ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Monet.source:
--!strict
-- Fair monetization (docs/DEFINICOES.md §6), cosmetics and convenience only:
--   • Gamepass "Pacote do Sobrevivente" — gold weapon skin + a trail ("SurvivorPack" attribute;
--     CombatService paints the gun, this module adds the trail).
--   • Developer Product "Boost 2x XP por 1 h" — extends the profile's boostUntil.
-- Receipts are idempotent: a purchase id is recorded in the profile and only reported as
-- granted once the profile carrying it has been saved, so a crash never loses or doubles it.
-- With ids left at 0 (not created in the Creator Hub yet) everything here stays inactive.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local ProfileSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.Data.ProfileSchema)
local ProgressionService = require(script.Parent.ProgressionService)

local MonetizationService = {}

local M = Config.MONETIZATION
local notifyRemote: RemoteEvent
-- Receipts applied in memory whose profile hasn't been saved yet.
local unsaved: { [string]: boolean } = {}

local function addTrail(character: Model)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or root:FindFirstChild("SurvivorTrail") then
		return
	end
	local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
	top.Name = "SurvivorTrailTop"
	top.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0.4)
	top.Parent = root
	local bottom = Instance.new("Attachment")
	bottom.Name = "SurvivorTrailBottom"
	bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.9, 0.4)
	bottom.Parent = root
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Name = "SurvivorTrail"
	trail.Attachment0 = top
	trail.Attachment1 = bottom
	trail.Lifetime = 0.35
	trail.LightEmission = 0.6
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 230), Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0))
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3, 1)
	trail.Parent = root
end

local function grantPack(player: Player)
	player:SetAttribute("SurvivorPack", true)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(addTrail, player.Character)
	end
end

local function checkPass(player: Player)
	if M.survivorPackId == 0 then
		return
	end
	local ok, owns = pcall(
		MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync,
		MarketplaceService,
		player.UserId,
		M.survivorPackId
	)
	if ok and owns then
		grantPack(player)
	end
end

local function hasReceipt(profile: ProfileSchema.Profile, id: string): boolean
	return table.find(profile.receipts, id) ~= nil
end

local function processReceipt(receipt: any): Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	local profile = player and DataService.get(player)
	if not player or not profile then
		-- Not in this server (or still loading): Roblox retries later, possibly elsewhere.
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local id = tostring(receipt.PurchaseId)
	if hasReceipt(profile, id) and not unsaved[id] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted -- already granted and saved
	end

	if not hasReceipt(profile, id) then
		if receipt.ProductId ~= M.xpBoostProductId or M.xpBoostProductId == 0 then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet -- unknown product: don't eat it
		end
		profile.boostUntil = math.max(profile.boostUntil, os.time()) + M.boostSeconds
		table.insert(profile.receipts, id)
		unsaved[id] = true
		ProgressionService.refresh(player)
	end

	if DataService.saveNow(player) then
		unsaved[id] = nil
		notifyRemote:FireClient(player, "Boost 2x XP ativado!")
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

function MonetizationService.init()
	notifyRemote = Net.notify()
end

function MonetizationService.start()
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt

	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if purchased and passId == M.survivorPackId and M.survivorPackId ~= 0 then
			grantPack(player)
			notifyRemote:FireClient(player, "Pacote do Sobrevivente ativado!")
		end
	end)

	local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			if player:GetAttribute("SurvivorPack") == true then
				addTrail(character)
			end
		end)
		checkPass(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
end

return MonetizationService

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Class.source:
--!strict
-- Classes and their abilities (docs/DEFINICOES.md §4). The chosen class lives in the player's
-- "Class" attribute (CombatService reads it for loadout and bonuses). Abilities:
--   Gunslinger   — incendiary rounds: sets "IncendiaryUntil" (server time); CombatService
--                  makes hits burn while it lasts.
--   Exterminator — molotov: a thrown bottle that leaves a fire patch hurting zombies inside.
-- "AbilityReadyAt" (server time) drives the cooldown on the HUD.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Types = require(Shared.Types)
local HordeService = require(script.Parent.HordeService)

local ClassService = {}

local FIRE_TICK = 0.25
local MOLOTOV_SPEED = 70
local MOLOTOV_LIFT = 25
local MOLOTOV_FLIGHT = 0.8

type FirePatch = {
	position: Vector3,
	radius: number,
	dps: number,
	endsAt: number,
	owner: Player,
	visual: BasePart,
}

local patches: { FirePatch } = {}
local projectiles: Folder

local function phase(): string
	local match = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Match")
	local value = match and match:GetAttribute("Phase")
	return if typeof(value) == "string" then value else "Waiting"
end

local function classOf(player: Player): Config.ClassStats
	local id = player:GetAttribute("Class")
	return Config.CLASSES[id :: Types.ClassId] or Config.CLASSES[Config.DEFAULT_CLASS]
end

local function onSelectClass(player: Player, classId: unknown)
	if typeof(classId) ~= "string" or Config.CLASSES[classId :: Types.ClassId] == nil then
		return
	end
	-- Only in the lobby or between waves, so nobody swaps loadouts mid-fight.
	if phase() ~= "Prep" and phase() ~= "Lobby" and phase() ~= "Waiting" then
		return
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("Class") ~= classId then
		player:SetAttribute("Class", classId)
	end
end

local function startFire(owner: Player, position: Vector3, ability: Config.AbilityStats)
	local visual = Instance.new("Part")
	visual.Name = "FirePatch"
	visual.Anchored = true
	visual.CanCollide = false
	visual.CanQuery = false
	visual.CanTouch = false
	visual.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	visual.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, ability.radius * 2, ability.radius * 2)
	visual.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0))
		* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	visual.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 30)
	visual.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	visual.Transparency = 0.55
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Size = ability.radius
	fire.Heat = 8
	fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)
	fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 30, 10)
	fire.Parent = visual
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 50)
	light.Range = ability.radius * 2.5
	light.Brightness = 3
	light.Parent = visual
	visual.Parent = projectiles

	table.insert(patches, {
		position = position,
		radius = ability.radius,
		dps = ability.fireDps,
		endsAt = os.clock() + ability.duration,
		owner = owner,
		visual = visual,
	})
end

local function throwMolotov(
	player: Player,
	head: BasePart,
	direction: Vector3,
	ability: Config.AbilityStats
)
	local bottle = Instance.new("Part")
	bottle.Name = "Molotov"
	bottle.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 1, 0.5)
	bottle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 130, 60)
	bottle.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
	bottle.CanCollide = false
	bottle.CanQuery = false
	bottle.CanTouch = false
	bottle.CFrame = CFrame.new(head.Position + direction * 2.5)
	bottle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * MOLOTOV_SPEED + Vector3.new(0, MOLOTOV_LIFT, 0)
	bottle.Parent = projectiles
	bottle:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

	task.delay(MOLOTOV_FLIGHT, function()
		local position = bottle.Position
		bottle:Destroy()
		-- Settle the fire on whatever is below where the bottle broke.
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace }
		local ground =
			workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), params)
		startFire(
			player,
			if ground then ground.Position else Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z),
			ability
		)
		HordeService.noise(position, 40, 2, nil)
	end)
end

local function onUseAbility(player: Player, aim: unknown)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local readyAt = player:GetAttribute("AbilityReadyAt")
	if typeof(readyAt) == "number" and now < readyAt then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	local class = classOf(player)
	local ability = class.ability
	if ability.fireDps > 0 then
		if typeof(aim) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end
		local direction = aim :: Vector3
		local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
		if not (magnitude > 0.9 and magnitude < 1.1) then
			return -- also rejects NaN
		end
		throwMolotov(player, head, direction.Unit, ability)
	else
		player:SetAttribute("IncendiaryUntil", now + ability.duration)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("AbilityReadyAt", now + ability.cooldown)
end

local function tickFire(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	for i = #patches, 1, -1 do
		local patch = patches[i]
		if now >= patch.endsAt then
			patch.visual:Destroy()
			table.remove(patches, i)
		else
			local damage = patch.dps * dt
			local attacker = if patch.owner.Parent then patch.owner else nil
			for _, zombie in HordeService.getZombies() do
				if not zombie.dead then
					local offset = zombie.position - patch.position
					if
						Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z).Magnitude <= patch.radius
						and math.abs(offset.Y) < 4
					then
						HordeService.damage(zombie, damage, attacker)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Removes every fire patch and resets cooldowns (new match). Classes are kept.
function ClassService.reset()
	for _, patch in patches do
		patch.visual:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(patches)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		player:SetAttribute("AbilityReadyAt", 0)
		player:SetAttribute("IncendiaryUntil", 0)
	end
end

function ClassService.init()
	projectiles = Instance.new("Folder")
	projectiles.Name = "Abilities"
	projectiles.Parent = workspace
end

function ClassService.start()
	Net.selectClass().OnServerEvent:Connect(onSelectClass)
	Net.useAbility().OnServerEvent:Connect(onUseAbility)

	local function setup(player: Player)
		if player:GetAttribute("Class") == nil then
			player:SetAttribute("Class", Config.DEFAULT_CLASS)
		end
		player:SetAttribute("AbilityReadyAt", 0)
		player:SetAttribute("IncendiaryUntil", 0)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		setup(player)
	end

	local accumulator = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator += dt
		if accumulator >= FIRE_TICK then
			tickFire(accumulator)
			accumulator = 0
		end
	end)
end

return ClassService

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Progr.source:
--!strict
-- Account XP and levels (Config.PROGRESSION), shared by every place (the camp hub and the
-- maps). XP is awarded through award() — MatchRewards does it for kills, waves, matches and
-- extractions — doubled while an XP boost is active. The level is derived from lifetime XP;
-- levels unlock shop items (ShopService enforces it).
--
-- Mirrored to the client as player attributes: Level, LevelXP (progress inside the level),
-- LevelXPNeeded, MatchXP (earned this match) and BoostUntil (os.time()).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local ProgressionService = {}

local P = Config.PROGRESSION

local notifyRemote: RemoteEvent

-- XP needed to go from `level` to `level + 1`.
function ProgressionService.xpForLevel(level: number): number
	return math.floor(P.levelBase * level ^ P.levelExponent)
end

-- Level and progress inside it for a lifetime XP total.
function ProgressionService.levelFromXp(xp: number): (number, number, number)
	local level = 1
	local remaining = xp
	while remaining >= ProgressionService.xpForLevel(level) do
		remaining -= ProgressionService.xpForLevel(level)
		level += 1
	end
	return level, remaining, ProgressionService.xpForLevel(level)
end

function ProgressionService.level(player: Player): number
	local value = player:GetAttribute("Level")
	return if typeof(value) == "number" then value else 1
end

local function boosted(player: Player): boolean
	local profile = DataService.get(player)
	return profile ~= nil and profile.boostUntil > os.time()
end

local function mirror(player: Player)
	local profile = DataService.get(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local level, progress, needed = ProgressionService.levelFromXp(profile.xp)
	player:SetAttribute("Level", level)
	player:SetAttribute("LevelXP", progress)
	player:SetAttribute("LevelXPNeeded", needed)
	player:SetAttribute("BoostUntil", profile.boostUntil)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local value = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Nível")
	if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then
		value.Value = level
	end
end

local function unlocksAt(level: number): { string }
	local names = {}
	for item, required in P.unlocks do
		if required == level then
			local gun = Config.GUNS[item :: Config.GunName]
			local melee = Config.MELEE[item :: Config.MeleeName]
			table.insert(
				names,
				if gun then gun.displayName elseif melee then melee.displayName else "Torreta"
			)
		end
	end
	return names
end

-- Adds XP (boost applied) and announces level-ups with what they unlock.
function ProgressionService.award(player: Player, amount: number)
	local profile = DataService.get(player)
	if not profile or amount <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local gained = amount * (if boosted(player) then Config.MONETIZATION.boostMultiplier else 1)
	local before = ProgressionService.levelFromXp(profile.xp)
	profile.xp += gained
	local after = ProgressionService.levelFromXp(profile.xp)
	local matchXp = player:GetAttribute("MatchXP")
	player:SetAttribute("MatchXP", (if typeof(matchXp) == "number" then matchXp else 0) + gained)
	mirror(player)
	for level = before + 1, after do
		local unlocked = unlocksAt(level)
		notifyRemote:FireClient(
			player,
			`Nível {level}!`
				.. (if #unlocked > 0 then " Desbloqueado: " .. table.concat(unlocked, ", ") else "")
		)
	end
end

function ProgressionService.init()
	notifyRemote = Net.notify()
end

function ProgressionService.start()
	local function onLoaded(player: Player)
		player:SetAttribute("MatchXP", 0)
		-- Maps get leaderstats from EconomyService; the hub has none, so make our own.
		local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 5)
		if not leaderstats and player.Parent then
			leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
			leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
			leaderstats.Parent = player
		end
		if leaderstats and not leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Nível") then
			local level = Instance.new("IntValue")
			level.Name = "Nível"
			level.Parent = leaderstats
		end
		mirror(player)
	end
	DataService.loaded:connect(function(player)
		task.spawn(onLoaded, player)
	end)
	-- Profiles that finished loading before this service started (systems start in any order).
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if DataService.get(player) then
			task.spawn(onLoaded, player)
		end
	end
end

-- Re-publishes attributes after something outside changed the profile (e.g. a boost).
ProgressionService.refresh = mirror

return ProgressionService

ServerScriptService.Server.source:
--!strict
-- Roblox Swarm: Outbreak server entry point. Two-phase bootstrap: init() all, then start() all.

local Folder = script:FindFirstChild("Systems")

local loaded: { [string]: any } = {}
if Folder then
	for _, child in Folder:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			loaded[child.Name] = require(child) :: any
		end
	end
end

for _, mod in loaded do
	if typeof(mod.init) == "function" then
		mod.init()
	end
end

for _, mod in loaded do
	if typeof(mod.start) == "function" then
		task.spawn(mod.start)
	end
end

print("[Swarm] server started")

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.DataS.source:
--!strict
-- Player profiles: one DataStore key per player, claimed with a session lock so only one
-- server owns a profile at a time (no dupes when rejoining fast). Gameplay reads and writes the
-- in-memory profile only; this module persists it on an autosave timer, when the player
-- leaves and on server shutdown. If a profile can't be loaded the player is kicked rather
-- than handed a blank profile that would overwrite their real data on the next save.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local ProfileSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.Data.ProfileSchema)
local Stores = require(script.Parent.Parent.Data.Stores)

local DataService = {}

-- Fired once a player's profile is loaded and owned by this server.
DataService.loaded = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player, ProfileSchema.Profile>

local AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL = 60
local LOCK_STALE = AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL * 2 + 30 -- a lock not refreshed this long is a dead server's
local LOAD_ATTEMPTS = 5
local SHUTDOWN_WAIT = 25

type Session = {
	profile: ProfileSchema.Profile,
	key: string,
	released: boolean,
}

local store: Stores.Store
local sessions: { [Player]: Session } = {}
local jobId = if game.JobId ~= "" then game.JobId else "studio"

local function keyFor(player: Player): string
	return "player_" .. player.UserId
end

-- pcall + exponential backoff around one store call.
local function withRetry<T>(attempts: number, fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	local delaySeconds = 1
	for attempt = 1, attempts do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(`[Data] attempt {attempt}/{attempts} failed: {result}`)
		if attempt < attempts then
			task.wait(delaySeconds)
			delaySeconds = math.min(delaySeconds * 2, 16)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

-- Claims the lock and loads (migrating) in one atomic UpdateAsync.
-- Returns the profile, or nil plus whether it failed because another server holds it.
local function claim(key: string): (ProfileSchema.Profile?, boolean)
	local lockedElsewhere = false
	local loaded: ProfileSchema.Profile? = nil
	local ok = withRetry(3, function()
		lockedElsewhere = false
		return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(stored: any)
			local lock = if typeof(stored) == "table" then stored.lock else nil
			if
				typeof(lock) == "table"
				and lock.jobId ~= jobId
				and typeof(lock.time) == "number"
				and os.time() - lock.time < LOCK_STALE
			then
				lockedElsewhere = true
				return nil -- abort: another server owns this profile
			end
			local profile = ProfileSchema.migrate(stored)
			local out: any = ProfileSchema.serialize(profile)
			out.lock = { jobId = jobId, time = os.time() }
			loaded = profile
			return out
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return nil, false
	end
	return loaded, lockedElsewhere
end

-- Writes the in-memory profile. `release` clears the lock (leaving / shutting down).
-- Refuses to write if another server took the lock meanwhile.
local function save(session: Session, release: boolean): boolean
	local stolen = false
	local ok = withRetry(3, function()
		stolen = false
		return store:UpdateAsync(session.key, function(stored: any)
			local lock = if typeof(stored) == "table" then stored.lock else nil
			if typeof(lock) == "table" and lock.jobId ~= jobId then
				stolen = true
				return nil
			end
			local out: any = ProfileSchema.serialize(session.profile)
			out.lock = if release then nil else { jobId = jobId, time = os.time() }
			return out
		end)
	end)
	if stolen then
		warn(`[Data] lost the session lock for {session.key}; not overwriting`)
		return false
	end
	return ok
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local key = keyFor(player)
	for attempt = 1, LOAD_ATTEMPTS do
		local profile, lockedElsewhere = claim(key)
		if not player.Parent then
			-- Left while loading: hand the lock straight back.
			if profile then
				save({ profile = profile, key = key, released = false }, true)
			end
			return
		end
		if profile then
			sessions[player] = { profile = profile, key = key, released = false }
			DataService.loaded:fire(player, profile)
			return
		end
		if not lockedElsewhere then
			break -- the store itself failed; retrying the lock won't help
		end
		if attempt < LOAD_ATTEMPTS then
			task.wait(3) -- the previous server may still be saving
		end
	end
	player:Kick("Não foi possível carregar seu progresso. Entre de novo em alguns instantes.")
end

local function release(player: Player)
	local session = sessions[player]
	if not session or session.released then
		return
	end
	session.released = true
	save(session, true)
	sessions[player] = nil
end

-- The loaded profile, or nil while loading / after leaving. Gameplay mutates it directly.
function DataService.get(player: Player): ProfileSchema.Profile?
	local session = sessions[player]
	return if session then session.profile else nil
end

-- Saves right away (used after purchases). Returns whether the write succeeded.
function DataService.saveNow(player: Player): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
	return session ~= nil and not session.released and save(session, false)
end

function DataService.isOffline(): boolean
	return store.offline
end

function DataService.init()
	store = Stores.profiles()
end

function DataService.start()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(release)

	-- Staggered autosave: each player saves at their own offset within the interval.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL / 6)
			local slot = math.floor(os.clock() / (AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL / 6)) % 6
			for player, session in sessions do
				if player.UserId % 6 == slot and not session.released then
					task.spawn(save, session, false)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for player in sessions do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				release(player)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		if RunService:IsStudio() then
			return -- don't make every stopped playtest hang
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + SHUTDOWN_WAIT
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)
end

return DataService

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Match.source:
--!strict
-- Match flow (docs/DEFINICOES.md §4): Lobby (pick a class, press PRONTO) → Prep → Wave 1 → … →
-- Prep → Final wave with the Brute (survive finalDuration) → Extract (reach the helicopter) →
-- Result → Lobby.
--
-- Only the players in the lobby when the match starts take part (up to MATCH.maxPlayers; their
-- `InMatch` attribute is true). Anyone who joins later has no character and spectates until
-- the next lobby. In a portal group's reserved server (the normal case once the hub is live)
-- the lobby waits for the whole party from the teleport data, and after the result everyone
-- flies back to the camp hub. State is published as attributes on ReplicatedStorage.Match (Phase, Wave,
-- EndsAt in server time, Remaining, BossHealth/BossMaxHealth, Outcome, LobbyCount,
-- ReadyCount) so the HUD needs no remotes. Participants who die during combat stay down until
-- the next Prep; if every participant is down or gone, the match is lost.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Tags = require(Shared.Tags)
local Types = require(Shared.Types)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local BarricadeService = require(script.Parent.BarricadeService)
local ClassService = require(script.Parent.ClassService)
local EconomyService = require(script.Parent.EconomyService)
local HordeService = require(script.Parent.HordeService)
local TurretService = require(script.Parent.TurretService)

local MatchService = {}

-- Progression hooks: a new match began; a wave was cleared (its number); the match ended
-- with the players who made it onto the helicopter (empty on a defeat).
MatchService.started = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<()>
MatchService.waveCleared = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number>
MatchService.finished = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<"Victory" | "Defeat", { Player }>

local MATCH = Config.MATCH
local EXTRACT_TIME = 25
local RESPAWN_DELAY = 3 -- outside combat
local LEAVE_GRACE = 30 -- after sending everyone to the hub, don't reopen the lobby this long

local state: Configuration
local phase: Types.MatchPhase = "Waiting"
local phaseEndsAt = 0 -- os.clock() deadline, 0 = no timer
local wave = 0
local spawnQueue: { Types.ZombieKind } = {}
local spawnAccumulator = 0
local queueEmptiedAt = 0
local boss: HordeService.Zombie? = nil
local helicopter: Model? = nil
local participants: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
-- A hub portal group's private server (or Studio simulating one): wait for `party`, then
-- send everyone back to the hub after the result.
local reserved = (game.PrivateServerId ~= "" and game.PrivateServerOwnerId == 0)
	or (RunService:IsStudio() and Config.DEBUG.simulateReserved)
local party: { number }? = nil
local notifyRemote: RemoteEvent
local leavingUntil = 0 -- os.clock(); the group is on its way back to the hub

local function setPhase(newPhase: Types.MatchPhase, duration: number?)
	phase = newPhase
	local now = os.clock()
	phaseEndsAt = if duration then now + duration else 0
	-- Phase last: clients react to its change and read the others.
	state:SetAttribute("Wave", wave)
	state:SetAttribute("EndsAt", if duration then workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + duration else 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", newPhase)
end

function MatchService.isParticipant(player: Player): boolean
	return participants[player] == true
end

local function participantCount(): number
	local count = 0
	for _ in participants do
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

local function aliveHumanoids(): { [Player]: BasePart }
	local alive = {}
	for player in participants do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			alive[player] = root
		end
	end
	return alive
end

local function loadMissingCharacters()
	for player in participants do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			task.spawn(player.LoadCharacter, player)
		end
	end
end

local function playerScale(): number
	return 1 + MATCH.extraPlayerScale * math.max(0, participantCount() - 1)
end

local function buildQueue(composition: { [string]: number }): { Types.ZombieKind }
	local queue: { Types.ZombieKind } = {}
	local scale = playerScale()
	for kind, count in composition do
		for _ = 1, math.round(count * scale) do
			table.insert(queue, kind :: Types.ZombieKind)
		end
	end
	-- Shuffle so special zombies arrive mixed into the crowd.
	for i = #queue, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		queue[i], queue[j] = queue[j], queue[i]
	end
	return queue
end

local function pickFinalKind(): Types.ZombieKind
	local roll = math.random()
	for kind, weight in MATCH.finalMix do
		roll -= weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return kind :: Types.ZombieKind
		end
	end
	return "Runner"
end

-- Helicopter ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function extractionZone(): BasePart?
	local zone = CollectionService:GetTagged(Tags.Extraction)[1]
	return if zone and zone:IsA("BasePart") then zone else nil
end

local function inZone(zone: BasePart, position: Vector3): boolean
	local offset = zone.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	return math.abs(offset.X) <= zone.Size.X / 2 and math.abs(offset.Z) <= zone.Size.Z / 2
end

-- Greybox helicopter that descends onto the extraction field.
local function spawnHelicopter(zone: BasePart)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Helicopter"
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Size = Vector3.new(8, 6, 18)
	body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 80, 60)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	body.Anchored = true
	body.CanCollide = false
	body.Parent = model
	local rotor = Instance.new("Part")
	rotor.Name = "Rotor"
	rotor.Size = Vector3.new(30, 0.3, 1.5)
	rotor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	rotor.Anchored = true
	rotor.CanCollide = false
	rotor.Parent = model
	local tail = Instance.new("Part")
	tail.Name = "Tail"
	tail.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 12)
	tail.Color = body.Color
	tail.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	tail.Anchored = true
	tail.CanCollide = false
	tail.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = body

	local landed = zone.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	local function place(at: Vector3)
		body.CFrame = CFrame.new(at)
		rotor.CFrame = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
		tail.CFrame = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(0, 1, 14))
	end
	place(landed + Vector3.new(0, 80, 0))
	model.Parent = workspace
	helicopter = model

	local height = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	height.Value = 80
	height.Changed:Connect(function(value)
		place(landed + Vector3.new(0, value, 0))
	end)
	TweenService:Create(
		height,
		TweenInfo.new(6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Value = 0 }
	):Play()
end

-- Phases -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function startPrep()
	local index = math.min(wave + 1, #MATCH.prepTimes)
	setPhase("Prep", MATCH.prepTimes[index])
	loadMissingCharacters()
end

local function startWave()
	wave += 1
	spawnQueue = buildQueue(MATCH.waves[wave])
	queueEmptiedAt = 0
	setPhase("Wave")
end

local function startFinal()
	wave = #MATCH.waves + 1
	spawnQueue = {}
	setPhase("Final", MATCH.finalDuration)
	local stats = Config.ZOMBIES.Brute
	local health = stats.health + Config.BRUTE.healthPerPlayer * #Players:GetPlayers()
	boss = HordeService.spawnRandom("Brute", health)
	state:SetAttribute("BossMaxHealth", health)
end

local function finish(outcome: "Victory" | "Defeat", extracted: { Player }?)
	MatchService.finished:fire(outcome, extracted or {})
	state:SetAttribute("Outcome", outcome)
	state:SetAttribute("BossMaxHealth", 0)
	boss = nil
	-- The horde leaves with the match, so nobody respawns into it during the result screen.
	spawnQueue = {}
	HordeService.clear()
	setPhase("Result", MATCH.resultTime)
end

-- Back to the lobby: a clean farm, everyone (participants and spectators) on their feet and
-- free to pick a class, nobody ready yet.
local function enterLobby()
	HordeService.clear()
	BarricadeService.resetAll()
	TurretService.clear()
	spawnQueue = {}
	boss = nil
	if helicopter then
		helicopter:Destroy()
		helicopter = nil
	end
	table.clear(participants)
	wave = 0
	state:SetAttribute("Outcome", "")
	state:SetAttribute("Remaining", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("BossHealth", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("BossMaxHealth", 0)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		player:SetAttribute("InMatch", false)
		player:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
		task.spawn(player.LoadCharacter, player)
	end
	setPhase("Lobby", if reserved then MATCH.reservedLobbyTime else MATCH.lobbyTime)
end

-- Teleports `players` to the camp hub. Returns false when it can't (no hub, Studio, failure).
local function sendToHub(players: { Player }): boolean
	local hub = Config.PLACES.hub
	if #players == 0 or hub <= 0 or hub == game.PlaceId then
		return false
	end
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		for _, player in players do
			notifyRemote:FireClient(player, "(Studio) teleporte simulado para o acampamento")
		end
		return false
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(TeleportService.TeleportAsync, TeleportService, hub, players)
	if not ok then
		warn(`[Match] teleport back to the hub failed: {err}`)
	end
	return ok
end

-- The players in the lobby (up to maxPlayers, earliest first) become the match roster.
local function startMatch()
	ClassService.reset()
	EconomyService.resetAll()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local joins = participantCount() < MATCH.maxPlayers
		participants[player] = if joins then true else nil
		player:SetAttribute("InMatch", joins)
		player:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local kills = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Abates")
		if kills and kills:IsA("IntValue") then
			kills.Value = 0
		end
		if joins then
			-- Fresh characters: full health and a reset loadout (CombatService resets on spawn).
			task.spawn(player.LoadCharacter, player)
		elseif player.Character then
			player.Character:Destroy() -- over the cap: watch this match, play the next
		end
	end
	setPhase("Prep", MATCH.prepTimes[1])
	MatchService.started:fire()
end

local function updateLobby(now: number)
	local present, ready = 0, 0
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		present += 1
		if player:GetAttribute("Ready") == true then
			ready += 1
		end
	end
	state:SetAttribute("LobbyCount", present)
	state:SetAttribute("ReadyCount", ready)
	-- A portal group waits for its stragglers still loading in (up to the lobby timer).
	local expected = if party then #party else 0
	-- Everyone ready: start shortly instead of waiting out the lobby timer.
	if
		present > 0
		and present >= expected
		and ready == present
		and phaseEndsAt - now > MATCH.readyStartDelay
	then
		phaseEndsAt = now + MATCH.readyStartDelay
		state:SetAttribute("EndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + MATCH.readyStartDelay)
	end
end

-- Tick ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function spawnFromQueue(dt: number, interval: number)
	spawnAccumulator += dt
	while spawnAccumulator >= interval and #spawnQueue > 0 do
		spawnAccumulator -= interval
		if not HordeService.spawnRandom(spawnQueue[#spawnQueue]) then
			break -- horde at its cap: try again next tick
		end
		spawnQueue[#spawnQueue] = nil
	end
	spawnAccumulator = math.min(spawnAccumulator, interval)
end

local function tick(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	local timeUp = phaseEndsAt > 0 and now >= phaseEndsAt

	if phase == "Waiting" then
		if #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 and now >= leavingUntil then
			enterLobby()
		end
		return
	elseif phase == "Lobby" then
		if #Players:GetPlayers() == 0 then
			setPhase("Waiting")
		else
			updateLobby(now)
			if now >= phaseEndsAt then
				startMatch()
			end
		end
		return
	elseif phase == "Result" then
		if timeUp then
			if #Players:GetPlayers() == 0 then
				setPhase("Waiting")
			elseif reserved then
				-- TeleportAsync yields: wait in Waiting (not here, where every frame would
				-- teleport again) and reopen the lobby only if the trip can't happen.
				leavingUntil = now + LEAVE_GRACE
				setPhase("Waiting")
				local leaving = Players:GetPlayers()
				task.spawn(function()
					if not sendToHub(leaving) then
						leavingUntil = 0
					end
				end)
			else
				enterLobby()
			end
		end
		return
	end

	-- A match is on. Everyone who played it left: back to the lobby (or Waiting if empty).
	if next(participants) == nil then
		if #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 then
			enterLobby()
		else
			setPhase("Waiting")
		end
		return
	end

	if phase == "Prep" then
		if timeUp then
			if wave < #MATCH.waves then
				startWave()
			else
				startFinal()
			end
		end
		return
	end

	-- Combat phases.
	if next(aliveHumanoids()) == nil then
		finish("Defeat")
		return
	end

	if phase == "Wave" then
		spawnFromQueue(dt, MATCH.spawnInterval)
		if #spawnQueue == 0 and queueEmptiedAt == 0 then
			queueEmptiedAt = now
		end
		if #spawnQueue == 0 and HordeService.aliveCount() == 0 then
			MatchService.waveCleared:fire(wave)
			startPrep()
		elseif queueEmptiedAt > 0 and now - queueEmptiedAt > MATCH.waveTimeout then
			HordeService.clear() -- stragglers stuck somewhere: don't block the match
			startPrep()
		end
	else
		-- Final and Extract: an endless mixed horde.
		if #spawnQueue == 0 then
			table.insert(spawnQueue, pickFinalKind())
		end
		spawnFromQueue(dt, MATCH.finalSpawnInterval)

		local b = boss
		if b and not b.dead then
			state:SetAttribute("BossHealth", math.max(0, b.health))
		elseif b then
			state:SetAttribute("BossHealth", 0)
		end

		if phase == "Final" and timeUp then
			setPhase("Extract", EXTRACT_TIME)
			local zone = extractionZone()
			if zone then
				spawnHelicopter(zone)
			end
		elseif phase == "Extract" then
			local zone = extractionZone()
			local aboard: { Player } = {}
			local total = 0
			for player, root in aliveHumanoids() do
				total += 1
				if zone and inZone(zone, root.Position) then
					table.insert(aboard, player)
				end
			end
			-- Everyone still standing aboard: leave now. Timer out: whoever made it wins.
			if total > 0 and #aboard == total then
				finish("Victory", aboard)
			elseif timeUp then
				finish(if #aboard > 0 then "Victory" else "Defeat", aboard)
			end
		end
	end

	state:SetAttribute("Remaining", #spawnQueue + HordeService.aliveCount())
end

-- Players ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The party a portal sent here, from the first arrival's teleport data.
local function readParty(player: Player)
	if party or not reserved then
		return
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return player:GetJoinData().TeleportData
	end)
	local list = ok and typeof(data) == "table" and (data :: any).party
	if typeof(list) == "table" then
		local ids = {}
		for _, id in list do
			if typeof(id) == "number" then
				table.insert(ids, id)
			end
		end
		party = ids
	end
end

local lastReturn: { [Player]: number } = {}
local function onReturnToHub(player: Player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastReturn[player] or 0) < 5 then
		return
	end
	lastReturn[player] = now
	-- Mid-match players stay: only the lobby, spectators and the result screen can leave.
	if participants[player] and phase ~= "Lobby" and phase ~= "Result" then
		return
	end
	sendToHub({ player })
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	readParty(player)
	player:SetAttribute("InMatch", false)
	player:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			-- In the lobby and in Prep you're back quickly; in combat you wait for the next
			-- Prep, and after the result the lobby reloads everyone.
			task.delay(RESPAWN_DELAY, function()
				if not player.Parent or player.Character ~= character then
					return
				end
				if phase == "Lobby" or (phase == "Prep" and participants[player]) then
					player:LoadCharacter()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
	-- Joining mid-match: no character, spectate until the next lobby.
	if phase == "Lobby" then
		player:LoadCharacter()
	end
end

local function onSetReady(player: Player, ready: unknown)
	if typeof(ready) == "boolean" and phase == "Lobby" then
		player:SetAttribute("Ready", ready)
	end
end

function MatchService.init()
	Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false
	state = Instance.new("Configuration")
	state.Name = "Match"
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
	state:SetAttribute("Wave", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Waves", #MATCH.waves + 1) -- the final wave counts too
	state:SetAttribute("EndsAt", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Remaining", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("BossHealth", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("BossMaxHealth", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Outcome", "")
	state:SetAttribute("LobbyCount", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("ReadyCount", 0)
	state.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	Net.setReady()
	Net.returnToHub()
	notifyRemote = Net.notify()
end

function MatchService.start()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		participants[player] = nil
		lastReturn[player] = nil
	end)
	Net.returnToHub().OnServerEvent:Connect(onReturnToHub)
	TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, _result, message)
		warn(`[Match] teleport of {player.Name} failed: {message}`)
		notifyRemote:FireClient(player, "Falha ao voltar ao acampamento — tente o botão de novo")
	end)
	Net.setReady().OnServerEvent:Connect(onSetReady)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(tick)
end

return MatchService

--!strict
-- Map-side XP sources (Config.PROGRESSION): kills, cleared waves, finished matches and
-- extractions. Only the match roster earns wave and match XP; spectators who joined late
-- don't. Lives with the map's systems so ProgressionService stays usable in the hub.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local HordeService = require(script.Parent.HordeService)
local MatchService = require(script.Parent.MatchService)
local ProgressionService = require(script.Parent.ProgressionService)

local MatchRewards = {}

local P = Config.PROGRESSION

function MatchRewards.start()
	HordeService.killed:connect(function(zombie, attacker)
		if attacker and attacker.Parent then
			local profile = DataService.get(attacker)
			if profile then
				profile.kills += 1
			end
			ProgressionService.award(attacker, P.xpPerKill[zombie.kindName] or 0)
		end
	end)

	MatchService.started:connect(function()
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			player:SetAttribute("MatchXP", 0)
		end
	end)
	MatchService.waveCleared:connect(function()
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if MatchService.isParticipant(player) then
				ProgressionService.award(player, P.xpWaveCleared)
			end
		end
	end)
	MatchService.finished:connect(function(_outcome, extracted)
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if not MatchService.isParticipant(player) then
				continue
			end
			local profile = DataService.get(player)
			if profile then
				profile.matches += 1
			end
			ProgressionService.award(player, P.xpMatchPlayed)
		end
		for _, player in extracted do
			local profile = DataService.get(player)
			if profile then
				profile.extractions += 1
			end
			ProgressionService.award(player, P.xpExtraction)
		end
	end)
end

return MatchRewards

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.ShopS.source:
--!strict
-- Barn shop (Config.SHOP). The client opens the menu from the shop crate's prompt; purchases
-- arrive here and are checked for everything that matters: the item exists, the player is
-- alive and standing at a shop crate, has the account level that unlocks it, can afford it,
-- and the item actually applies (not already equipped, grenades not full, kit limit). Credits
-- are only taken if it applied.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Tags = require(Shared.Tags)
local CombatService = require(script.Parent.CombatService)
local EconomyService = require(script.Parent.EconomyService)
local ProgressionService = require(script.Parent.ProgressionService)
local TurretService = require(script.Parent.TurretService)

local ShopService = {}

local PURCHASE_COOLDOWN = 0.3

local notifyRemote: RemoteEvent
local lastPurchase: { [Player]: number } = {}

local itemsById: { [string]: Config.ShopItem } = {}
for _, item in Config.SHOP do
	itemsById[item.id] = item
end

local function notify(player: Player, message: string)
	notifyRemote:FireClient(player, message)
end

local function atShop(player: Player): boolean
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false
	end
	for _, crate in CollectionService:GetTagged(Tags.ShopBox) do
		if
			crate:IsA("BasePart")
			and (crate.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= Config.SHOP_RANGE
		then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Applies the item; returns nil on success or the reason it couldn't.
local function apply(player: Player, item: Config.ShopItem): string?
	if item.kind == "gun" then
		return if CombatService.equipGun(player, item.id :: Config.GunName)
			then nil
			else "Você já está com essa arma"
	elseif item.kind == "melee" then
		return if CombatService.equipMelee(player, item.id :: Config.MeleeName)
			then nil
			else "Você já está com essa arma"
	elseif item.kind == "grenade" then
		return if CombatService.addGrenade(player) then nil else "Granadas no máximo"
	elseif item.kind == "heal" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return "Item indisponível"
		end
		if humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
			return "Sua vida já está cheia"
		end
		humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
		return nil
	elseif item.kind == "turret" then
		return if TurretService.addKit(player) then nil else "Limite de torretas atingido"
	end
	return "Item indisponível"
end

local function onPurchase(player: Player, itemId: unknown)
	if typeof(itemId) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local item = itemsById[itemId]
	local now = os.clock()
	if not item or now - (lastPurchase[player] or 0) < PURCHASE_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastPurchase[player] = now

	-- Credits and loadouts belong to a match: nothing to buy in the lobby.
	if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") ~= true then
		notify(player, "A loja abre quando a partida começa")
		return
	end
	if not atShop(player) then
		notify(player, "Chegue mais perto da loja")
		return
	end
	local required = Config.PROGRESSION.unlocks[item.id]
	if required and ProgressionService.level(player) < required then
		notify(player, `Desbloqueia no nível {required}`)
		return
	end
	if EconomyService.get(player) < item.price then
		notify(player, "Créditos insuficientes")
		return
	end
	local failure = apply(player, item)
	if failure then
		notify(player, failure)
		return
	end
	EconomyService.spend(player, item.price) -- can't fail: checked above, same frame
	notify(
		player,
		if item.kind == "turret"
			then "Torreta comprada: instale numa marca azul do quintal"
			else "Comprou: " .. item.displayName
	)
end

function ShopService.init()
	notifyRemote = Net.notify()
end

function ShopService.start()
	Net.purchase().OnServerEvent:Connect(onPurchase)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastPurchase[player] = nil
	end)
end

return ShopService

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Turre.source:
--!strict
-- Automatic turrets. A turret kit bought at the shop ("TurretKits" player attribute) is
-- installed by holding the prompt on one of the map's TurretSlot markers. The turret shoots
-- the nearest visible zombie in range, credits kills to its owner, makes noise, and powers
-- down (freeing the slot) when its ammo runs out.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Hitscan = require(Shared.Hitscan)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Tags = require(Shared.Tags)
local HordeService = require(script.Parent.HordeService)

local TurretService = {}

local TURRET = Config.TURRET
local RETARGET_INTERVAL = 0.3
local MAX_SIGHT_CHECKS = 4 -- line-of-sight raycasts per retarget
local HEAD_HEIGHT = 2.8

type Turret = {
	slot: BasePart,
	owner: Player,
	ammo: number,
	model: Model,
	head: BasePart,
	target: HordeService.Zombie?,
	nextShot: number,
	nextRetarget: number,
}

local turrets: { [BasePart]: Turret } = {}
local shotRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent
local notifyRemote: RemoteEvent

local function notify(player: Player, message: string)
	if player.Parent then
		notifyRemote:FireClient(player, message)
	end
end

local function kits(player: Player): number
	local value = player:GetAttribute("TurretKits")
	return if typeof(value) == "number" then value else 0
end

function TurretService.addKit(player: Player): boolean
	if kits(player) >= TURRET.maxKits then
		return false
	end
	player:SetAttribute("TurretKits", kits(player) + 1)
	return true
end

local function slotPrompt(slot: BasePart): ProximityPrompt?
	return slot:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
end

local function buildModel(slot: BasePart): (Model, BasePart)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Turret"
	local function piece(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		cframe: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		material: Enum.Material
	): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Anchored = true
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cframe
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = material
		p.CanQuery = false -- bullets pass the turret, it isn't cover
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end
	local base = slot.Position
	piece(
		"Base",
		Vector3.new(3, 2, 3),
		CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)),
		Color3.fromRGB(60, 62, 66),
		Enum.Material.DiamondPlate
	)
	local head = piece(
		"Head",
		Vector3.new(1.8, 1.2, 2.6),
		CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, HEAD_HEIGHT, 0)),
		Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 48),
		Enum.Material.Metal
	)
	local lamp = piece(
		"Lamp",
		Vector3.new(0.4, 0.2, 0.4),
		head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.7, 0.6),
		Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 230),
		Enum.Material.Neon
	)
	lamp.CanCollide = false
	local barrel = piece(
		"Barrel",
		Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 2),
		head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.2),
		Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
		Enum.Material.Metal
	)
	barrel.CanCollide = false
	-- Lamp and barrel follow the head when it turns.
	for _, attached in { lamp, barrel } do
		attached.Anchored = false
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = head
		weld.Part1 = attached
		weld.Parent = attached
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = head
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model, head
end

local function removeTurret(turret: Turret)
	turret.model:Destroy()
	turrets[turret.slot] = nil
	local prompt = slotPrompt(turret.slot)
	if prompt then
		prompt.Enabled = true
	end
end

local function install(slot: BasePart, player: Player)
	if turrets[slot] then
		return
	end
	if kits(player) < 1 then
		notify(player, "Compre uma torreta na loja do celeiro")
		return
	end
	player:SetAttribute("TurretKits", kits(player) - 1)
	local model, head = buildModel(slot)
	turrets[slot] = {
		slot = slot,
		owner = player,
		ammo = TURRET.ammo,
		model = model,
		head = head,
		target = nil,
		nextShot = 0,
		nextRetarget = 0,
	}
	local prompt = slotPrompt(slot)
	if prompt then
		prompt.Enabled = false
	end
	notify(player, "Torreta instalada")
end

local function chest(zombie: HordeService.Zombie): Vector3
	return zombie.position
		+ Vector3.new(0, Hitscan.CHEST_HEIGHT * Config.ZOMBIES[zombie.kindName].scale, 0)
end

-- Nearest zombie in range that the turret can actually see.
local function findTarget(turret: Turret): HordeService.Zombie?
	local origin = turret.head.Position
	local candidates: { { zombie: HordeService.Zombie, dist: number } } = {}
	for _, zombie in HordeService.getZombies() do
		if not zombie.dead then
			local dist = (chest(zombie) - origin).Magnitude
			if dist <= TURRET.range then
				table.insert(candidates, { zombie = zombie, dist = dist })
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		return a.dist < b.dist
	end)
	for i = 1, math.min(#candidates, MAX_SIGHT_CHECKS) do
		local zombie = candidates[i].zombie
		if Hitscan.clearLine(origin, chest(zombie)) then
			return zombie
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function stepTurret(turret: Turret, now: number)
	if now >= turret.nextRetarget then
		turret.nextRetarget = now + RETARGET_INTERVAL
		turret.target = findTarget(turret)
	end
	local target = turret.target
	if not target or target.dead or now < turret.nextShot then
		return
	end
	local aim = chest(target)
	local origin = turret.head.Position
	if (aim - origin).Magnitude > TURRET.range then
		turret.target = nil
		return
	end
	turret.nextShot = now + 1 / TURRET.fireRate

	turret.head.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, Vector3.new(aim.X, origin.Y, aim.Z))
	local muzzle = origin + turret.head.CFrame.LookVector * 3.2
	local owner = if turret.owner.Parent then turret.owner else nil
	HordeService.damage(target, TURRET.damage, owner)
	shotRemote:FireAllClients(muzzle, aim)
	HordeService.noise(turret.slot.Position, TURRET.noise, 1.5, turret)

	turret.ammo -= 1
	if turret.ammo <= 0 then
		removeTurret(turret)
		if owner then
			notify(owner, "Sua torreta ficou sem munição")
		end
	end
end

local function setupSlot(instance: Instance)
	if not instance:IsA("BasePart") or slotPrompt(instance) then
		return
	end
	local slot = instance
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Instalar torreta"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Ponto de torreta"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 1
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = slot
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		install(slot, player)
	end)
end

-- Removes every turret and kit (new match).
function TurretService.clear()
	for _, turret in turrets do
		removeTurret(turret)
	end
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		player:SetAttribute("TurretKits", 0)
	end
end

function TurretService.init()
	shotRemote = Net.turretShot()
	notifyRemote = Net.notify()
end

function TurretService.start()
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Tags.TurretSlot):Connect(setupSlot)
	for _, slot in CollectionService:GetTagged(Tags.TurretSlot) do
		setupSlot(slot)
	end
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, turret in turrets do
			stepTurret(turret, now)
		end
	end)
end

return TurretService

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Comba.source:
--!strict
-- Server authority for player weapons. Clients raycast locally for instant feedback and send
-- *claims*; this service owns ammo, fire rate, reloads and damage, and re-checks every claim
-- (zombie exists, in weapon range, visible from the player's head). Melee and grenades are
-- resolved entirely here from server positions.
--
-- Known trust gap (accepted for PvE co-op): the server doesn't verify the shot's aim, so a
-- modified client could pick any visible zombie in range. Damage per second is still capped
-- by fire rate, magazine and reserve, so it can't do more than a perfect-aim player.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Hitscan = require(Shared.Hitscan)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Tags = require(Shared.Tags)
local Types = require(Shared.Types)
local HordeService = require(script.Parent.HordeService)
local WeaponModels = require(Shared.Art.WeaponModels)

local CombatService = {}

-- Slack for network latency: clients see zombies ~100–200 ms in the past.
local RANGE_SLACK = 12
local MELEE_RANGE_SLACK = 2
local MELEE_ARC_SLACK = 15
local FIRE_BURST = 2 -- shots that may arrive bunched together by network jitter
local SYNC_MIN_INTERVAL = 0.25

type PlayerState = {
	gun: Config.GunName,
	melee: Config.MeleeName,
	mag: number,
	reserve: number,
	grenades: number,
	reloadToken: number, -- bumps on every reload start/cancel so stale timers do nothing
	reloading: boolean,
	fireAllowance: number,
	allowanceAt: number,
	nextMelee: number,
	nextGrenade: number,
	ammoBoxReadyAt: number,
	lastSync: number,
	syncQueued: boolean,
}

local states: { [Player]: PlayerState } = {}
local lastDebug: { [Player]: number } = {}
-- Last shot sequence number seen per player. Lives outside PlayerState so it survives
-- respawns: the client's counter never resets.
local shotSeqs: { [Player]: number } = {}
local syncRemote: RemoteEvent
local shotFxRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent
local characterFxRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent
local grenadeFolder: Folder

local function classOf(player: Player): Config.ClassStats
	local id = player:GetAttribute("Class")
	return Config.CLASSES[id :: Types.ClassId] or Config.CLASSES[Config.DEFAULT_CLASS]
end

local function reserveFor(player: Player, gun: Config.GunName): number
	return math.floor(Config.GUNS[gun].reserveMax * classOf(player).reserveBonus)
end

local function newState(player: Player): PlayerState
	local class = classOf(player)
	local gun = class.startGun
	return {
		gun = gun,
		melee = Config.LOADOUT.melee,
		mag = Config.GUNS[gun].magSize,
		reserve = reserveFor(player, gun),
		grenades = class.grenades,
		reloadToken = 0,
		reloading = false,
		fireAllowance = FIRE_BURST,
		allowanceAt = os.clock(),
		nextMelee = 0,
		nextGrenade = 0,
		ammoBoxReadyAt = 0,
		lastSync = 0,
		syncQueued = false,
	}
end

local function sendSync(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local payload: Types.WeaponState = {
		gun = state.gun,
		melee = state.melee,
		mag = state.mag,
		reserve = state.reserve,
		grenades = state.grenades,
		reloading = state.reloading,
		shotSeq = shotSeqs[player] or 0,
	}
	state.lastSync = os.clock()
	syncRemote:FireClient(player, payload)
end

-- Throttled sync for rejection paths, so a misbehaving client can't make us spam it.
local function queueSync(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or state.syncQueued then
		return
	end
	local wait = SYNC_MIN_INTERVAL - (os.clock() - state.lastSync)
	if wait <= 0 then
		sendSync(player)
		return
	end
	state.syncQueued = true
	task.delay(wait, function()
		if states[player] == state then
			state.syncQueued = false
			sendSync(player)
		end
	end)
end

-- Rate-limited diagnostics (Config.DEBUG.combatLog), at most a few lines per second per player.
local function debugLog(player: Player, message: string)
	if not Config.DEBUG.combatLog then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastDebug[player] or 0) < 0.25 then
		return
	end
	lastDebug[player] = now
	print(string.format("[Combat] %s: %s", player.Name, message))
end

local function aliveCharacter(player: Player): (Humanoid?, BasePart?, BasePart?)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if
		humanoid
		and humanoid.Health > 0
		and root
		and root:IsA("BasePart")
		and head
		and head:IsA("BasePart")
	then
		return humanoid, root, head
	end
	return nil, nil, nil
end

local function onKill(_zombie: HordeService.Zombie, attacker: Player?)
	if not attacker or not attacker.Parent then
		return
	end
	local leaderstats = attacker:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local kills = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Abates")
	if kills and kills:IsA("IntValue") then
		kills.Value += 1
	end
end

-- Guns -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Bulls and the Brute take extra damage from behind (their weak spot).
local function backMultiplier(zombie: HordeService.Zombie, from: Vector3): number
	local multiplier = Config.ZOMBIES[zombie.kindName].backMultiplier
	if multiplier == 1 then
		return 1
	end
	local toAttacker = Vector3.new(from.X - zombie.position.X, 0, from.Z - zombie.position.Z)
	if toAttacker.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		return 1
	end
	local forward = Vector3.new(-math.sin(zombie.yaw), 0, -math.cos(zombie.yaw))
	return if forward:Dot(toAttacker.Unit) < -0.35 then multiplier else 1
end

local function takeFireAllowance(state: PlayerState, fireRate: number): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	state.fireAllowance =
		math.min(FIRE_BURST, state.fireAllowance + (now - state.allowanceAt) * fireRate)
	state.allowanceAt = now
	if state.fireAllowance < 1 then
		return false
	end
	state.fireAllowance -= 1
	return true
end

local function onFire(player: Player, shotSeq: unknown, hits: unknown)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or typeof(shotSeq) ~= "number" or typeof(hits) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	-- Sequence numbers only move forward; an old or repeated one is a replay.
	local seq = shotSeq :: number
	if seq ~= math.floor(seq) or seq <= (shotSeqs[player] or 0) then
		return
	end
	shotSeqs[player] = seq

	local gun = Config.GUNS[state.gun]
	local _, root, head = aliveCharacter(player)
	if not root or not head or state.reloading or state.mag < 1 then
		debugLog(
			player,
			string.format(
				"tiro recusado (vivo=%s recarregando=%s pente=%d)",
				tostring(root ~= nil),
				tostring(state.reloading),
				state.mag
			)
		)
		queueSync(player)
		return
	end
	if not takeFireAllowance(state, gun.fireRate) then
		debugLog(player, "tiro recusado: cadência acima do limite")
		queueSync(player)
		return
	end
	if not Config.DEBUG.infiniteAmmo then
		state.mag -= 1
	end
	HordeService.noise(root.Position, gun.noise, 2.5, player)
	shotFxRemote:FireAllClients(player, state.gun)
	characterFxRemote:FireAllClients(player, "shot", state.gun)

	local hitList = hits :: { unknown }
	local eye = head.Position
	-- Gunslinger ability: hits set zombies burning (reuses the bleed damage-over-time).
	local ability = classOf(player).ability
	local incendiaryUntil = player:GetAttribute("IncendiaryUntil")
	local incendiary = typeof(incendiaryUntil) == "number"
		and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < incendiaryUntil
		and ability.burnDps > 0
	local visible: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(#hitList, gun.pellets) do
		local hit = hitList[i]
		if typeof(hit) == "table" then
			local entry = hit :: { [string]: unknown }
			local id, isHead = entry.id, entry.head
			if typeof(id) == "number" and typeof(isHead) == "boolean" then
				local zombie = HordeService.get(id)
				if zombie then
					local scale = Config.ZOMBIES[zombie.kindName].scale
					local distance = (zombie.position - root.Position).Magnitude
					local inRange = distance <= gun.range + RANGE_SLACK
					if inRange and visible[id] == nil then
						visible[id] = Hitscan.canSeeZombie(eye, zombie.position, scale)
					end
					if inRange and visible[id] then
						local damage = gun.damage
							* (if isHead then gun.headMultiplier else 1)
							* backMultiplier(zombie, eye)
							* (classOf(player).damageBonus[state.gun] or 1)
						local killed = HordeService.damage(zombie, damage, player)
						if not killed and incendiary then
							HordeService.bleed(zombie, ability.burnDps, ability.burnTime, player)
						end
						debugLog(
							player,
							string.format(
								"acertou zumbi %d%s: -%.0f, %s",
								id,
								if isHead then " (cabeça)" else "",
								damage,
								if killed
									then "MORTO"
									else string.format("vida %.0f", zombie.health)
							)
						)
					elseif not inRange then
						debugLog(
							player,
							string.format("acerto recusado: fora de alcance (%.0f studs)", distance)
						)
					else
						debugLog(player, "acerto recusado: parede entre jogador e zumbi")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function finishReload(player: Player, state: PlayerState, token: number)
	if states[player] ~= state or state.reloadToken ~= token then
		return
	end
	local gun = Config.GUNS[state.gun]
	local amount = math.min(gun.magSize - state.mag, state.reserve)
	state.mag += amount
	state.reserve -= amount
	state.reloading = false
	sendSync(player)
end

local function onReload(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local gun = Config.GUNS[state.gun]
	local humanoid = aliveCharacter(player)
	if not humanoid or state.reloading or state.mag >= gun.magSize or state.reserve <= 0 then
		queueSync(player)
		return
	end
	state.reloading = true
	characterFxRemote:FireAllClients(player, "reload", state.gun)
	state.reloadToken += 1
	local token = state.reloadToken
	sendSync(player)
	task.delay(gun.reloadTime, finishReload, player, state, token)
end

-- Melee ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function onMelee(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local melee = Config.MELEE[state.melee]
	local now = os.clock()
	local _, root = aliveCharacter(player)
	-- Small tolerance so client-timed swings aren't dropped by jitter.
	if not root or now < state.nextMelee - 0.1 then
		return
	end
	state.nextMelee = now + melee.cooldown
	characterFxRemote:FireAllClients(player, "melee", state.gun)

	local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local forward = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z).Unit
	local cosArc = math.cos(math.rad(melee.arc / 2 + MELEE_ARC_SLACK))
	local reach = melee.range + MELEE_RANGE_SLACK
	local origin = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)

	local candidates: { { zombie: HordeService.Zombie, dist: number } } = {}
	for _, zombie in HordeService.getZombies() do
		if not zombie.dead then
			local offset = zombie.position - origin
			local dist = offset.Magnitude
			if dist <= reach and (dist < 1.5 or forward:Dot(offset / dist) >= cosArc) then
				table.insert(candidates, { zombie = zombie, dist = dist })
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		return a.dist < b.dist
	end)
	for i = 1, math.min(#candidates, melee.maxTargets) do
		local zombie = candidates[i].zombie
		local damage = melee.damage * backMultiplier(zombie, root.Position)
		if not HordeService.damage(zombie, damage, player) then
			HordeService.bleed(zombie, melee.bleedDps, melee.bleedTime, player)
		end
	end
end

-- Grenades ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Zombie body for grenade contact, per unit of kind scale: the body cylinder plus the
-- grenade's own radius.
local GRENADE_HIT_RADIUS = 1.4
local GRENADE_HIT_TOP = 5.2

local function explode(player: Player, position: Vector3)
	local g = Config.GRENADE
	HordeService.explode(position, {
		radius = g.radius,
		playerDamage = 0, -- no friendly fire
		zombieDamage = g.damage,
		barricadeDamage = 0,
		noise = g.noise,
		attacker = player,
	})
end

local function onThrowGrenade(player: Player, direction: unknown)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	local dir = direction :: Vector3
	local magnitude = dir.Magnitude
	-- Rejects NaN (fails every comparison) and non-unit vectors.
	if not (magnitude > 0.9 and magnitude < 1.1) then
		return
	end
	local g = Config.GRENADE
	local now = os.clock()
	local _, _, head = aliveCharacter(player)
	if not head or state.grenades < 1 or now < state.nextGrenade then
		queueSync(player)
		return
	end
	if not Config.DEBUG.infiniteAmmo then
		state.grenades -= 1
	end
	state.nextGrenade = now + g.cooldown
	characterFxRemote:FireAllClients(player, "throw", state.gun)

	local grenade = Instance.new("Part")
	grenade.Name = "Grenade"
	grenade.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	grenade.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
	grenade.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 72, 48)
	grenade.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	grenade.CanQuery = false
	grenade.CanTouch = false
	grenade.CFrame = CFrame.new(head.Position + dir.Unit * 2.5)
	grenade.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir.Unit * g.throwSpeed + Vector3.new(0, g.throwLift, 0)
	grenade.Parent = grenadeFolder
	grenade:SetNetworkOwner(nil) -- server simulates it, so the client can't steer the blast

	-- Once it has (roughly) landed it starts pulling Runners in: the decoy.
	task.delay(0.4, function()
		if grenade.Parent then
			HordeService.noise(grenade.Position, g.noise, g.fuse, nil)
		end
	end)
	-- Blows on whichever comes first: touching a zombie (zombies are data, not parts, so a
	-- per-frame check against their bodies stands in for Touched) or the fuse running out.
	local done = false
	local watch: RBXScriptConnection
	local function detonate()
		if done then
			return
		end
		done = true
		watch:Disconnect()
		local position = grenade.Position
		grenade:Destroy()
		explode(player, position)
	end
	watch = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not grenade.Parent then
			detonate()
			return
		end
		local at = grenade.Position
		for _, zombie in HordeService.getZombies() do
			local scale = Config.ZOMBIES[zombie.kindName].scale
			local feet = zombie.position
			local height = at.Y - feet.Y
			local flat = Vector2.new(at.X - feet.X, at.Z - feet.Z).Magnitude
			if
				not zombie.dead
				and height >= 0
				and height <= GRENADE_HIT_TOP * scale
				and flat <= GRENADE_HIT_RADIUS * scale
			then
				detonate()
				return
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(g.fuse, detonate)
end

-- Ammo box ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function onAmmoBox(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	local now = os.clock()
	if not state or now < state.ammoBoxReadyAt then
		return
	end
	state.ammoBoxReadyAt = now + Config.AMMO_BOX_COOLDOWN
	state.reserve = reserveFor(player, state.gun)
	state.grenades = classOf(player).grenades
	sendSync(player)
end

local function watchAmmoBox(box: Instance)
	local prompt = box:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	if prompt then
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(onAmmoBox)
	end
end

-- Puts the current gun's low-poly model (Art/WeaponModels) in the right hand, replacing
-- the previous one. Other players see it; the client also uses its Muzzle for tracers.
local function attachWeapon(character: Model, gun: string)
	local hand = character:WaitForChild("RightHand", 5) or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	if not hand or not hand:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local owner = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local skin = if owner and owner:GetAttribute("SurvivorPack") == true then "gold" else nil
	local model = WeaponModels.build(gun, skin)
	if not model then
		return
	end
	model.Name = "Gun"
	-- Barrel along the hand's -Y (down the forearm) and the gun's top facing the back of the
	-- hand, matching the aiming pose the client puts the arms in (PoseController).
	model:PivotTo(hand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
	for _, piece in model:GetChildren() do
		if piece:IsA("BasePart") then
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = hand
			weld.Part1 = piece
			weld.Parent = piece
		end
	end
	model.Parent = character
end

-- Shop API ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Swaps the gun for `gun` with a full magazine and reserve. False if already equipped.
function CombatService.equipGun(player: Player, gun: Config.GunName): boolean
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or state.gun == gun then
		return false
	end
	state.gun = gun
	state.mag = Config.GUNS[gun].magSize
	state.reserve = reserveFor(player, gun)
	state.reloading = false
	state.reloadToken += 1 -- cancels a reload in progress on the old gun
	if player.Character then
		attachWeapon(player.Character, gun)
	end
	sendSync(player)
	return true
end

function CombatService.equipMelee(player: Player, melee: Config.MeleeName): boolean
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or state.melee == melee then
		return false
	end
	state.melee = melee
	sendSync(player)
	return true
end

function CombatService.addGrenade(player: Player): boolean
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or state.grenades >= classOf(player).grenades then
		return false
	end
	state.grenades += 1
	sendSync(player)
	return true
end

-- Players ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Greybox gun so other players can see who is armed; replaced by real models in the art pass.

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local kills = Instance.new("IntValue")
	kills.Name = "Abates"
	kills.Parent = leaderstats
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local function onCharacter(character: Model)
		states[player] = newState(player)
		if Config.DEBUG.godMode then
			-- Humanoid:TakeDamage (every zombie and explosion hit) is ignored under a ForceField.
			local shield = Instance.new("ForceField")
			shield.Name = "DebugGodMode"
			shield.Visible = false
			shield.Parent = character
		end
		sendSync(player)
		-- The avatar's body parts are swapped when its appearance finishes loading, which would
		-- drop a gun welded to the old hand; attach it only after that.
		task.spawn(function()
			if not player:HasAppearanceLoaded() then
				player.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Wait()
			end
			local state = states[player]
			if state and player.Character == character then
				attachWeapon(character, state.gun)
			end
		end)
	end
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	-- Buying the Survivor Pack mid-match repaints the gun right away.
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SurvivorPack"):Connect(function()
		local state = states[player]
		if state and player.Character then
			attachWeapon(player.Character, state.gun)
		end
	end)
	-- Picking a class re-issues the loadout (only allowed during Prep, see ClassService).
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Class"):Connect(function()
		if states[player] and aliveCharacter(player) then
			local state = newState(player)
			states[player] = state
			if player.Character then
				attachWeapon(player.Character, state.gun)
			end
			sendSync(player)
		end
	end)
end

function CombatService.init()
	syncRemote = Net.weaponSync()
	shotFxRemote = Net.shotFx()
	characterFxRemote = Net.characterFx()
	grenadeFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	grenadeFolder.Name = "Grenades"
	grenadeFolder.Parent = workspace
end

function CombatService.start()
	Net.fireWeapon().OnServerEvent:Connect(onFire)
	Net.reload().OnServerEvent:Connect(onReload)
	Net.melee().OnServerEvent:Connect(onMelee)
	Net.throwGrenade().OnServerEvent:Connect(onThrowGrenade)
	syncRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(queueSync)
	-- Aim pitch for everyone's poses: a finite number in range, copied to the character.
	local lastPitch: { [Player]: number } = {}
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastPitch[player] = nil
	end)
	Net.aimPitch().OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, pitch: unknown)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastPitch[player] or 0) < 0.08 then
			return -- the client sends ~8/s at most; ignore floods
		end
		lastPitch[player] = now
		local character = player.Character
		if character and typeof(pitch) == "number" and pitch == pitch then
			character:SetAttribute("AimPitch", math.clamp(pitch :: number, -1.1, 1.1))
		end
	end)

	HordeService.killed:connect(onKill)

	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Tags.AmmoBox):Connect(watchAmmoBox)
	for _, box in CollectionService:GetTagged(Tags.AmmoBox) do
		watchAmmoBox(box)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		states[player] = nil
		shotSeqs[player] = nil
		lastDebug[player] = nil
	end)
end

return CombatService

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Econo.source:
--!strict
-- In-match credits: earned per kill (Config.REWARDS, turret kills go to its owner), spent at
-- the barn shop, reset every match. Shown in the leaderboard as "Créditos".

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local HordeService = require(script.Parent.HordeService)

local EconomyService = {}

local function startCredits(): number
	return if Config.DEBUG.richStart then 5000 else Config.START_CREDITS
end

local function creditsValue(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local value = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Créditos")
	return if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then value else nil
end

function EconomyService.get(player: Player): number
	local value = creditsValue(player)
	return if value then value.Value else 0
end

function EconomyService.add(player: Player, amount: number)
	local value = creditsValue(player)
	if value then
		value.Value += amount
	end
end

-- Takes `amount` if the player can afford it.
function EconomyService.spend(player: Player, amount: number): boolean
	local value = creditsValue(player)
	if not value or value.Value < amount then
		return false
	end
	value.Value -= amount
	return true
end

function EconomyService.resetAll()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local value = creditsValue(player)
		if value then
			value.Value = startCredits()
		end
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	-- CombatService creates leaderstats; credits are added next to the kill count.
	local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 10)
	if not leaderstats or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Créditos") then
		return
	end
	local credits = Instance.new("IntValue")
	credits.Name = "Créditos"
	credits.Value = startCredits()
	credits.Parent = leaderstats
end

function EconomyService.start()
	HordeService.killed:connect(function(zombie, attacker)
		if attacker and attacker.Parent then
			EconomyService.add(attacker, Config.REWARDS[zombie.kindName] or 0)
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
end

return EconomyService

ServerScriptService.Server.Systems.Horde.source:
--!strict
-- Authoritative horde simulation. Zombies are plain data (no Humanoids, no parts on the
-- server): positions advance at SIM_HZ following the shared FlowField, with cheap separation
-- through a spatial hash. Clients receive compact snapshots at REPLICATION_HZ and draw them.
--
-- Kinds (docs/DEFINICOES.md §4): Runners hear noise and build pyramids; Bulls telegraph and
-- charge; Creepers light a fuse next to players or barricades and explode (also when shot);
-- the Brute punches and throws rocks. Spawning is driven by MatchService.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Hitscan = require(Shared.Hitscan)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Tags = require(Shared.Tags)
local Types = require(Shared.Types)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local ZombiePacket = require(Shared.ZombiePacket)
