--!strict
-- Roblox Swarm: Outbreak client entry point. Two-phase bootstrap: init() all, then start() all.

local Folder = script:FindFirstChild("Controllers")

local loaded: { [string]: any } = {}
if Folder then
	for _, child in Folder:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			loaded[child.Name] = require(child) :: any
		end
	end
end

for _, mod in loaded do
	if typeof(mod.init) == "function" then
		mod.init()
	end
end

for _, mod in loaded do
	if typeof(mod.start) == "function" then
		task.spawn(mod.start)
	end
end

print("[Swarm] client started")

ServerScriptService.Server.Horde.Piles.source:
--!strict
-- Zombie pyramids. Zombies that reach a ClimbZone (the corral chain-link fence, the silo)
-- from outside stack into a pile against it, perLayer zombies per layer. Once the pile plus a
-- zombie's reach is as tall as the zone's ClimbHeight, newcomers run up the pile, over the
-- top and drop down on the far side. Like the rest of the horde this is pure server data:
-- the positions written here replicate with everything else.

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local ZombiePacket = require(Shared.ZombiePacket)
local FlowField = require(script.Parent.FlowField)

local Piles = {}

local PILE = Config.PILE
local CELL = Config.HORDE.CELL_SIZE
local GRID = 4 -- cells per pile along a wall, so a long wall gets several separate piles
local LANDING_RADIUS = 4
local UP = Vector3.yAxis

-- The fields of a horde zombie this module reads and writes.
export type Member = { position: Vector3, yaw: number, state: number }

type Pile = {
	anchor: Vector3, -- ground point on the zone's outer face
	outward: Vector3, -- flat unit vector from the zone toward the approach side
	lateral: Vector3,
	climbHeight: number,
	landing: Vector3?,
	members: { Member },
	lastActivity: number, -- last join or climb
	lastJoin: number,
	nextRelease: number,
}

type Joined = { pile: Pile, from: Vector3, joinedAt: number }
type Climb = { points: { Vector3 }, startedAt: number, yaws: { number } }

local piles: { [BasePart]: { [number]: Pile } } = {}
local joined: { [Member]: Joined } = {}
local climbing: { [Member]: Climb } = {}

local function yawFacing(direction: Vector3): number
	return math.atan2(-direction.X, -direction.Z)
end

local function layersOf(pile: Pile): number
	return math.ceil(#pile.members / PILE.perLayer)
end

local function climbable(pile: Pile): boolean
	return pile.landing ~= nil
		and layersOf(pile) * PILE.layerHeight + PILE.reach >= pile.climbHeight
end

-- Is the approaching zombie on the fort side of the zone? (Zones carry an `Inside` point.)
local function fromInside(zone: BasePart, from: Vector3): boolean
	local inside = zone:GetAttribute("Inside")
	if typeof(inside) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false
	end
	local center = Vector3.new(zone.Position.X, 0, zone.Position.Z)
	local toInside = Vector3.new(inside.X, 0, inside.Z) - center
	return (from - center):Dot(toInside) > 0
end

-- Nearest open cell on the far side of the zone, where climbers land.
local function findLanding(anchor: Vector3, outward: Vector3, bx: number, bz: number): Vector3?
	local best: Vector3? = nil
	local bestDist = math.huge
	for dx = -LANDING_RADIUS, LANDING_RADIUS do
		for dz = -LANDING_RADIUS, LANDING_RADIUS do
			local cx, cz = bx + dx, bz + dz
			if FlowField.kind(cx, cz) == FlowField.FREE then
				local center = FlowField.cellCenter(cx, cz)
				local offset = center - anchor
				if offset:Dot(outward) < -1.5 and offset.Magnitude < bestDist then
					best, bestDist = center, offset.Magnitude
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function newPile(
	zone: BasePart,
	outward: Vector3,
	bx: number,
	bz: number,
	from: Vector3
): Pile
	-- Find the zone's actual surface by casting from the approach cell back toward it.
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zone }
	local origin = Vector3.new(from.X, 2, from.Z)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, -outward * CELL * 3, params)
	local anchor = if hit
		then Vector3.new(hit.Position.X, 0, hit.Position.Z)
		else FlowField.cellCenter(bx, bz) + outward * CELL / 2

	local height = zone:GetAttribute("ClimbHeight")
	return {
		anchor = anchor,
		outward = outward,
		lateral = Vector3.new(-outward.Z, 0, outward.X),
		climbHeight = if typeof(height) == "number" then height else zone.Size.Y,
		landing = findLanding(anchor, outward, bx, bz),
		members = {},
		lastActivity = os.clock(),
		lastJoin = os.clock(),
		nextRelease = 0,
	}
end

local function startClimb(z: Member, pile: Pile, now: number)
	local top = pile.anchor + pile.outward * 0.9 + UP * (layersOf(pile) * PILE.layerHeight + 0.3)
	local over = pile.anchor - pile.outward * 0.4 + UP * (pile.climbHeight + 0.4)
	local landing = pile.landing :: Vector3
	local inward = yawFacing(-pile.outward)
	climbing[z] = {
		points = { z.position, top, over, landing },
		yaws = { inward, inward, yawFacing(landing - over) },
		startedAt = now,
	}
	z.state = ZombiePacket.STATE_CLIMB
	pile.lastActivity = now
end

function Piles.isBusy(z: Member): boolean
	return joined[z] ~= nil or climbing[z] ~= nil
end

-- Called when a walking zombie's next cell is part of `zone`. Returns true if the zombie is
-- now piling or climbing (the caller stops moving it); false means "hold here".
function Piles.handleBreach(
	z: Member,
	zone: BasePart,
	bx: number,
	bz: number,
	fx: number,
	fz: number,
	now: number
): boolean
	if Piles.isBusy(z) then
		return true
	end
	local from = FlowField.cellCenter(fx, fz)
	if fromInside(zone, from) then
		return false
	end

	local dx, dz = fx - bx, fz - bz
	local outward: Vector3, dirCode: number
	if math.abs(dx) >= math.abs(dz) then
		outward, dirCode = Vector3.new(math.sign(dx), 0, 0), if dx > 0 then 0 else 1
	else
		outward, dirCode = Vector3.new(0, 0, math.sign(dz)), if dz > 0 then 2 else 3
	end
	local key = ((bx // GRID) * 1000 + (bz // GRID)) * 4 + dirCode

	local byKey = piles[zone]
	if not byKey then
		byKey = {}
		piles[zone] = byKey
	end
	local pile = byKey[key]
	if not pile then
		pile = newPile(zone, outward, bx, bz, from)
		byKey[key] = pile
	end

	if climbable(pile) then
		startClimb(z, pile, now)
		return true
	end
	if pile.landing == nil then
		-- Nowhere to land: cap the pile at the height that would have been enough.
		local maxLayers = math.ceil((pile.climbHeight - PILE.reach) / PILE.layerHeight)
		if layersOf(pile) >= maxLayers then
			return false
		end
	end

	table.insert(pile.members, z)
	joined[z] = { pile = pile, from = z.position, joinedAt = now }
	z.state = ZombiePacket.STATE_PILE
	pile.lastActivity = now
	pile.lastJoin = now
	return true
end

function Piles.forget(z: Member)
	local j = joined[z]
	if j then
		local index = table.find(j.pile.members, z)
		if index then
			-- table.remove keeps order, so everyone above settles one slot down.
			table.remove(j.pile.members, index)
		end
		joined[z] = nil
	end
	climbing[z] = nil
end

local function disband(pile: Pile)
	for _, m in pile.members do
		joined[m] = nil
		m.position = Vector3.new(m.position.X, 0, m.position.Z)
		m.state = ZombiePacket.STATE_IDLE
	end
	table.clear(pile.members)
end

local function layoutPile(pile: Pile, now: number)
	local count = #pile.members
	local topLayer = (count - 1) // PILE.perLayer
	local yaw = yawFacing(-pile.outward)
	for i, m in pile.members do
		local layer = (i - 1) // PILE.perLayer
		local column = (i - 1) % PILE.perLayer - (PILE.perLayer - 1) / 2
		-- Lower layers sit further out, so the pile reads as a ramp up the wall.
		local slot = pile.anchor
			+ pile.outward * (0.9 + (topLayer - layer) * 0.8)
			+ pile.lateral * (column * 1.5 + (layer % 2) * 0.6)
			+ UP * (layer * PILE.layerHeight)
		local j = joined[m]
		local alpha = if j then math.min(1, (now - j.joinedAt) / PILE.joinTime) else 1
		m.position = if j then j.from:Lerp(slot, alpha) else slot
		m.yaw = yaw
		m.state = ZombiePacket.STATE_PILE
	end
end

local function stepClimb(z: Member, c: Climb, now: number): boolean
	local elapsed = now - c.startedAt
	for i, duration in PILE.climbTimes do
		if elapsed < duration then
			z.position = c.points[i]:Lerp(c.points[i + 1], elapsed / duration)
			z.yaw = c.yaws[i]
			return false
		end
		elapsed -= duration
	end
	z.position = c.points[#c.points]
	z.yaw = c.yaws[#c.yaws]
	z.state = ZombiePacket.STATE_WALK
	return true
end

-- Positions every piled and climbing zombie. Call once per simulation step.
function Piles.step(now: number)
	for _, byKey in piles do
		for key, pile in byKey do
			if #pile.members > 0 and pile.landing then
				-- The pile flows over the top: once it's tall enough, or once nobody new has
				-- joined for a while (the end of a wave), the top zombie climbs every
				-- releaseInterval. Without this the zombies forming the pile never leave and a
				-- wave can't finish.
				local stalled = now - pile.lastJoin > PILE.stallTime
				if (climbable(pile) or stalled) and now >= pile.nextRelease then
					pile.nextRelease = now + PILE.releaseInterval
					local top = table.remove(pile.members) :: Member
					joined[top] = nil
					startClimb(top, pile, now)
				end
			elseif #pile.members > 0 and now - pile.lastActivity > PILE.disbandAfter then
				disband(pile) -- nowhere to land: it can never get over
			end
			if #pile.members == 0 and now - pile.lastActivity > PILE.disbandAfter then
				byKey[key] = nil
			else
				layoutPile(pile, now)
			end
		end
	end
	for z, c in climbing do
		if stepClimb(z, c, now) then
			climbing[z] = nil
		end
	end
end

return Piles

StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Clien.source:
--!strict
-- Local-only combat feedback: blood, tracers, muzzle flashes, the melee swipe, explosion
-- fireballs and camera shake. Pooled emitters serve every burst, so heavy fights don't create
-- instances. `Effects.quality` drops to 0.5 when the frame rate sags (§2 Gráficos Dinâmicos):
-- fewer particles and no flash lights.

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Effects = {}

Effects.quality = 1

local COLOR_BLOOD = Color3.fromRGB(70, 8, 8)
local COLOR_TRACER = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 140)

local folder: Folder? = nil
local bloodAttachment: Attachment? = nil
local bloodEmitter: ParticleEmitter? = nil
local smokeAttachment: Attachment? = nil
local smokeEmitter: ParticleEmitter? = nil
local trauma = 0 -- camera shake, 0..1

local function container(): Folder
	if folder then
		return folder
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = "EffectsClient"
	f.Parent = workspace
	folder = f
	return f
end

local function emitter(): (Attachment, ParticleEmitter)
	if bloodAttachment and bloodEmitter then
		return bloodAttachment, bloodEmitter
	end
	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Name = "BloodAnchor"
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.CanQuery = false
	anchor.CanTouch = false
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.Size = Vector3.one
	anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	anchor.Parent = container()

	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = anchor

	local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	pe.Enabled = false
	pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(COLOR_BLOOD)
	pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.6)
	pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 14)
	pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -60, 0)
	pe.Drag = 2
	pe.LightInfluence = 1
	pe.Parent = attachment

	bloodAttachment, bloodEmitter = attachment, pe
	return attachment, pe
end

function Effects.blood(position: Vector3, amount: number)
	local attachment, pe = emitter()
	attachment.WorldPosition = position
	pe:Emit(math.max(1, math.round(amount * Effects.quality)))
end

local function smoke(): (Attachment, ParticleEmitter)
	if smokeAttachment and smokeEmitter then
		return smokeAttachment, smokeEmitter
	end
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	pe.Enabled = false
	pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(70, 64, 60))
	pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 7),
	})
	pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2)
	pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 12)
	pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
	pe.Drag = 1.5
	pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40)
	pe.Parent = attachment
	smokeAttachment, smokeEmitter = attachment, pe
	return attachment, pe
end

-- Short-lived neon flash at the muzzle; a light too unless quality is reduced.
function Effects.muzzleFlash(position: Vector3, direction: Vector3)
	local flash = Instance.new("Part")
	flash.Anchored = true
	flash.CanCollide = false
	flash.CanQuery = false
	flash.CanTouch = false
	flash.CastShadow = false
	flash.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	flash.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90)
	flash.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.9)
	flash.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position + direction * 0.4, position + direction)
	if Effects.quality >= 1 then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = flash.Color
		light.Range = 10
		light.Brightness = 3
		light.Parent = flash
	end
	flash.Parent = container()
	Debris:AddItem(flash, 0.05)
end

-- Fireball that swells and fades, a burst of smoke, and shake that falls off with distance.
function Effects.explosion(position: Vector3, radius: number)
	local ball = Instance.new("Part")
	ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	ball.Anchored = true
	ball.CanCollide = false
	ball.CanQuery = false
	ball.CanTouch = false
	ball.CastShadow = false
	ball.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 30)
	ball.Size = Vector3.one * 2
	ball.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
	ball.Parent = container()
	local grow = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(ball, grow, {
		Size = Vector3.one * radius * 1.2,
		Transparency = 1,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 10),
	}):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(ball, 0.4)

	local attachment, pe = smoke()
	attachment.WorldPosition = position
	pe:Emit(math.max(4, math.round(18 * Effects.quality)))

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local distance = (camera.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
	Effects.shake(math.clamp(1 - distance / (radius * 6), 0, 1) * 0.9)
end

-- Adds camera shake (0..1); it decays on its own.
function Effects.shake(amount: number)
	trauma = math.min(1, trauma + amount)
end

local function applyShake(dt: number)
	if trauma <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local strength = trauma * trauma
	local t = os.clock() * 25
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	camera.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(
		math.rad(math.noise(t, 1) * 4 * strength),
		math.rad(math.noise(t, 2) * 4 * strength),
		math.rad(math.noise(t, 3) * 3 * strength)
	)
	trauma = math.max(0, trauma - dt * 1.6)
end

-- Starts camera shake and the frame-rate watch that drives `quality`. Call once.
function Effects.start()
	-- After the default camera has positioned itself this frame.
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("SwarmShake", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, applyShake)

	local frames, elapsed = 0, 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		frames += 1
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed >= 2 then
			local fps = frames / elapsed
			-- Hysteresis so it doesn't flip every sample around the threshold.
			if fps < 40 then
				Effects.quality = 0.5
			elseif fps > 50 then
				Effects.quality = 1
			end
			frames, elapsed = 0, 0
		end
	end)
end

function Effects.tracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color3?)
	local offset = to - from
	local length = offset.Magnitude
	if length < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local beam = Instance.new("Part")
	beam.Anchored = true
	beam.CanCollide = false
	beam.CanQuery = false
	beam.CanTouch = false
	beam.CastShadow = false
	beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	beam.Color = color or COLOR_TRACER
	beam.Transparency = 0.3
	beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, length)
	beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from + offset / 2, to)
	beam.Parent = container()
	Debris:AddItem(beam, 0.05)
end

-- Flat arc flash in front of the player for a melee swing.
function Effects.swipe(root: CFrame, range: number)
	local slab = Instance.new("Part")
	slab.Anchored = true
	slab.CanCollide = false
	slab.CanQuery = false
	slab.CanTouch = false
	slab.CastShadow = false
	slab.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	slab.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	slab.Transparency = 0.7
	slab.Size = Vector3.new(range * 1.2, 0.1, range * 0.6)
	slab.CFrame = root * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -range * 0.5)
	slab.Parent = container()
	Debris:AddItem(slab, 0.08)
end

return Effects

--!strict
-- Single source of truth for player actions. Keyboard/mouse, gamepad and the touch HUD all
-- feed setAction(); gameplay code only reads isDown() / actionChanged and never cares which
-- device produced the input.

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Signal = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util.Signal)

export type Action = "Fire" | "Aim" | "Reload" | "Ability" | "Interact" | "Grenade" | "Melee" | "Jump"

local InputController = {}

InputController.actionChanged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Action, boolean>

-- Auto-fire (fire when the crosshair is over a zombie) defaults on for touch; the targeting
-- check itself lands with the weapon system in week 4.
InputController.autoFire = false

local down: { [Action]: boolean } = {}
local modals: { [string]: boolean } = {}

local KEY_BINDINGS: { [Enum.KeyCode | Enum.UserInputType]: Action } = {
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = "Fire",
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = "Aim",
	[Enum.KeyCode.R] = "Reload",
	[Enum.KeyCode.Q] = "Ability",
	[Enum.KeyCode.E] = "Interact",
	[Enum.KeyCode.G] = "Grenade",
	[Enum.KeyCode.V] = "Melee",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2] = "Fire",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2] = "Aim",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX] = "Reload",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY] = "Ability",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB] = "Melee",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1] = "Grenade",
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp] = "Interact",
}

-- Menus (shop, class picker) register while open: the mouse is freed and weapons hold fire.
function InputController.setModal(name: string, open: boolean)
	modals[name] = if open then true else nil
	if open then
		for action in down do
			InputController.setAction(action, false)
		end
	end
end

function InputController.isModalOpen(): boolean
	return next(modals) ~= nil
end

function InputController.isDown(action: Action): boolean
	return down[action] == true
end

function InputController.setAction(action: Action, isDown: boolean)
	if (down[action] == true) == isDown then
		return
	end
	down[action] = isDown
	InputController.actionChanged:fire(action, isDown)
end

local function bindingFor(input: InputObject): Action?
	return KEY_BINDINGS[input.KeyCode] or KEY_BINDINGS[input.UserInputType]
end

function InputController.init()
	InputController.autoFire = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
		and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
end

function InputController.start()
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed or InputController.isModalOpen() then
			return
		end
		local action = bindingFor(input)
		if action then
			InputController.setAction(action, true)
		end
	end)

	-- Releases are never filtered by `processed`, otherwise an action could stay stuck down.
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local action = bindingFor(input)
		if action then
			InputController.setAction(action, false)
		end
	end)

	-- Losing focus (alt-tab, app backgrounded on mobile) releases everything.
	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
		for action in down do
			InputController.setAction(action, false)
		end
	end)
end

return InputController

local function clock(seconds: number): string
	local m = math.ceil(seconds / 60)
	return if m >= 60 then string.format("%dh%02d", m // 60, m % 60) else `{m} min`
end

-- Level and VIP are for the lobby, the camp and the breaks between waves; in combat they're
-- clutter next to health and ammo. Without a Match (the hub) they always show.
local function outOfCombat(): boolean
	local match = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Match")
	local phase = match and match:GetAttribute("Phase")
	return phase ~= "Wave" and phase ~= "Final" and phase ~= "Extract"
end

local function update()
	local calm = outOfCombat()
	badge.Visible = calm
	vipButton.Visible = calm
	if not calm and vipPanel.Visible then
		setVipOpen(false)
	end
	local level = number("Level", 1)
	local progress = number("LevelXP", 0)
	local needed = math.max(1, number("LevelXPNeeded", 100))
	levelLabel.Text = `NÍVEL {level}   {math.floor(progress)} / {needed} XP`
	xpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(progress / needed, 0, 1), 1)

	-- BoostUntil is os.time() on the server; server time on the client is the same clock.
	local boostLeft = number("BoostUntil", 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	boostLabel.Visible = calm and boostLeft > 0
	if boostLeft > 0 then
		boostLabel.Text = "2x XP — " .. clock(boostLeft)
	end

	local owned = player:GetAttribute("SurvivorPack") == true
	packButton.Text = if M.survivorPackId == 0
		then "EM BREVE"
		elseif owned then "ATIVO"
		else "COMPRAR"
	packButton.AutoButtonColor = M.survivorPackId ~= 0 and not owned
	boostButton.Text = if M.xpBoostProductId == 0 then "EM BREVE" else "COMPRAR"
	boostButton.AutoButtonColor = M.xpBoostProductId ~= 0
end

-- The picker opens in the lobby (pick or confirm a class before PRONTO) and can be reopened
-- there or, for players in the match, during any Prep.
local function canPick(phase: unknown): boolean
	return phase == "Lobby" or (phase == "Prep" and player:GetAttribute("InMatch") == true)
end

local function onPhaseChanged(match: Instance)
	local phase = match:GetAttribute("Phase")
	reopenButton.Visible = canPick(phase)
	if phase == "Lobby" then
		setOpen(true)
	elseif picker.Visible then
		setOpen(false) -- the match started (or left Prep): CLASSE reopens it while allowed
	end
end

function ClassController.init()
	screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "ClassUI"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets
	screen.DisplayOrder = 5
	buildPicker()
end

function ClassController.start()
	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local match = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Match")
	match:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(function()
		onPhaseChanged(match)
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InMatch"):Connect(function()
		reopenButton.Visible = canPick(match:GetAttribute("Phase"))
	end)
	onPhaseChanged(match)

	InputController.actionChanged:connect(function(action, isDown)
		if action == "Ability" and isDown and not InputController.isModalOpen() then
			local readyAt = player:GetAttribute("AbilityReadyAt")
			if typeof(readyAt) == "number" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < readyAt then
				return
			end
			Net.useAbility():FireServer(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector)
		end
	end)
end

return ClassController

-- Fired on a confirmed-looking local hit; the argument is true for headshots.
WeaponController.hit = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<boolean>
-- Feedback hooks for audio and effects: a shot (gun name, muzzle position, aim direction),
-- a melee swing, a grenade throw and the start of a reload.
WeaponController.fired = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string, Vector3, Vector3>
WeaponController.swung = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<()>
WeaponController.thrown = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<()>
WeaponController.reloadStarted = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<()>

local view = WeaponController.view
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local shotSeq = 0
local nextShot = 0
local nextMelee = 0
local nextGrenade = 0
local reloadWatchdog = 0

local ASSIST_COS = math.cos(math.rad(Config.AIM_ASSIST_DEGREES))
local COLOR_INCENDIARY = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 20)
local COLOR_TURRET = Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 255)

local function incendiaryActive(): boolean
	local untilTime = player:GetAttribute("IncendiaryUntil")
	return typeof(untilTime) == "number" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < untilTime
end

type Body = { root: BasePart, head: BasePart }

local function body(): Body?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if
		humanoid
		and humanoid.Health > 0
		and root
		and root:IsA("BasePart")
		and head
		and head:IsA("BasePart")
	then
		return { root = root, head = head }
	end
	return nil
end

local function onSync(payload: unknown)
	if typeof(payload) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local state = payload :: Types.WeaponState
	local gun = state.gun :: Config.GunName
	local melee = state.melee :: Config.MeleeName
	if not Config.GUNS[gun] or not Config.MELEE[melee] then
		return
	end
	local pending = if Config.DEBUG.infiniteAmmo then 0 else math.max(0, shotSeq - state.shotSeq)
	view.gun = gun
	view.melee = melee
	view.mag = math.max(0, state.mag - pending)
	view.reserve = state.reserve
	view.grenades = state.grenades
	view.reloading = state.reloading
	view.ready = true
	WeaponController.changed:fire()
end

local function centerRay(): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local size = camera.ViewportSize
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(size.X / 2, size.Y / 2)
	return ray.Origin, ray.Direction.Unit
end

local function withSpread(direction: Vector3, degrees: number): Vector3
	if degrees <= 0 then
		return direction
	end
	local roll = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local tilt = math.rad(degrees) * math.sqrt(math.random())
	return (CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, direction) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, roll) * CFrame.Angles(
		tilt,
		0,
		0
	)).LookVector
end

-- Resolves one ray. The camera sits behind the shoulder, so distances are measured from where
-- the ray passes the player's head (`minT`); range and walls count from there.
local function cast(
	origin: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	me: Body,
	range: number,
	assist: boolean
): (Vector3, number?, boolean)
	local minT = math.max(0, (me.head.Position - origin):Dot(direction))
	local wallT = minT + Hitscan.mapDistance(origin + direction * minT, direction, range)

	local bestT, bestId, bestHead = wallT, nil :: number?, false
	ZombieRenderer.forEach(function(id, feet, scale)
		local t, isHead = Hitscan.rayZombie(origin, direction, bestT, feet, scale)
		if t and t >= minT - 2 and t < bestT then
			bestT, bestId, bestHead = t, id, isHead
		end
	end)
	if bestId or not assist then
		return origin + direction * bestT, bestId, bestHead
	end

	-- Touch aim assist: the zombie closest to the crosshair inside the cone, if visible.
	local eye = me.head.Position
	local assistCos, assistId, assistPoint = ASSIST_COS, nil :: number?, nil :: Vector3?
	ZombieRenderer.forEach(function(id, feet, scale)
		local chest = feet + Vector3.new(0, Hitscan.CHEST_HEIGHT * scale, 0)
		local toChest = chest - origin
		local along = toChest:Dot(direction)
		if along > minT and (chest - eye).Magnitude <= range then
			local cos = along / toChest.Magnitude
			if cos >= assistCos then
				assistCos, assistId, assistPoint = cos, id, chest
			end
		end
	end)
	if assistId and assistPoint and Hitscan.clearLine(eye, assistPoint) then
		return assistPoint, assistId, false
	end
	return origin + direction * wallT, nil, false
end

local function requestReload()
	local gun = Config.GUNS[view.gun]
	if not view.ready or view.reloading or view.mag >= gun.magSize or view.reserve <= 0 then
		return
	end
	view.reloading = true
	reloadWatchdog = os.clock() + gun.reloadTime + 1.5
	Net.reload():FireServer()
	WeaponController.reloadStarted:fire()
	WeaponController.changed:fire()
end

local function fire(me: Body)
	local gun = Config.GUNS[view.gun]
	local now = os.clock()
	nextShot = now + 1 / gun.fireRate
	shotSeq += 1
	if not Config.DEBUG.infiniteAmmo then
		view.mag -= 1
	end

	local aiming = InputController.isDown("Aim")
	local spread = gun.spread * (if aiming then 0.5 else 1)
	local assist = InputController.autoFire and gun.pellets == 1
	local origin, center = centerRay()
	local gunModel = me.root.Parent and me.root.Parent:FindFirstChild("Gun")
	local muzzlePart = gunModel and gunModel:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
	local muzzle = if muzzlePart and muzzlePart:IsA("BasePart")
		then muzzlePart.Position
		else me.head.Position

	local hits = {}
	local anyHit, anyHead = false, false
	local tracerColor = if incendiaryActive() then COLOR_INCENDIARY else nil
	for _ = 1, gun.pellets do
		local endPoint, id, isHead = cast(origin, withSpread(center, spread), me, gun.range, assist)
		Effects.tracer(muzzle, endPoint, tracerColor)
		if id then
			table.insert(hits, { id = id, head = isHead })
			Effects.blood(endPoint, 4)
			ZombieRenderer.flinch(id)
			anyHit = true
			anyHead = anyHead or isHead
		end
	end

	Net.fireWeapon():FireServer(shotSeq, hits)
	WeaponController.fired:fire(view.gun, muzzle, center)
	if anyHit then
		WeaponController.hit:fire(anyHead)
	end
	WeaponController.changed:fire()
	if view.mag <= 0 then
		requestReload()
	end
end

-- Auto-fire trigger: something hittable is under (or, with assist, near) the crosshair.
local function hasTarget(me: Body): boolean
	local gun = Config.GUNS[view.gun]
	local origin, center = centerRay()
	local _, id = cast(origin, center, me, gun.range, true)
	return id ~= nil
end

local function swing()
	local now = os.clock()
	local me = body()
	if not view.ready or not me or now < nextMelee then
		return
	end
	local melee = Config.MELEE[view.melee]
	nextMelee = now + melee.cooldown
	Net.melee():FireServer()
	WeaponController.swung:fire()
	Effects.swipe(me.root.CFrame, melee.range)

	-- Local hit check only drives feedback; the server decides the real targets.
	local look = me.root.CFrame.LookVector
	local forward = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z).Unit
	local origin = Vector3.new(me.root.Position.X, 0, me.root.Position.Z)
	local cosArc = math.cos(math.rad(melee.arc / 2))
	local hit = false
	ZombieRenderer.forEach(function(id, feet, scale)
		local offset = Vector3.new(feet.X, 0, feet.Z) - origin
		local dist = offset.Magnitude
		if dist <= melee.range and (dist < 1.5 or forward:Dot(offset / dist) >= cosArc) then
			Effects.blood(feet + Vector3.new(0, 3 * scale, 0), 6)
			ZombieRenderer.flinch(id)
			hit = true
		end
	end)
	if hit then
		WeaponController.hit:fire(false)
	end
end

local function throwGrenade()
	local now = os.clock()
	if not view.ready or not body() or view.grenades < 1 or now < nextGrenade then
		return
	end
	nextGrenade = now + Config.GRENADE.cooldown
	if not Config.DEBUG.infiniteAmmo then
		view.grenades -= 1
	end
	Net.throwGrenade():FireServer(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector)
	WeaponController.thrown:fire()
	WeaponController.changed:fire()
end

local function step()
	if not view.ready then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if view.reloading and now > reloadWatchdog then
		-- Lost the server's answer somehow; ask for the truth instead of staying stuck.
		view.reloading = false
		Net.weaponSync():FireServer()
		WeaponController.changed:fire()
	end
	if view.reloading or now < nextShot or InputController.isModalOpen() then
		return
	end
	local me = body()
	if not me then
		return
	end

	local wantsFire = InputController.isDown("Fire")
		or (InputController.autoFire and view.mag > 0 and hasTarget(me))
	if not wantsFire then
		return
	end
	if view.mag > 0 then
		fire(me)
	else
		requestReload()
	end
end

function WeaponController.start()
	Net.weaponSync().OnClientEvent:Connect(onSync)
	Net.turretShot().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(from: Vector3, to: Vector3)
		if typeof(from) == "Vector3" and typeof(to) == "Vector3" then
			Effects.tracer(from, to, COLOR_TURRET)
		end
	end)
	Net.weaponSync():FireServer()

	InputController.actionChanged:connect(function(action, isDown)
		if not isDown or InputController.isModalOpen() then
			return
		end
		if action == "Reload" then
			requestReload()
		elseif action == "Melee" then
			swing()
		elseif action == "Grenade" then
			throwGrenade()
		end
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(step)
end

return WeaponController

--!strict
-- Sound and the effects tied to world events. Mixes three groups — SFX, ambience, music:
--   • your shots, reloads, swings and throws in 2D; other players' shots, turrets,
--     explosions, molotov fire and Creeper fuses positioned in the world
--   • one looped growl bed for the whole horde, louder the more zombies are close (§3)
--   • music in layers: a drone during Prep, plus a tension track during waves; a horror
--     sting at every wave and the Brute's roar when he arrives; the helicopter on extraction
--   • a heartbeat when your health is low, clicks on menu buttons, a till on purchases
-- Sound ids live in Art/Sounds.

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Sounds = require(Shared.Art.Sounds)
local WeaponController = require(script.Parent.WeaponController)
local ZombieRenderer = require(script.Parent.ZombieRenderer)
local Effects = require(script.Parent.Parent.Effects)

local AudioController = {}

local GUN_SOUNDS: { [string]: string } = {
	Pistol = "GunPistol",
	SMG = "GunSMG",
	Shotgun = "GunShotgun",
	Rifle = "GunRifle",
	AK47 = "GunAK47",
}
local HORDE_RADIUS = 45
local HORDE_FULL = 25 -- this many zombies in range = full growl volume
local FADE = TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local groups: { [string]: SoundGroup } = {}
local loops: { [string]: Sound } = {}

local function group(name: string, volume: number): SoundGroup
	local g = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
	g.Name = name
	g.Volume = volume
	g.Parent = SoundService
	groups[name] = g
	return g
end

local function makeSound(name: string, parent: Instance, soundGroup: SoundGroup): Sound
	local def = Sounds[name]
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = name
	s.SoundId = def.id
	s.Volume = def.volume
	s.Looped = def.looped == true
	local jitter = def.jitter or 0
	s.PlaybackSpeed = (def.pitch or 1) * (1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * jitter)
	s.SoundGroup = soundGroup
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

-- One-shot in 2D (your own actions, UI, stingers).
function AudioController.play(name: string, groupName: string?)
	local s = makeSound(name, SoundService, groups[groupName or "SFX"])
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(s, 8)
end

-- One-shot heard from a point in the world.
function AudioController.playAt(name: string, position: Vector3, rollOffMax: number?)
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.WorldPosition = position
	attachment.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local s = makeSound(name, attachment, groups.SFX)
	s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	s.RollOffMinDistance = 10
	s.RollOffMaxDistance = rollOffMax or 250
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(attachment, 8)
end

-- Looped sounds live forever and are faded in and out by volume.
local function loop(name: string, groupName: string): Sound
	local s = makeSound(name, SoundService, groups[groupName])
	s.Volume = 0
	s:Play()
	loops[name] = s
	return s
end

local function fadeTo(name: string, volume: number)
	local s = loops[name]
	if s then
		TweenService:Create(s, FADE, { Volume = volume }):Play()
	end
end

-- Music --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function onPhase(match: Instance)
	local phase = match:GetAttribute("Phase")
	local drone, tension = Sounds.MusicDrone.volume, Sounds.MusicTension.volume
	if phase == "Prep" or phase == "Lobby" then
		fadeTo("MusicDrone", drone)
		fadeTo("MusicTension", 0)
		fadeTo("Helicopter", 0)
	elseif phase == "Wave" or phase == "Final" then
		AudioController.play("Sting", "Music")
		fadeTo("MusicDrone", drone * 0.5)
		fadeTo("MusicTension", tension)
	elseif phase == "Extract" then
		fadeTo("MusicTension", tension)
		fadeTo("Helicopter", Sounds.Helicopter.volume)
	elseif phase == "Result" then
		AudioController.play("Sting", "Music")
		fadeTo("MusicDrone", 0)
		fadeTo("MusicTension", 0)
		fadeTo("Helicopter", 0)
	end
end

-- Ambient beds ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateBeds()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local center = if root and root:IsA("BasePart")
		then root.Position
		else workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position

	local near = ZombieRenderer.countNear(center, HORDE_RADIUS)
	local horde = loops.Horde
	if horde then
		horde.Volume = Sounds.Horde.volume * math.clamp(near / HORDE_FULL, 0, 1)
	end

	local heart = loops.Heartbeat
	if heart then
		local low = humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth < 0.35
		heart.Volume = if low then Sounds.Heartbeat.volume else 0
	end
end

-- World events -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function onWorldDescendant(instance: Instance)
	if instance:IsA("Explosion") then
		AudioController.playAt("Explosion", instance.Position, 400)
		Effects.explosion(instance.Position, instance.BlastRadius)
	elseif instance.Name == "FirePatch" and instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		-- Molotov fire: crackles where it burns, removed with the patch.
		local s = makeSound("Fire", instance, groups.SFX)
		s.RollOffMaxDistance = 80
		s:Play()
	end
end

local function hookButtons(gui: Instance)
	-- Menu buttons click; the touch action cluster (SwarmHUD) stays silent, it fires constantly.
	local function hook(descendant: Instance)
		local screen = descendant:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if descendant:IsA("GuiButton") and screen and screen.Name ~= "SwarmHUD" then
			descendant.Activated:Connect(function()
				AudioController.play("Click", "UI")
			end)
		end
	end
	gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)
	for _, d in gui:GetDescendants() do
		hook(d)
	end
end

function AudioController.init()
	group("SFX", 0.9)
	group("Ambience", 0.8)
	group("Music", 0.6)
	group("UI", 0.7)
end

function AudioController.start()
	loop("MusicDrone", "Music")
	loop("MusicTension", "Music")
	loop("Horde", "Ambience")
	loop("Heartbeat", "SFX")
	loop("Helicopter", "Ambience")

	-- Your own weapon.
	WeaponController.fired:connect(function(gun, muzzle, direction)
		AudioController.play(GUN_SOUNDS[gun] or "GunPistol")
		Effects.muzzleFlash(muzzle, direction)
	end)
	WeaponController.reloadStarted:connect(function()
		AudioController.play("Reload")
	end)
	WeaponController.swung:connect(function()
		AudioController.play("Swing")
	end)
	WeaponController.thrown:connect(function()
		AudioController.play("Throw")
	end)
	WeaponController.hit:connect(function()
		AudioController.play("HitTick", "UI")
	end)

	-- Other players and turrets.
	Net.shotFx().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(shooter: unknown, gun: unknown)
		if typeof(shooter) ~= "Instance" or shooter == player or typeof(gun) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local character = (shooter :: Player).Character
		local muzzle = character and character:FindFirstChild("Muzzle", true)
		if muzzle and muzzle:IsA("BasePart") then
			AudioController.playAt(GUN_SOUNDS[gun] or "GunPistol", muzzle.Position)
		end
	end)
	Net.turretShot().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(from: Vector3)
		if typeof(from) == "Vector3" then
			AudioController.playAt("Turret", from, 150)
		end
	end)
	ZombieRenderer.fuseLit:connect(function(position)
		AudioController.playAt("CreeperHiss", position, 120)
	end)

	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(onWorldDescendant)

	Net.notify().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message: unknown)
		if
			typeof(message) == "string"
			and (message:find("^Comprou") or message:find("^Torreta comprada"))
		then
			AudioController.play("Purchase", "UI")
		end
	end)
	hookButtons(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

	local match = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Match")
	match:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(function()
		onPhase(match)
	end)
	onPhase(match)
	-- The Brute announces himself.
	local bossWasUp = false
	match:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BossMaxHealth"):Connect(function()
		local up = (match:GetAttribute("BossMaxHealth") or 0) > 0
		if up and not bossWasUp then
			AudioController.play("BruteRoar", "Music")
			Effects.shake(0.4)
		end
		bossWasUp = up
	end)

	local accumulator = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator += dt
		if accumulator >= 0.25 then
			accumulator = 0
			updateBeds()
		end
	end)
end

return AudioController

--!strict
-- Barn shop menu and toast notifications. The menu opens when the shop crate's prompt is
-- completed (keyboard hold or the touch context button) and closes when the player walks
-- away. Buttons only ask; the server validates and answers with a toast (Net.notify).

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Tags = require(Shared.Tags)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Theme)

local ShopUI = {}

local COLOR_PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
local COLOR_ROW = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 42)
local COLOR_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
local COLOR_ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
local COLOR_DISABLED = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 96)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local screen: ScreenGui
local menu: Frame
local toasts: Frame
local buyButtons: { [string]: TextButton } = {}

local function credits(): number
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local value = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Créditos")
	return if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then value.Value else 0
end

local function label(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
	l.FontFace = Theme.FONT.heavy
	l.TextScaled = true
	for key, value in props do
		(l :: any)[key] = value
	end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local function refreshPrices()
	local have = credits()
	local levelValue = player:GetAttribute("Level")
	local level = if typeof(levelValue) == "number" then levelValue else 1
	for _, item in Config.SHOP do
		local button = buyButtons[item.id]
		if button then
			-- Items above the account level show what unlocks them instead of a price.
			local required = Config.PROGRESSION.unlocks[item.id]
			local locked = required ~= nil and level < required
			local affordable = not locked and have >= item.price
			button.Text = if locked then `NÍVEL {required}` else "$ " .. item.price
			button.BackgroundColor3 = if affordable then COLOR_ACCENT else COLOR_DISABLED
			button.TextColor3 = if affordable then COLOR_PANEL else COLOR_TEXT
		end
	end
end

local function setOpen(open: boolean)
	menu.Visible = open
	InputController.setModal("Shop", open)
	if open then
		refreshPrices()
	end
end

local function nearShop(): boolean
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false

	for _, crate in CollectionService:GetTagged(Tags.ShopBox) do
		if
			crate:IsA("BasePart")
			and (crate.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= Config.SHOP_RANGE

		end
	end
	return false

function ShopUI.start()
	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt)
		local crate = prompt.Parent
		if crate and CollectionService:HasTag(crate, Tags.ShopBox) then

	end)
	Net.notify().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message: unknown)
		if typeof(message) == "string" then
			toast(message)
		end
	end)

	-- Prices dim/brighten as credits change; walking away closes the menu.
	task.spawn(function()
		local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
		local value = leaderstats:WaitForChild("Créditos")
		if value:IsA("IntValue") then

--!strict
-- Procedural upper-body poses for every player character, applied after Roblox's default
-- animations each frame (PreSimulation) so legs keep the stock walk cycle:
--   • holding the gun two-handed (pistol: both hands forward), arms and head following the
--     aim pitch; the wrist keeps the barrel exactly on the aim line
--   • recoil kick per shot, reload (left hand to the magazine, gun tilted), melee swing with
--     the gun, overhand grenade throw with a grenade in the left hand
--   • while strafing, the legs turn toward the movement and the chest stays on the aim
-- Works with Motor6D and AnimationConstraint joints (both expose Transform). The local player
-- poses from the camera; others from the AimPitch attribute and Net.characterFx events.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local WeaponController = require(script.Parent.WeaponController)

local PoseController = {}

local HALF_PI = math.pi / 2
local MAX_PITCH = math.rad(60)
local MAX_TWIST = math.rad(55)
local SPEED_NORMAL, SPEED_AIM, SPEED_RELOAD = 16, 11, 13
local PITCH_SEND_INTERVAL = 0.12

type Joint = { Transform: CFrame }
type Action = { kind: string, start: number, duration: number }
type Rig = {
	character: Model,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	root: BasePart,
	leftHand: BasePart,
	joints: { [string]: Joint },
	twist: number,
	recoil: number,
	action: Action?,
	prop: BasePart?,
	-- What we wrote to the Root joint last frame and the animation value under it, so a frame
	-- where the animator didn't touch Root doesn't stack the hip turn again.
	lastRoot: CFrame?,
	rootBase: CFrame,
}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local rigs: { [Model]: Rig } = {}
local lastPitchSent = 0
local lastPitchTime = 0

local JOINT_PARTS = {
	RightShoulder = "RightUpperArm",
	RightElbow = "RightLowerArm",
	RightWrist = "RightHand",
	LeftShoulder = "LeftUpperArm",
	LeftElbow = "LeftLowerArm",
	Waist = "UpperTorso",
	Neck = "Head",
	Root = "LowerTorso",
}

local function smooth(t: number): number
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

-- 0→1→0 envelope over [0, 1] with `edge` long ramps, for actions that leave and return.
local function envelope(t: number, edge: number): number
	if t < edge then
		return smooth(t / edge)
	elseif t > 1 - edge then
		return smooth((1 - t) / edge)
	end
	return 1
end

local function arm(pitch: number, yaw: number): CFrame
	-- Raise the arm forward by `pitch` (0 = hanging), then swing it sideways by `yaw`.
	return CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
end

local function track(character: Model)
	if rigs[character] then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	local leftHand = character:WaitForChild("LeftHand", 10)
	if
		not humanoid
		or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid")
		or humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
	then
		return
	end
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not leftHand or not leftHand:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local joints: { [string]: Joint } = {}
	for name, partName in JOINT_PARTS do
		local part = character:WaitForChild(partName, 10)
		local joint = part and part:FindFirstChild(name)
		if joint and (joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) then
			joints[name] = joint :: any
		end
	end
	rigs[character] = {
		character = character,
		humanoid = humanoid,
		root = root,
		leftHand = leftHand,
		joints = joints,
		twist = 0,
		recoil = 0,
		action = nil,
		prop = nil,
		lastRoot = nil,
		rootBase = CFrame.identity,
	}
	character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			local rig = rigs[character]
			if rig and rig.prop then
				rig.prop:Destroy()
			end
			rigs[character] = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function startAction(character: Model?, kind: string, duration: number)
	local rig = character and rigs[character]
	if rig then
		rig.action = { kind = kind, start = os.clock(), duration = duration }
	end
end

local function grenadeProp(rig: Rig, show: boolean)
	if show and not rig.prop then
		local ball = Instance.new("Part")
		ball.Name = "GrenadeInHand"
		ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		ball.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
		ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 72, 48)
		ball.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		ball.Anchored = true
		ball.CanCollide = false
		ball.CanQuery = false
		ball.CanTouch = false
		ball.CastShadow = false
		ball.Parent = workspace
		rig.prop = ball
	elseif not show and rig.prop then
		rig.prop:Destroy()
		rig.prop = nil
	end
	if rig.prop then
		rig.prop.CFrame = rig.leftHand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.4, 0)
	end
end

local function aimPitch(rig: Rig): number
	if rig.character == player.Character then
		return math.clamp(
			math.asin(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector.Y),
			-MAX_PITCH,
			MAX_PITCH
		)
	end
	local pitch = rig.character:GetAttribute("AimPitch")
	return if typeof(pitch) == "number" then math.clamp(pitch, -MAX_PITCH, MAX_PITCH) else 0
end

local function gunName(rig: Rig): string
	local gun = rig.character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
	if gun then
		for _, child in gun:GetChildren() do
			local base = string.match(child.Name, "^(%w+)_")
			if base and Config.GUNS[base :: Config.GunName] then
				return base
			end
		end
	end
	if rig.character == player.Character then
		return WeaponController.view.gun
	end
	return "SMG"
end

local function pose(rig: Rig, dt: number)
	local joints = rig.joints
	local pitch = aimPitch(rig)
	local pistol = gunName(rig) == "Pistol"

	-- Base hold: right hand on the grip, left hand supporting the barrel.
	local rShoulder, rYaw, rElbow = 1.45 + pitch * 0.8, 0, 0.25
	local lShoulder, lYaw, lElbow = 1.35 + pitch * 0.8, -0.6, 0.55
	if pistol then
		rShoulder, rElbow = 1.5 + pitch * 0.9, 0.12
		lShoulder, lYaw, lElbow = 1.45 + pitch * 0.9, -0.42, 0.3
	end
	local wristRoll = 0
	local waistExtra = 0

	rig.recoil = math.max(0, rig.recoil - dt * 9)
	local kick = rig.recoil * 0.18
	rShoulder += kick
	lShoulder += kick

	local action = rig.action
	if action then
		local t = (os.clock() - action.start) / action.duration
		if t >= 1 then
			rig.action = nil
		elseif action.kind == "melee" then
			-- Wind up high and out, then bash across the body, then recover.
			if t < 0.35 then
				local k = smooth(t / 0.35)
				rShoulder += (2.4 - rShoulder) * k
				rYaw += 0.6 * k
				waistExtra = 0.25 * k
			elseif t < 0.7 then
				local k = smooth((t - 0.35) / 0.35)
				rShoulder = 2.4 + (0.6 - 2.4) * k
				rYaw = 0.6 + (-0.5 - 0.6) * k
				waistExtra = 0.25 - 0.55 * k
			else
				local k = smooth((t - 0.7) / 0.3)
				rShoulder = 0.6 + (rShoulder - 0.6) * k
				rYaw = -0.5 * (1 - k)
				waistExtra = -0.3 * (1 - k)
			end
		elseif action.kind == "throw" then
			-- Overhand: left arm up and back with the grenade, whip forward, recover.
			if t < 0.4 then
				local k = smooth(t / 0.4)
				lShoulder += (2.9 - lShoulder) * k
				lYaw += (0.45 - lYaw) * k
				lElbow += (1.3 - lElbow) * k
				waistExtra = -0.3 * k
			elseif t < 0.62 then
				local k = smooth((t - 0.4) / 0.22)
				lShoulder = 2.9 + (1.1 - 2.9) * k
				lYaw = 0.45 + (-0.3 - 0.45) * k
				lElbow = 1.3 + (0.05 - 1.3) * k
				waistExtra = -0.3 + 0.55 * k
			else
				local k = smooth((t - 0.62) / 0.38)
				lShoulder = 1.1 + (lShoulder - 1.1) * k
				lYaw = -0.3 + (lYaw + 0.3) * k
				lElbow = 0.05 + (lElbow - 0.05) * k
				waistExtra = 0.25 * (1 - k)
			end
			grenadeProp(rig, t < 0.42)
		elseif action.kind == "reload" then
			-- Left hand drops to the magazine and back; the gun tilts while it's out.
			local k = envelope(t, 0.2)
			lShoulder += (0.75 - lShoulder) * k
			lYaw += (-0.35 - lYaw) * k
			lElbow += (1.15 - lElbow) * k
			wristRoll = 0.45 * k
		end
	end
	if not (action and action.kind == "throw") and rig.prop then
		grenadeProp(rig, false)
	end

	-- Strafing: legs face the movement, chest stays on the aim.
	local velocity = rig.root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(rig.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
	local flat = Vector2.new(velocity.X, velocity.Z)
	local targetTwist = 0
	if flat.Magnitude > 2 then
		local angle = math.atan2(-velocity.X, -velocity.Z) -- 0 = forward, + = left
		if math.abs(angle) > HALF_PI then
			-- Backpedalling: keep the hips square rather than turning them around.
			angle = (if angle > 0 then angle - math.pi else angle + math.pi) * 0.5
		end
		targetTwist = math.clamp(angle, -MAX_TWIST, MAX_TWIST)
	end
	rig.twist += (targetTwist - rig.twist) * math.min(1, dt * 10)

	-- The wrist keeps the barrel on the aim line whatever the arm is doing.
	local wrist = HALF_PI + pitch - rShoulder - rElbow

	local function set(name: string, value: CFrame)
		local joint = joints[name]
		if joint then
			joint.Transform = value
		end
	end
	set("RightShoulder", arm(rShoulder, rYaw))
	set("RightElbow", CFrame.Angles(rElbow, 0, 0))
	set("RightWrist", CFrame.Angles(wrist, 0, wristRoll))
	set("LeftShoulder", arm(lShoulder, lYaw))
	set("LeftElbow", CFrame.Angles(lElbow, 0, 0))
	set("Waist", CFrame.Angles(0, -rig.twist + waistExtra, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.25, 0, 0))
	set("Neck", CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.45, 0, 0))
	local root = joints.Root
	if root then
		-- Keep the walk cycle's bob from the default animation, add the hip turn.
		local current = root.Transform
		local base = if rig.lastRoot and current == rig.lastRoot then rig.rootBase else current
		rig.rootBase = base
		local out = CFrame.Angles(0, rig.twist, 0) * base
		root.Transform = out
		rig.lastRoot = out
	end
end

local function localUpdate()
	local rig = player.Character and rigs[player.Character]
	if not rig then
		return
	end
	-- Aiming and reloading slow you down.
	local speed = SPEED_NORMAL
	if WeaponController.view.reloading then
		speed = SPEED_RELOAD
	end
	if InputController.isDown("Aim") then
		speed = SPEED_AIM
	end
	if rig.humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= speed then
		rig.humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
	end
	-- Share the aim pitch so others see where you point (throttled, only on change).
	local pitch = aimPitch(rig)
	local now = os.clock()
	if math.abs(pitch - lastPitchSent) > 0.03 and now - lastPitchTime > PITCH_SEND_INTERVAL then
		lastPitchSent, lastPitchTime = pitch, now
		Net.aimPitch():FireServer(pitch)
	end
end

function PoseController.start()
	local function watch(p: Player)
		if p.Character then
			task.spawn(track, p.Character)
		end
		p.CharacterAdded:Connect(track)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		watch(p)
	end

	-- Your own actions start instantly; others' arrive through the server relay.
	WeaponController.fired:connect(function()
		local rig = player.Character and rigs[player.Character]
		if rig then
			rig.recoil = 1
		end
	end)
	WeaponController.swung:connect(function()
		startAction(player.Character, "melee", 0.4)
	end)
	WeaponController.thrown:connect(function()
		startAction(player.Character, "throw", 0.6)
	end)
	WeaponController.reloadStarted:connect(function()
		startAction(player.Character, "reload", Config.GUNS[WeaponController.view.gun].reloadTime)
	end)
	Net.characterFx().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(who: unknown, kind: unknown, gun: unknown)
		if typeof(who) ~= "Instance" or who == player or typeof(kind) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local character = (who :: Player).Character
		if kind == "shot" then
			local rig = character and rigs[character]
			if rig then
				rig.recoil = 1
			end
		elseif kind == "reload" then
			local stats = typeof(gun) == "string" and Config.GUNS[gun :: Config.GunName]
			startAction(character, kind, if stats then stats.reloadTime else 1.5)
		elseif kind == "melee" then
			startAction(character, kind, 0.4)
		elseif kind == "throw" then
			startAction(character, kind, 0.6)
		end
	end)

	RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
		localUpdate()
		for _, rig in rigs do
			if rig.humanoid.Health > 0 then
				pose(rig, dt)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return PoseController

-- crosshair layer ignores every inset so its center is exactly the camera ray's center.
