-- Red edges that flash on damage and pulse when health is low. Four gradient strips in the
-- inset-free layer, so they hug the real screen edges.
local function buildVignette()
	for i, spec in
		{
			{ anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0), size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.18), rotation = 90 },
			{ anchor = Vector2.new(0, 1), size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.18), rotation = -90 },
			{ anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 1), rotation = 0 },
			{ anchor = Vector2.new(1, 0), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 1), rotation = 180 },
		}
	do
		local edge = Instance.new("Frame")
		edge.Name = "Vignette" .. i
		edge.AnchorPoint = spec.anchor
		edge.Position = UDim2.fromScale(spec.anchor.X, spec.anchor.Y)
		edge.Size = spec.size
		edge.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.danger
		edge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		edge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gradient.Rotation = spec.rotation
		gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1) -- solid at the edge, clear inward
		gradient.Parent = edge
		edge.Parent = center
		table.insert(vignette, edge)
	end
end

local function humanoid(): Humanoid?
	local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function updateHealth(dt: number)
	local h = humanoid()
	local ratio = if h and h.MaxHealth > 0 then math.clamp(h.Health / h.MaxHealth, 0, 1) else 0
	healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
	healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = if ratio < 0.35 then Theme.COLOR.danger else Theme.COLOR.player
	healthLabel.Text = if h then tostring(math.ceil(h.Health)) else ""

	damageFlash = math.max(0, damageFlash - dt * 1.8)
	local lowPulse = if h
			and h.Health > 0
			and ratio < 0.35
		then 0.25 + 0.15 * math.sin(os.clock() * 5)
		else 0
	local strength = math.max(damageFlash, lowPulse)
	for _, edge in vignette do
		edge.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - strength
	end
end

local function watchDamage(character: Model)
	local h = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not h or not h:IsA("Humanoid") then
		return
	end
	local last = h.Health
	h.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		if health < last then
			damageFlash = math.min(0.7, damageFlash + (last - health) / h.MaxHealth * 3 + 0.2)
		end
		last = health
	end)
end

-- "+N" that rises from the credits line whenever credits go up.
local function creditPopup(amount: number)
	local popup = label(screen, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
			creditsLabel.AbsolutePosition.X + creditsLabel.TextBounds.X + 10,
			creditsLabel.AbsolutePosition.Y
		),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, creditsLabel.AbsoluteSize.Y),
		Text = "+" .. amount,
		TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(popup, info, {
		Position = popup.Position - UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
		TextTransparency = 1,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
	}):Play()
	task.delay(1, popup.Destroy, popup)
end

local function refreshStatus()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local value = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Créditos")
	creditsLabel.Text = "$ " .. (if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then value.Value else 0)

	local class = Config.CLASSES[player:GetAttribute("Class") :: Types.ClassId]
		or Config.CLASSES[Config.DEFAULT_CLASS]
	local readyAt = player:GetAttribute("AbilityReadyAt")
	local left = if typeof(readyAt) == "number" then readyAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() else 0
	abilityLabel.Text = "[Q] "
		.. Text.upper(class.ability.name)
		.. (if left > 0 then string.format(" — %ds", math.ceil(left)) else " — PRONTA")
	abilityLabel.TextColor3 = if left > 0 then Theme.COLOR.muted else Theme.COLOR.player

	local view = WeaponController.view
	reloadBar.Visible = view.reloading
	if view.reloading then
		local duration = Config.GUNS[view.gun].reloadTime
		reloadFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(
			math.clamp((os.clock() - reloadStartedAt) / math.max(duration, 0.05), 0, 1),
			1
		)
	end
end

local function buildCenter()
	-- A thin ring reads better than a dot on a busy, dark screen and leaves the target visible.
	local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
	ring.Name = "Crosshair"
	ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local round = Instance.new("UICorner")
	round.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	round.Parent = ring
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = COLOR_TEXT
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Transparency = 0.1
	stroke.Parent = ring
	ring.Parent = center
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
	dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	dot.Parent = center

	-- Reload progress: a short bar under the crosshair that fills over the reload time.
	reloadBar = Instance.new("Frame")
	reloadBar.Name = "Reload"
	reloadBar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	reloadBar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 22)
	reloadBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 6)
	reloadBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	reloadBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	reloadBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	reloadBar.Visible = false
	reloadBar.Parent = center
	reloadFill = Instance.new("Frame")
	reloadFill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent
	reloadFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	reloadFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	reloadFill.Parent = reloadBar

	-- Four short diagonal ticks around the crosshair.
	hitmarker = Instance.new("Frame")
	hitmarker.Name = "Hitmarker"
	hitmarker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	hitmarker.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	hitmarker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
	hitmarker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hitmarker.Parent = center
	for _, corner in
		{ Vector2.new(-1, -1), Vector2.new(1, -1), Vector2.new(-1, 1), Vector2.new(1, 1) }
	do
		local tick = Instance.new("Frame")
		tick.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		tick.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, corner.X * 9, 0.5, corner.Y * 9)
		tick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 2)
		tick.Rotation = if corner.X == corner.Y then 45 else -45
		tick.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tick.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
		tick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tick.Parent = hitmarker
		table.insert(hitTicks, tick)
	end
end

local function refresh()
	local view = WeaponController.view
	local gun = Config.GUNS[view.gun]
	gunLabel.Text = Text.upper(gun.displayName)
	magLabel.Text = tostring(view.mag)
	magLabel.TextColor3 = if view.mag <= gun.magSize * 0.25 then COLOR_LOW else COLOR_TEXT
	reserveLabel.Text = if Config.DEBUG.infiniteAmmo then "/ ∞" else "/ " .. view.reserve
	grenadeLabel.Text = "GRANADAS: " .. view.grenades
end

local function flashHit(head: boolean)
	if hitTween then
		hitTween:Cancel()
	end
	local color = if head then COLOR_HEAD else COLOR_TEXT
	for _, tick in hitTicks do
		tick.BackgroundColor3 = color
		tick.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	end
	hitmarker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	hitTween = TweenService:Create(hitmarker, info, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28) })
	local tween = hitTween :: Tween
	tween:Play()
	for _, tick in hitTicks do
		TweenService:Create(tick, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end
end

function CombatHUD.init()
	screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "CombatHUD"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets

	center = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	center.Name = "Crosshair"
	center.ResetOnSpawn = false
	center.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None

	buildAmmoPanel()
	buildVitals()
	buildCenter()
	buildVignette()
end

function CombatHUD.start()
	refresh()
	WeaponController.changed:connect(refresh)
	WeaponController.hit:connect(flashHit)
	WeaponController.reloadStarted:connect(function()
		reloadStartedAt = os.clock()
	end)
	-- Credits, cooldown and health change constantly; a few writes per frame are cheap.
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		refreshStatus()
		updateHealth(dt)
	end)

	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(watchDamage, player.Character)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchDamage)
	task.spawn(function()
		local credits = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Créditos")
		if credits:IsA("IntValue") then
			local last = credits.Value
			credits.Changed:Connect(function(value)
				-- Kill rewards only; a new match resetting credits isn't a reward.
				if value > last and value - last <= 500 then
					creditPopup(value - last)
				end
				last = value
			end)
		end
	end)
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	screen.Parent = playerGui
	center.Parent = playerGui
end

return CombatHUD

--!strict
-- Draws the server's zombie snapshots. Three LOD tiers, all pooled and moved in one
-- workspace:BulkMoveTo per frame (never created/destroyed while playing):
--   near  — up to MAX_ANIMATED closest within NEAR_DISTANCE: the kind's low-poly rig
--           (Art/ZombieRigs) with a procedural walk/attack cycle; pooled per kind. Each part
--           uses the matching Blender mesh from ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Zombies
--           (tools/blender/zombies.py) when the place has it, a plain block otherwise
--   mid   — single block in the zombie's shirt colour, up to FAR_DISTANCE
--   none  — beyond that the corn and fog hide them anyway
-- Positions are interpolated between 10 Hz snapshots, so motion stays smooth at any FPS.
-- Hit zombies flinch; killed ones that were drawn as rigs fall over before returning to the
-- pool (capped at MAX_CORPSES).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Types = require(Shared.Types)
local ZombiePacket = require(Shared.ZombiePacket)
local ZombieRigs = require(Shared.Art.ZombieRigs)
local HeroRigs = require(Shared.Art.HeroRigs)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local Effects = require(script.Parent.Parent.Effects)

local LOD = Config.CLIENT_ZOMBIES
local SNAPSHOT_DT = 1 / Config.HORDE.REPLICATION_HZ
local HIDDEN = CFrame.new(0, -1000, 0)

type Tier = "none" | "mid" | "near"

-- A pooled set of parts for one kind; `specs` says how each part is posed and painted.
type Rig = {
	kind: Types.ZombieKind,
	parts: { BasePart },
	specs: { ZombieRigs.PartSpec },
	pivots: { [ZombieRigs.Role]: Vector3 },
}

local FLINCH_TIME = 0.18
local FLINCH_ANGLE = math.rad(22)
local CORPSE_FALL = 0.35
local CORPSE_LIE = 2.5
local CORPSE_SINK = 0.8
local MAX_CORPSES = 16

type Entry = {
	id: number,
	kind: number,
	state: number,
	from: Vector3,
	to: Vector3,
	fromYaw: number,
	toYaw: number,
	alpha: number,
	lastSeen: number,
	phase: number, -- walk-cycle offset so the horde doesn't march in lockstep
	hitAt: number,
	variant: ZombieRigs.Variant,
	tier: Tier,
	near: Rig?,
	mid: BasePart?,
}

local ZombieRenderer = {}

-- A Creeper lit its fuse at this position (audio plays the hiss).
ZombieRenderer.fuseLit = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Vector3>

local entries: { [number]: Entry } = {}
-- Ids removed recently. Snapshots are unreliable and removals reliable, so a snapshot can
-- arrive after the removal; without this the dead zombie would pop back for a second.
local removedAt: { [number]: number } = {}
local container: Folder
local nearPools: { [Types.ZombieKind]: { Rig } } = {}
local midPool: { BasePart } = {}
-- `root` is on the ground; zombies killed up on a pile drop from `height` as they fall.
type Corpse = { rig: Rig, root: CFrame, height: number, kind: number, diedAt: number }
local corpses: { Corpse } = {}
local moveParts: { BasePart } = {}
local moveCFrames: { CFrame } = {}

local function newPart(
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	shape: Enum.PartType?
): BasePart
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	if shape then
		p.Shape = shape
	end
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.CFrame = HIDDEN
	p.Parent = container
	return p
end

-- Blender meshes by name ("Zombie_Torso"…); left/right and lettered parts share one mesh.
local meshTemplates: { [string]: MeshPart } = {}
local MESH_ALIASES: { [string]: string } = {
	LegL = "Leg",
	LegR = "Leg",
	ArmL = "Arm",
	ArmR = "Arm",
	SleeveL = "Sleeve",
	SleeveR = "Sleeve",
	PlateL = "Plate",
	PlateR = "Plate",
	FistL = "Fist",
	FistR = "Fist",
	TrapL = "Trap",
	TrapR = "Trap",
	PustuleA = "Pustule",
	PustuleB = "Pustule",
	PustuleC = "Pustule",
}

-- Hero meshes (tools/blender/zombie_heroes.py), imported into Assets.Heroes. A kind uses its
-- hero rig only when every part's mesh is present; otherwise the block/part rig above.
local heroTemplates: { [string]: MeshPart } = {}
local heroKinds: { [Types.ZombieKind]: boolean } = {}

local function loadMeshTemplates()
	local assets = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Assets")
	local folder = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Zombies")
	if folder then
		for _, d in folder:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
				meshTemplates[d.Name] = d
			end
		end
	end
	local heroes = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Heroes")
	if heroes then
		for _, d in heroes:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
				heroTemplates[d.Name] = d
			end
		end
	end
	for kind, rig in HeroRigs.RIGS do
		local complete = true
		for _, spec in rig.parts do
			if not heroTemplates[spec.mesh :: string] then
				complete = false
				break
			end
		end
		heroKinds[kind] = complete
	end
end

-- A pooled rig part: the Blender mesh for this spec if imported, else a block/ball.
local function rigPart(spec: ZombieRigs.PartSpec): BasePart
	local template = if spec.mesh
		then heroTemplates[spec.mesh]
		else meshTemplates["Zombie_" .. (MESH_ALIASES[spec.name] or spec.name)]
	if not template then
		return newPart(
			spec.name,
			spec.size,
			Color3.new(),
			ZombieRigs.material(spec.tone),
			spec.shape
		)
	end
	local p = template:Clone()
	for _, child in p:GetChildren() do
		child:Destroy()
	end
	p.Name = spec.name
	p.Size = spec.size
	p.Material = spec.material or ZombieRigs.material(spec.tone)
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.CFrame = HIDDEN
	p.Parent = container
	return p
end

local function kindName(kind: number): Types.ZombieKind
	return Config.ZOMBIE_KINDS_BY_ID[kind] or "Runner"
end

local function acquireNear(kind: Types.ZombieKind): Rig
	local pool = nearPools[kind]
	local rig = pool and table.remove(pool)
	if rig then
		return rig
	end
	local hero = if heroKinds[kind] then HeroRigs.RIGS[kind] else nil
	local specs = if hero then hero.parts else ZombieRigs.RIGS[kind]
	local parts = table.create(#specs) :: { BasePart }
	for _, spec in specs do
		table.insert(parts, rigPart(spec))
	end
	return {
		kind = kind,
		parts = parts,
		specs = specs,
		pivots = if hero then hero.pivots else ZombieRigs.PIVOTS,
	}
end

local function releaseRig(rig: Rig)
	for _, p in rig.parts do
		table.insert(moveParts, p)
		table.insert(moveCFrames, HIDDEN)
	end
	local pool = nearPools[rig.kind]
	if pool then
		table.insert(pool, rig)
	else
		nearPools[rig.kind] = { rig }
	end
end

-- Rigs are reused between zombies of a kind, so each is repainted with its new owner's outfit.
local function paintRig(rig: Rig, variant: ZombieRigs.Variant)
	for i, spec in rig.specs do
		rig.parts[i].Color = ZombieRigs.partColor(spec, variant, rig.kind)
	end
end

local function acquireMid(): BasePart
	local part = table.remove(midPool)
	if part then
		return part
	end
	-- No lights or extra parts here: at 100+ instances even a SurfaceLight each is too costly.
	return newPart("ZombieMid", Vector3.new(1.8, 5, 1), Color3.new(), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
end

local function release(entry: Entry)
	local near = entry.near
	if near then
		releaseRig(near)
		entry.near = nil
	end
	local mid = entry.mid
	if mid then
		table.insert(moveParts, mid)
		table.insert(moveCFrames, HIDDEN)
		table.insert(midPool, mid)
		entry.mid = nil
	end
	entry.tier = "none"
end

local function setTier(entry: Entry, tier: Tier)
	if entry.tier == tier then
		return
	end
	release(entry)
	entry.tier = tier
	if tier == "near" then
		local rig = acquireNear(kindName(entry.kind))
		paintRig(rig, entry.variant)
		entry.near = rig
	elseif tier == "mid" then
		local mid = acquireMid()
		mid.Color = entry.variant.shirt
		entry.mid = mid
	end
end

local function removeEntry(id: number)
	local entry = entries[id]
	if entry then
		release(entry)
		entries[id] = nil
	end
end

local function lerpAngle(a: number, b: number, t: number): number
	local diff = (b - a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
	return a + diff * t
end

local function currentPosition(entry: Entry): Vector3
	return entry.from:Lerp(entry.to, entry.alpha)
end

local function currentYaw(entry: Entry): number
	return lerpAngle(entry.fromYaw, entry.toYaw, entry.alpha)
end

local function onSnapshot(b: buffer)
	if typeof(b) ~= "buffer" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	ZombiePacket.decode(b, function(id, kind, state, position, yaw)
		local removed = removedAt[id]
		if removed then
			if now - removed < LOD.STALE_TIMEOUT * 2 then
				return
			end
			removedAt[id] = nil -- old enough: the id has been reused by a new zombie
		end
		local entry = entries[id]
		if entry then
			entry.from = currentPosition(entry)
			entry.fromYaw = currentYaw(entry)
			entry.to = position
			entry.toYaw = yaw
			entry.alpha = 0
			if state == ZombiePacket.STATE_FUSE and entry.state ~= state then
				ZombieRenderer.fuseLit:fire(position)
			end
			entry.state = state
			entry.kind = kind
			entry.lastSeen = now
		else
			entries[id] = {
				id = id,
				kind = kind,
				state = state,
				from = position,
				to = position,
				fromYaw = yaw,
				toYaw = yaw,
				alpha = 1,
				lastSeen = now,
				phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
				hitAt = -math.huge,
				variant = ZombieRigs.variant(kindName(kind), id),
				tier = "none",
			}
		end
	end)
end

local function viewerPosition(): Vector3
	local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root.Position
	end
	return workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
end

-- Picks tiers: nearest MAX_ANIMATED inside NEAR_DISTANCE get rigs, the rest within
-- FAR_DISTANCE get blocks. Also drops entries the server stopped sending.
local function assignLods()
	-- Fewer full rigs while the frame rate is low (Effects.quality drops to 0.5 below 40 FPS).
	local budget = math.floor(LOD.MAX_ANIMATED * Effects.quality)
	local now = os.clock()
	local viewer = viewerPosition()
	local sorted: { { entry: Entry, dist: number } } = {}
	for id, entry in entries do
		if now - entry.lastSeen > LOD.STALE_TIMEOUT then
			removeEntry(id)
		else
			table.insert(
				sorted,
				{ entry = entry, dist = (currentPosition(entry) - viewer).Magnitude }
			)
		end
	end
	for id, removed in removedAt do
		if now - removed >= LOD.STALE_TIMEOUT * 2 then
			removedAt[id] = nil
		end
	end
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		return a.dist < b.dist
	end)

	local animated = 0
	for _, item in sorted do
		local tier: Tier = "none"
		if item.dist <= LOD.NEAR_DISTANCE and animated < budget then
			tier = "near"
			animated += 1
		elseif item.dist <= LOD.FAR_DISTANCE then
			tier = "mid"
		end
		setTier(item.entry, tier)
	end
end

local function kindScale(kind: number): number
	local name = Config.ZOMBIE_KINDS_BY_ID[kind]
	return if name then Config.ZOMBIES[name].scale else 1
end

-- How many zombies are within `radius` studs of `point` (drives the horde ambience).
function ZombieRenderer.countNear(point: Vector3, radius: number): number
	local count = 0
	local radiusSq = radius * radius
	for _, entry in entries do
		local offset = entry.to - point
		if offset:Dot(offset) <= radiusSq then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

-- Local hit feedback; the server still decides the damage.
function ZombieRenderer.flinch(id: number)
	local entry = entries[id]
	if entry then
		entry.hitAt = os.clock()
	end
end

-- Visits every zombie at its rendered (interpolated) position. Weapons hit-test against this,
-- so what the player sees is what they hit.
function ZombieRenderer.forEach(visit: (id: number, feet: Vector3, scale: number) -> ())
	for id, entry in entries do
		visit(id, currentPosition(entry), kindScale(entry.kind))
	end
end

local function onRemoved(ids: { number })
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, id in ids do
		local entry = entries[id]
		if entry then
			local position = currentPosition(entry)
			Effects.blood(position + Vector3.new(0, 3 * kindScale(entry.kind), 0), 14)
			-- Hand the drawn rig to a corpse instead of the pool; far zombies just vanish.
			local rig = entry.near
			if rig and #corpses < MAX_CORPSES then
				entry.near = nil
				table.insert(corpses, {
					rig = rig,
					root = CFrame.new(position.X, 0, position.Z)
						* CFrame.Angles(0, currentYaw(entry), 0),
					height = position.Y,
					kind = entry.kind,
					diedAt = now,
				})
			end
		end
		removedAt[id] = now
		removeEntry(id)
	end
end

-- Places every rig part relative to `base` (the feet, facing -Z): legs swing around the
-- hips, arms around the shoulders, body and head bob.
local function poseRig(
	rig: Rig,
	base: CFrame,
	scale: number,
	legSwing: number,
	armSwing: number,
	armRaise: number, -- both arms up together (climbing, grabbing the wall)
	bob: number,
	rightRaise: number? -- extra lift on the right arm only (Brute holding a rock up)
)
	local lift = CFrame.new(0, bob, 0)
	for i, spec in rig.specs do
		local part = rig.parts[i]
		local role = spec.role
		local offset = spec.offset * scale
		local cf: CFrame
		if role == "Body" or role == "Head" then
			cf = base * lift * CFrame.new(offset)
		else
			local pivot = rig.pivots[role] * scale
			local angle: number
			if role == "LegL" then
				angle = legSwing
			elseif role == "LegR" then
				angle = -legSwing
			elseif role == "ArmL" then
				angle = armRaise + armSwing
			else
				angle = armRaise - armSwing + (rightRaise or 0)
			end
			-- Arms ride the body's bob; legs stay planted.
			local origin = if role == "ArmL" or role == "ArmR" then base * lift else base
			cf = origin
				* CFrame.new(pivot)
				* CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0)
				* CFrame.new(offset - pivot)
		end
		local size = spec.size * scale
		if part.Size ~= size then
			part.Size = size
		end
		table.insert(moveParts, part)
		table.insert(moveCFrames, cf)
	end
end

local function poseNear(entry: Entry, rig: Rig, root: CFrame, t: number)
	local state = entry.state
	local cycle = t * 9 + entry.phase
	local legSwing, armSwing, armRaise, bob, lean = 0, math.sin(cycle) * 0.12, 0, 0, 0
	local rightRaise = 0
	local shake = Vector3.zero
	if state == ZombiePacket.STATE_WALK then
		legSwing = math.sin(cycle) * 0.7
		bob = math.abs(math.sin(cycle)) * 0.25
	elseif state == ZombiePacket.STATE_ATTACK then
		armSwing = math.sin(t * 12 + entry.phase) * 0.6
	elseif state == ZombiePacket.STATE_PILE then
		-- Clawing at the wall: leaning in, arms up, legs scrabbling.
		legSwing = math.sin(t * 3 + entry.phase) * 0.15
		armSwing = math.sin(t * 6 + entry.phase) * 0.3
		armRaise, lean = 1.4, -0.35
	elseif state == ZombiePacket.STATE_CLIMB then
		legSwing = math.sin(t * 16 + entry.phase) * 0.9
		armSwing = math.sin(t * 16 + entry.phase) * 0.5
		armRaise, lean = 1.2, -0.2
	elseif state == ZombiePacket.STATE_CHARGE then
		-- Head down, arms back, legs pumping.
		legSwing = math.sin(t * 18 + entry.phase) * 0.9
		armRaise, lean = -0.6, -0.45
	elseif state == ZombiePacket.STATE_WINDUP then
		if rig.kind == "Brute" then
			rightRaise, lean = 2.6, 0.12 -- rock held high: the throw telegraph
		else
			-- Bull scraping the ground before a charge.
			legSwing = math.max(0, math.sin(t * 10)) * 0.6
			lean = -0.3
		end
	elseif state == ZombiePacket.STATE_FUSE then
		-- Creeper about to blow: trembling, belly and pustules flashing red.
		local s = 0.08 * kindScale(entry.kind)
		shake = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * s, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * s)
		armRaise = 0.4
		local flash = math.sin(t * 30) > 0
		for i, spec in rig.specs do
			if spec.tone == "glow" or spec.glow or spec.name == "Belly" then
				rig.parts[i].Color = if flash
					then ZombieRigs.FUSE_COLOR
					else ZombieRigs.partColor(spec, entry.variant, rig.kind)
			end
		end
	end
	-- Hit reaction: snap back from the feet and recover.
	local flinch = math.max(0, 1 - (t - entry.hitAt) / FLINCH_TIME)
	local base = root * CFrame.new(shake) * CFrame.Angles(lean + flinch * FLINCH_ANGLE, 0, 0)
	poseRig(rig, base, kindScale(entry.kind), legSwing, armSwing, armRaise, bob, rightRaise)
end

-- Dead rigs fall on their back, lie still, then sink into the ground and go back to the pool.
local function poseCorpses(t: number)
	for i = #corpses, 1, -1 do
		local corpse = corpses[i]
		local age = t - corpse.diedAt
		if age >= CORPSE_FALL + CORPSE_LIE + CORPSE_SINK then
			releaseRig(corpse.rig)
			corpses[i] = corpses[#corpses]
			corpses[#corpses] = nil
		else
			local scale = kindScale(corpse.kind)
			local fall = math.min(1, age / CORPSE_FALL)
			fall *= fall -- accelerate like gravity
			local sink = math.max(0, age - CORPSE_FALL - CORPSE_LIE) / CORPSE_SINK * 2 * scale
			-- Lifting by half the torso depth keeps the back on the ground once flat.
			local base = corpse.root
				* CFrame.new(0, corpse.height * (1 - fall) + fall * 0.5 * scale - sink, 0)
				* CFrame.Angles(fall * math.rad(88), 0, 0)
			poseRig(corpse.rig, base, scale, fall * 0.2, fall * 0.4, 0, 0)
		end
	end
end

local function render(dt: number)
	local t = os.clock()
	for _, entry in entries do
		entry.alpha = math.min(1, entry.alpha + dt / SNAPSHOT_DT)
		if entry.tier ~= "none" then
			local root = CFrame.new(currentPosition(entry)) * CFrame.Angles(0, currentYaw(entry), 0)
			local near, mid = entry.near, entry.mid
			if near then
				poseNear(entry, near, root, t)
			elseif mid then
				local scale = kindScale(entry.kind)
				table.insert(moveParts, mid)
				table.insert(moveCFrames, root * CFrame.new(0, 2.5 * scale, 0))
			end
		end
	end

	poseCorpses(t)

	if #moveParts > 0 then
		workspace:BulkMoveTo(moveParts, moveCFrames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
		table.clear(moveParts)
		table.clear(moveCFrames)
	end
end

function ZombieRenderer.init()
	container = Instance.new("Folder")
	container.Name = "ZombiesClient"
	container.Parent = workspace
end

function ZombieRenderer.start()
	loadMeshTemplates()
	Net.zombieState().OnClientEvent:Connect(onSnapshot)
	Net.zombieRemoved().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ids: { number })
		if typeof(ids) == "table" then
			onRemoved(ids)
		end
	end)

	local lodAccumulator = 0
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		lodAccumulator += dt
		if lodAccumulator >= LOD.LOD_INTERVAL then
			lodAccumulator = 0
			assignLods()
		end
		render(dt)
	end)
end

return ZombieRenderer

--!strict
-- Touch HUD: a right-thumb cluster of big buttons around ATIRAR (the crosshair lives in
-- CombatHUD). The cluster scales with screen height so ATIRAR stays ~100 pt and the others
-- ~60 pt from small phones to tablets, all labelled in full. MIRA toggles instead of needing a
-- held thumb; GRANADA shows how many are left; PODER wears a cyan ring when ready and counts
-- down otherwise. The context button holds whichever ProximityPrompt is showing (shop, ammo,
-- repair), so prompts keep their 0.5 s hold without a precise tap.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local WeaponController = require(script.Parent.WeaponController)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Theme)
local Text = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util.Text)

type Action = InputController.Action

local MobileHUD = {}

local COLOR_PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
local COLOR_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
local COLOR_FIRE = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40)
local COLOR_CONTEXT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
local COLOR_READY = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 230)

-- Button layout inside the cluster frame (scale units of the cluster, a square anchored
-- bottom-right; pos is the button centre). ATIRAR is biggest and sits where the thumb rests;
-- the rest arc around it without touching.
type ButtonSpec = { action: Action, label: string, pos: Vector2, size: number, color: Color3? }
local BUTTONS: { ButtonSpec } = {
	{
		action = "Fire",
		label = "ATIRAR",
		pos = Vector2.new(0.74, 0.72),
		size = 0.36,
		color = COLOR_FIRE,
	},
	{ action = "Aim", label = "MIRA", pos = Vector2.new(0.42, 0.88), size = 0.2 },
	{ action = "Reload", label = "RECARREGAR", pos = Vector2.new(0.46, 0.58), size = 0.2 },
	{ action = "Grenade", label = "GRANADA", pos = Vector2.new(0.62, 0.36), size = 0.2 },
	{ action = "Melee", label = "FACA", pos = Vector2.new(0.88, 0.4), size = 0.2 },
	{ action = "Ability", label = "PODER", pos = Vector2.new(0.18, 0.68), size = 0.2 },
	-- Kept below the cluster's top band, which the ammo panel covers on wide phones.
	{ action = "Jump", label = "PULAR", pos = Vector2.new(0.12, 0.42), size = 0.16 },
}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local screen: ScreenGui
local contextButton: TextButton
local abilityButton: TextButton?
local aimButton: TextButton?
local grenadeBadge: TextLabel?
local aiming = false
local shownPrompt: ProximityPrompt?
local holdingPrompt: ProximityPrompt?

local function corner(parent: GuiObject, radius: UDim)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = radius
	c.Parent = parent
end

-- `passThrough` buttons are labels that don't sink the touch, so the default camera still
-- turns when that finger drags (ATIRAR: hold to fire and drag to aim with one thumb).
local function makeButton(spec: ButtonSpec, parent: GuiObject, passThrough: boolean?): TextButton
	local b: any = Instance.new(if passThrough then "TextLabel" else "TextButton")
	b.Name = spec.action
	b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	b.Position = UDim2.fromScale(spec.pos.X, spec.pos.Y)
	b.Size = UDim2.fromScale(spec.size, spec.size)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = spec.color or COLOR_PANEL
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	b.Text = spec.label
	b.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
	b.FontFace = Theme.FONT.heavy
	b.TextScaled = true
	if passThrough then
		b.Active = false
	else
		b.AutoButtonColor = false
	end
	corner(b, UDim.new(0.5, 0))

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0.1, 0)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0.1, 0)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.3, 0)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.3, 0)
	pad.Parent = b

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Color = COLOR_TEXT
	stroke.Transparency = 0.6
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = b

	b.Parent = parent
	return b
end

-- Press/release wiring. InputEnded on the button can be missed if the finger slides off, so
-- we also release on the touch's global end. Pass-through buttons never receive input
-- themselves, so their press is a hit test of every touch that starts.
local function bindHold(button: GuiObject, onDown: () -> (), onUp: () -> (), passThrough: boolean?)
	local activeTouch: InputObject? = nil
	local function press(input: InputObject)
		activeTouch = input
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		onDown()
	end
	if passThrough then
		UserInputService.TouchStarted:Connect(function(input)
			if activeTouch or not button.Visible then
				return
			end
			local radius = button.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
			local center = button.AbsolutePosition + button.AbsoluteSize / 2
			local point = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			if (point - center).Magnitude <= radius then
				press(input)
			end
		end)
	else
		button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not activeTouch then
				press(input)
			end
		end)
	end
	UserInputService.TouchEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input == activeTouch then
			activeTouch = nil
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
			onUp()
		end
	end)
end

-- Changes state directly: setting Humanoid.Jump is overwritten every frame by the default
-- ControlModule (whose own jump button we hide), so the jump never happened.
local function jump()
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	end
end

-- Roblox's own jump button overlaps our cluster; ours replaces it.
local function hideDefaultJump()
	local touchGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("TouchGui", 10)
	local frame = touchGui and touchGui:WaitForChild("TouchControlFrame", 10)
	local jumpButton = frame and frame:WaitForChild("JumpButton", 10)
	if jumpButton and jumpButton:IsA("GuiObject") then
		jumpButton.Visible = false
		jumpButton:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			jumpButton.Visible = false
		end)
	end
end

local function buildTouchCluster()
	local cluster = Instance.new("Frame")
	cluster.Name = "ActionCluster"
	cluster.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	cluster.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
	cluster.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
	cluster.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cluster.Parent = screen

	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1
	aspect.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Height
	aspect.Parent = cluster

	for _, spec in BUTTONS do
		local passThrough = spec.action == "Fire"
		local button = makeButton(spec, cluster, passThrough)
		if spec.action == "Ability" then
			abilityButton = button
		elseif spec.action == "Aim" then
			aimButton = button
		elseif spec.action == "Grenade" then
			local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			badge.Name = "Count"
			badge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			badge.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.14)
			badge.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.42)
			badge.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_CONTEXT
			badge.TextColor3 = COLOR_PANEL
			badge.FontFace = Theme.FONT.heavy
			badge.TextScaled = true
			corner(badge, UDim.new(0.5, 0))
			badge.Parent = button
			grenadeBadge = badge
		end
		local action = spec.action
		if action == "Aim" then
			-- A toggle on touch: holding a second thumb on MIRA while firing is awkward.
			bindHold(button, function()
				aiming = not aiming
				InputController.setAction("Aim", aiming)
			end, function() end)
			continue
		end
		bindHold(button, function()
			InputController.setAction(action, true)
			if action == "Jump" then
				jump()
			end
		end, function()
			InputController.setAction(action, false)
		end, passThrough)
	end

	-- Context button: only visible while a prompt is on screen; label mirrors the prompt.
	contextButton = makeButton({
		action = "Interact",
		label = "USAR",
		pos = Vector2.new(0.34, 0.32),
		size = 0.2,
		color = COLOR_CONTEXT,
	}, cluster)
	contextButton.TextColor3 = COLOR_PANEL
	contextButton.Visible = false
	bindHold(contextButton, function()
		InputController.setAction("Interact", true)
		if shownPrompt then
			holdingPrompt = shownPrompt
			shownPrompt:InputHoldBegin()
		end
	end, function()
		InputController.setAction("Interact", false)
		if holdingPrompt then
			holdingPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
			holdingPrompt = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function watchPrompts()
	ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt)
		shownPrompt = prompt
		contextButton.Text = Text.upper(prompt.ActionText)
		contextButton.Visible = true
	end)
	ProximityPromptService.PromptHidden:Connect(function(prompt)
		if prompt == shownPrompt then
			shownPrompt = nil
			contextButton.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

function MobileHUD.init()
	screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "SwarmHUD"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets
end

function MobileHUD.start()
	-- Always landscape on phones, whichever way the device is held (also set on StarterGui).
	player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui").ScreenOrientation = Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeSensor
	if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
		buildTouchCluster()
		watchPrompts()
		-- Our context button replaces the built-in prompt tap target.
		ProximityPromptService.MaxPromptsVisible = 1
		task.spawn(hideDefaultJump)
		-- Live button states: PODER's cooldown/ready ring, MIRA on/off, grenades left.
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			-- A menu or death can release Aim behind our back; keep the toggle in sync.
			if aiming and not InputController.isDown("Aim") then
				aiming = false
			end
			local aim = aimButton
			if aim then
				aim.BackgroundColor3 = if aiming then COLOR_READY else COLOR_PANEL
			end
			local badge = grenadeBadge
			if badge then
				local count = WeaponController.view.grenades
				badge.Text = tostring(count)
				badge.BackgroundColor3 = if count > 0
					then COLOR_CONTEXT
					else Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90)
			end
			local button = abilityButton
			if not button then
				return
			end
			local readyAt = player:GetAttribute("AbilityReadyAt")
			local left = if typeof(readyAt) == "number"
				then readyAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				else 0
			button.Text = if left > 0 then tostring(math.ceil(left)) else "PODER"
			button.TextTransparency = if left > 0 then 0.35 else 0
			local stroke = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if stroke then
				stroke.Color = if left > 0 then COLOR_TEXT else COLOR_READY
				stroke.Transparency = if left > 0 then 0.7 else 0
				stroke.Thickness = if left > 0 then 2 else 4
			end
		end)
	end

	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

return MobileHUD

--!strict
-- Animates map lights tagged Flicker on the client, so no property changes cross the network.
-- LightMode "fire" wavers with noise; "blink" pulses on and off (silo beacon).

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Tags = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Tags)
local Effects = require(script.Parent.Parent.Effects)

local AmbienceController = {}

type Flicker = {
	bulb: BasePart,
	light: PointLight,
	base: number,
	blink: boolean,
	seed: number,
	bulbTransparency: number,
}

local flickers: { [Instance]: Flicker } = {}

local function track(instance: Instance)
	if not instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local light = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
		or instance:WaitForChild("PointLight", 5)
	if not light or not light:IsA("PointLight") then
		return
	end
	local base = instance:GetAttribute("BaseBrightness")
	flickers[instance] = {
		bulb = instance,
		light = light,
		base = if typeof(base) == "number" then base else light.Brightness,
		blink = instance:GetAttribute("LightMode") == "blink",
		seed = math.random() * 100,
		bulbTransparency = instance.Transparency,
	}
end

local function step()
	local t = os.clock()
	for _, f in flickers do
		if f.blink then
			local on = math.sin(t * 4 + f.seed) > 0
			f.light.Brightness = if on then f.base else 0
			f.bulb.Transparency = if on then f.bulbTransparency else 0.8
		else
			-- math.noise is roughly [-0.5, 0.5]; two octaves read as a live flame.
			local n = math.noise(t * 5, f.seed) + 0.5 * math.noise(t * 13, f.seed + 10)
			f.light.Brightness = f.base * (0.85 + 0.45 * n)
		end
	end
end

function AmbienceController.start()
	Effects.start() -- camera shake and automatic effect quality
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Tags.Flicker):Connect(track)
	CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(Tags.Flicker):Connect(function(instance)
		flickers[instance] = nil
	end)
	for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged(Tags.Flicker) do
		task.spawn(track, instance)
	end
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(step)
end

return AmbienceController

--!strict
-- HUD look (docs/DEFINICOES.md §3): dark translucent panels with a yellow corner tab (the
-- "cut corner"), a condensed military face for numbers and labels (Oswald) and a rough
-- display face for announcements (Bangers). Every HUD builds its panels and text through here.

local Theme = {}

Theme.COLOR = table.freeze({
	panel = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(236, 232, 222),
	muted = Color3.fromRGB(160, 156, 148),
	accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0), -- interactive / economy
	danger = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40),
	player = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 230),
	fire = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 20),
})

Theme.FONT = table.freeze({
	label = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Oswald.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
	heavy = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Oswald.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold),
	display = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Bangers.json"),
})

export type TextStyle = "label" | "heavy" | "display"

-- A TextLabel in the house style; `props` are applied last and can override anything.
function Theme.text(parent: Instance, style: TextStyle, props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.text
	l.FontFace = Theme.FONT[style]
	l.TextScaled = true
	l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.75
	for key, value in props do
		(l :: any)[key] = value
	end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- Styles a frame as a HUD panel: dark glass, thin light edge and the yellow corner tab.
function Theme.panel(frame: GuiObject, transparency: number?)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.panel
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = transparency or 0.3
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Color = Theme.COLOR.text
	stroke.Transparency = 0.85
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- A square turned 45° and clipped by the panel reads as a cut, highlighted corner.
	local tab = Instance.new("Frame")
	tab.Name = "CornerTab"
	tab.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	tab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	tab.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
	tab.Rotation = 45
	tab.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent
	tab.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tab.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
	tab.Parent = frame
end

-- Big action button (shop, class cards): yellow fill, dark heavy text.
function Theme.button(button: TextButton)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent
	button.TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.panel
	button.FontFace = Theme.FONT.heavy
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

end

--!strict
-- Health bar over each barricade, driven by the Health/MaxHealth/Broken attributes the server
-- sets. Hidden at full health so a calm fort stays clean; shows "QUEBRADA" when down.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Tags = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Tags)

local BarricadeHUD = {}

local COLOR_FULL = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
local COLOR_LOW = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40)

local function number(part: Instance, name: string, default: number): number
	local value = part:GetAttribute(name)
	return if typeof(value) == "number" then value else default
end

local function track(instance: Instance)
	if not instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:FindFirstChild("BarricadeHealth") then
		return
	end
	local part = instance

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "BarricadeHealth"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(4, 0.5)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 1.2, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = 80
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Adornee = part

	local back = Instance.new("Frame")
	back.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
	back.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	back.BorderSizePixel = 0
	back.Parent = gui

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = back

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "QUEBRADA"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Parent = back

	local function refresh()
		local maxHealth = number(part, "MaxHealth", 1)
		local ratio = math.clamp(number(part, "Health", maxHealth) / maxHealth, 0, 1)
		local broken = part:GetAttribute("Broken") == true
		gui.Enabled = broken or ratio < 1
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_LOW:Lerp(COLOR_FULL, ratio)
		label.Visible = broken
	end

	part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(refresh)
	part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Broken"):Connect(refresh)
	refresh()
	gui.Parent = part
end

function BarricadeHUD.start()
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Tags.Barricade):Connect(track)
	for _, part in CollectionService:GetTagged(Tags.Barricade) do
		track(part)
	end
end

return BarricadeHUD

--!strict
-- Over-the-shoulder third-person camera. The character always faces where the camera looks
-- (shooter-style), the camera sits offset to the right shoulder, and aiming zooms the FOV.
-- On touch the default drag-to-look camera is kept; on PC the mouse is locked to the center.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Theme)

local CameraController = {}

local SHOULDER_OFFSET = Vector3.new(2.2, 1.2, 0)
local AIM_OFFSET = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.0, 0)
local FOV_DEFAULT = 70
local FOV_AIM = 50
local ZOOM_DISTANCE = 10
local TURN_SPEED = 18 -- higher = character snaps to camera yaw faster
local SPECTATE_DELAY = 2 -- seconds on your own body before the camera moves to a teammate

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local humanoid: Humanoid?
local root: BasePart?
local diedAt = 0
local spectating: Humanoid?
local spectateLabel: TextLabel

local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	local h = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	humanoid = h
	root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	h.AutoRotate = false
	h.CameraOffset = SHOULDER_OFFSET
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	camera.CameraSubject = h
	h.Died:Once(function()
		humanoid = nil
		root = nil
		diedAt = os.clock()
	end)
end

local function setAiming(aiming: boolean)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(camera, info, { FieldOfView = if aiming then FOV_AIM else FOV_DEFAULT })
		:Play()
	if humanoid then
		TweenService
			:Create(
				humanoid,
				info,
				{ CameraOffset = if aiming then AIM_OFFSET else SHOULDER_OFFSET }
			)
			:Play()
	end
end

-- While down, the camera follows a living teammate (the next one when they fall too) until
-- you respawn. With nobody left alive it stays where it is.
local function isAlive(h: Humanoid?): boolean
	return h ~= nil and h.Health > 0 and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
end

local function updateSpectate()
	if humanoid or os.clock() - diedAt < SPECTATE_DELAY then
		spectating = nil
		spectateLabel.Visible = false
		return
	end
	if not isAlive(spectating) then
		spectating = nil
		for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local h = other ~= player
				and other.Character
				and other.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if h and isAlive(h) then
				spectating = h
				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				camera.CameraSubject = h
				spectateLabel.Text = "OBSERVANDO: " .. other.DisplayName
				break
			end
		end
	end
	spectateLabel.Visible = spectating ~= nil
end

local function step(dt: number)
	updateSpectate()
	if InputController.isModalOpen() then
		-- A menu is open: give the mouse back so its buttons can be clicked.
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	elseif not UserInputService.TouchEnabled or UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	end

	local h, r = humanoid, root
	if not (h and r) or h.Sit then
		return
	end

	-- Rotate the character toward the camera's flat look direction.
	local look = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
	local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		return
	end
	local target = CFrame.lookAt(r.Position, r.Position + flat)
	r.CFrame = r.CFrame:Lerp(target, math.min(1, dt * TURN_SPEED))
end

function CameraController.init()
	player.CameraMinZoomDistance = ZOOM_DISTANCE
	player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = ZOOM_DISTANCE

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "Spectate"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.DisplayOrder = 3
	spectateLabel = Theme.text(screen, "heavy", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -24),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 28),
		Visible = false,
	})
	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

function CameraController.start()
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)

	InputController.actionChanged:connect(function(action, isDown)
		if action == "Aim" then
			setAiming(isDown)
		end
	end)

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("SwarmCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, step)
end

return CameraController

--!strict
-- Match HUD: a top-center banner (phase, wave, timer or zombies left), the Brute's health bar,
-- a big announcement on every phase change, the "you're down" notice, the result screen, the
-- lobby's PRONTO button and the notice for players who joined a match already under way.
-- Everything is read from the attributes MatchService sets on ReplicatedStorage.Match (and the
-- player's own InMatch / Ready attributes).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Theme)

local MatchHUD = {}

local COLOR_PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
local COLOR_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
local COLOR_DANGER = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40)
local COLOR_GOOD = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 230)
local COLOR_WARN = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local state: Instance
local screen: ScreenGui
local titleLabel: TextLabel
local detailLabel: TextLabel
local bossFrame: Frame
local bossFill: Frame
local announce: TextLabel
local downLabel: TextLabel
local result: Frame
local resultTitle: TextLabel
local resultStats: TextLabel
local lobbyScreen: ScreenGui
local readyButton: TextButton
local hubButton: TextButton
local lateLabel: TextLabel

local function attr<T>(name: string, default: T): T
	local value = state:GetAttribute(name)
	return if value ~= nil then value :: any else default
end

local function text(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
	l.FontFace = Theme.FONT.heavy
	l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.75
	l.TextScaled = true
	for key, value in props do
		(l :: any)[key] = value
	end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local function build()
	local banner = Instance.new("Frame")
	banner.Name = "Banner"
	banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	banner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12)
	banner.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.1)
	Theme.panel(banner)
	banner.Parent = screen
	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 4
	aspect.Parent = banner

	titleLabel =
		text(banner, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.08), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.5) })
	detailLabel = text(banner, {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.58),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.34),
		TextTransparency = 0.15,
	})

	bossFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	bossFrame.Name = "Boss"
	bossFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	bossFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12)
	bossFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.36, 0.03)
	bossFrame.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_PANEL
	bossFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	bossFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bossFrame.Visible = false
	bossFrame.Parent = screen
	bossFill = Instance.new("Frame")
	bossFill.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_DANGER
	bossFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bossFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	bossFill.Parent = bossFrame
	text(bossFrame, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "BRUTE", ZIndex = 2 })
	-- Sits right under the banner.
	banner:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		bossFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12 + banner.AbsoluteSize.Y + 6)
	end)

	announce = text(screen, {
		FontFace = Theme.FONT.display,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.3),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.1),
		TextTransparency = 1,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
	})

	downLabel = text(screen, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.62),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.05),
		Text = "VOCÊ CAIU — VOLTA NA PRÓXIMA PREPARAÇÃO",
		TextColor3 = COLOR_DANGER,
		Visible = false,
	})

	lateLabel = text(screen, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.62),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.05),
		TextColor3 = COLOR_WARN,
		Visible = false,
	})

	-- Its own ScreenGui above the class picker, so PRONTO stays reachable with it open.
	lobbyScreen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	lobbyScreen.Name = "LobbyUI"
	lobbyScreen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	lobbyScreen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	lobbyScreen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets
	lobbyScreen.DisplayOrder = 6
	readyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	readyButton.Name = "Ready"
	readyButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	readyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -16)
	readyButton.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 0.1)
	readyButton.Visible = false
	Theme.button(readyButton)
	readyButton.Parent = lobbyScreen
	local readyAspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	readyAspect.AspectRatio = 3.2
	readyAspect.Parent = readyButton
	readyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		Net.setReady():FireServer(player:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
	end)

	-- Back to the camp hub: in the lobby, while spectating, or on the result screen.
	hubButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hubButton.Name = "BackToHub"
	hubButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	hubButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.88, -24)
	hubButton.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.055)
	hubButton.Text = "VOLTAR AO ACAMPAMENTO"
	hubButton.Visible = false
	Theme.button(hubButton)
	hubButton.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_PANEL
	hubButton.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
	hubButton.Parent = lobbyScreen
	hubButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		Net.returnToHub():FireServer()
	end)

	result = Instance.new("Frame")
	result.Name = "Result"
	result.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	result.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	result.Visible = false
	result.ZIndex = 5
	result.Parent = screen
	resultTitle = text(result, {
		FontFace = Theme.FONT.display,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.35),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.14),
		ZIndex = 6,
	})
	resultStats = text(result, {
		FontFace = Theme.FONT.label,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.47),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.3),
		TextScaled = false,
		TextSize = 22,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		ZIndex = 6,
	})
end

local function flashAnnouncement(message: string, color: Color3)
	announce.Text = message
	announce.TextColor3 = color
	announce.TextTransparency = 0
	announce.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	local fade = TweenService:Create(
		announce,
		TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, 2),
		{ TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }
	)
	fade:Play()
end

local function killsTable(): string
	local rows = {}
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	local function kills(p: Player): number
		local leaderstats = p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local value = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Abates")
		return if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then value.Value else 0
	end
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		return kills(a) > kills(b)
	end)
	for _, p in players do
		table.insert(rows, string.format("%s — %d abates", p.DisplayName, kills(p)))
	end
	return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

local function onPhaseChanged()
	local phase = attr("Phase", "Waiting")
	local wave = attr("Wave", 0)
	if phase == "Prep" then
		flashAnnouncement("PREPARAÇÃO", COLOR_WARN)
	elseif phase == "Wave" then
		flashAnnouncement("ONDA " .. wave, COLOR_DANGER)
	elseif phase == "Final" then
		flashAnnouncement("ONDA FINAL", COLOR_DANGER)
	elseif phase == "Extract" then
		flashAnnouncement("CORRA PARA O HELICÓPTERO!", COLOR_GOOD)
	end

	result.Visible = phase == "Result"
	if phase == "Result" then
		local victory = attr("Outcome", "") == "Victory"
		resultTitle.Text = if victory then "EXTRAÍDOS!" else "A HORDA VENCEU"
		resultTitle.TextColor3 = if victory then COLOR_GOOD else COLOR_DANGER
		-- XP is awarded as the match ends; give the attribute a moment to arrive.
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			local xp = player:GetAttribute("MatchXP")
			local level = player:GetAttribute("Level")
			local summary = if typeof(xp) == "number"
				then string.format("+%d XP  ·  Nível %s\n\n", xp, tostring(level or 1))
				else ""
			resultStats.Text = summary .. killsTable()
		end)
	end
end

-- Shown by Roblox while the teleport back to the camp loads.
local function teleportScreen(): ScreenGui
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "TeleportScreen"
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	local back = Instance.new("Frame")
	back.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 12)
	back.Parent = gui
	text(back, {
		FontFace = Theme.FONT.display,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.1),
		Text = "VOLTANDO AO ACAMPAMENTO…",
		TextColor3 = COLOR_WARN,
	})
	return gui
end

local function timeLeft(): number
	local endsAt = attr("EndsAt", 0)
	if endsAt <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

local function clock(seconds: number): string
	local s = math.ceil(seconds)
	return string.format("%d:%02d", s // 60, s % 60)
end

local function update()
	local phase = attr("Phase", "Waiting")
	local wave = attr("Wave", 0)
	local waves = attr("Waves", 10)
	local left = timeLeft()

	if phase == "Lobby" then
		titleLabel.Text = "LOBBY"
		detailLabel.Text = string.format(
			"Começa em %s — %d/%d prontos",
			clock(left),
			attr("ReadyCount", 0),
			attr("LobbyCount", 0)
		)
	elseif phase == "Prep" then
		titleLabel.Text = "PREPARAÇÃO"
		detailLabel.Text = "Repare barricadas e reabasteça — " .. clock(left)
	elseif phase == "Wave" then
		titleLabel.Text = string.format("ONDA %d / %d", wave, waves)
		detailLabel.Text = string.format("%d zumbis restantes", attr("Remaining", 0))
	elseif phase == "Final" then
		titleLabel.Text = string.format("ONDA FINAL %d / %d", waves, waves)
		detailLabel.Text = "Helicóptero em " .. clock(left)
	elseif phase == "Extract" then
		titleLabel.Text = "EXTRAÇÃO"
		detailLabel.Text = "Chegue ao helicóptero ao norte — " .. clock(left)
	elseif phase == "Result" then
		titleLabel.Text = "FIM DE PARTIDA"
		detailLabel.Text = "Nova partida em " .. clock(left)
	else
		titleLabel.Text = "AGUARDANDO"
		detailLabel.Text = ""
	end

	local bossMax = attr("BossMaxHealth", 0)
	local bossHealth = attr("BossHealth", 0)
	bossFrame.Visible = bossMax > 0 and bossHealth > 0
	if bossMax > 0 then
		bossFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(bossHealth / bossMax, 0, 1), 1)
	end

	local ready = player:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	readyButton.Visible = phase == "Lobby"
	readyButton.Text = if ready then "PRONTO ✓" else "PRONTO"
	readyButton.BackgroundColor3 = if ready then COLOR_GOOD else COLOR_WARN

	local inMatch = player:GetAttribute("InMatch") == true
	local underWay = phase ~= "Lobby" and phase ~= "Waiting" and phase ~= "Result"
	hubButton.Visible = Config.PLACES.hub > 0
		and Config.PLACES.hub ~= game.PlaceId
		and (phase == "Lobby" or phase == "Result" or (underWay and not inMatch))
	lateLabel.Visible = underWay and not inMatch
	if lateLabel.Visible then
		lateLabel.Text = string.format(
			"PARTIDA EM ANDAMENTO (ONDA %d/%d) — VOCÊ ENTRA NA PRÓXIMA",
			math.max(wave, 1),
			waves
		)
	end

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local inCombat = phase == "Wave" or phase == "Final" or phase == "Extract"
	downLabel.Visible = inMatch and inCombat and (not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0)
end

function MatchHUD.init()
	screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "MatchHUD"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets
	build()
end

function MatchHUD.start()
	state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Match")
	state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(onPhaseChanged)
	onPhaseChanged()
	-- Timers tick every frame; cheap (a few text writes).
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(update)
	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	lobbyScreen.Parent = screen.Parent
	TeleportService:SetTeleportGui(teleportScreen())
end

return MatchHUD

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.source:

--!strict
-- Shared type definitions. Types that cross the client/server boundary
-- (remote payloads, profile schema) live here so both sides agree.

export type ZombieKind = "Runner" | "Bull" | "Creeper" | "Brute"
export type ClassId = "Gunslinger" | "Exterminator"

export type PlayerProfile = {
	version: number,
	xp: number,
	coins: number,
	unlockedWeapons: { string },
}

-- Server → client weapon snapshot (Net.weaponSync).
export type WeaponState = {
	gun: string,
	melee: string,
	mag: number,
	reserve: number,
	grenades: number,
	reloading: boolean,
	shotSeq: number, -- last shot the server processed; the client re-applies newer ones
}

-- Match flow (MatchService); replicated as attributes on ReplicatedStorage.Match.
export type MatchPhase = "Waiting" | "Lobby" | "Prep" | "Wave" | "Final" | "Extract" | "Result"

return nil

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Hitscan.source:
--!strict
-- Hit geometry shared by client and server. Zombies have no parts on the server, so both
-- sides test rays against the same analytic shapes: a vertical cylinder for the body and a
-- sphere for the head, scaled per zombie kind. Map line-of-sight ignores barricades and
-- ShootThrough parts (rail fences), which players shoot through.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Tags = require(script.Parent.Tags)

local Hitscan = {}

local BODY_RADIUS = 1
local BODY_TOP = 4
local HEAD_HEIGHT = 4.6
local HEAD_RADIUS = 0.8

Hitscan.CHEST_HEIGHT = 3

local mapParams: RaycastParams? = nil

local function params(): RaycastParams?
	if mapParams then
		return mapParams
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if not map then
		return nil
	end
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = { map }
	mapParams = p
	return p
end

-- Distance along a unit ray to the zombie standing at `feet`, or nil. Second value is true
-- when the closest hit is the head.
function Hitscan.rayZombie(
	origin: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	maxDistance: number,
	feet: Vector3,
	scale: number
): (number?, boolean)
	local best: number? = nil
	local head = false

	-- Head sphere.
	local toOrigin = origin - (feet + Vector3.new(0, HEAD_HEIGHT * scale, 0))
	local r = HEAD_RADIUS * scale
	local b = toOrigin:Dot(direction)
	local disc = b * b - (toOrigin:Dot(toOrigin) - r * r)
	if disc >= 0 then
		local s = math.sqrt(disc)
		local t = if -b - s >= 0 then -b - s else -b + s
		if t >= 0 and t <= maxDistance then
			best, head = t, true
		end
	end

	-- Body cylinder (XZ circle, clipped to [feet, BODY_TOP]).
	local ox, oz = origin.X - feet.X, origin.Z - feet.Z
	local dx, dz = direction.X, direction.Z
	local a = dx * dx + dz * dz
	if a > 1e-6 then
		local rb = BODY_RADIUS * scale
		local bb = ox * dx + oz * dz
		local disc2 = bb * bb - a * (ox * ox + oz * oz - rb * rb)
		if disc2 >= 0 then
			local s = math.sqrt(disc2)
			for _, t in { (-bb - s) / a, (-bb + s) / a } do
				if t >= 0 and t <= maxDistance and (best == nil or t < best) then
					local y = origin.Y + direction.Y * t - feet.Y
					if y >= 0 and y <= BODY_TOP * scale then
						best, head = t, false
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return best, head
end

local function shootThrough(instance: Instance): boolean
	return CollectionService:HasTag(instance, Tags.Barricade)
		or CollectionService:HasTag(instance, Tags.ShootThrough)
end

-- Distance along a unit ray to the first solid map surface, capped at max.
function Hitscan.mapDistance(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, maxDistance: number): number
	local p = params()
	if not p then
		return maxDistance
	end
	local travelled = 0
	local from = origin
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local result = workspace:Raycast(from, direction * (maxDistance - travelled), p)
		if not result then
			return maxDistance
		end
		travelled += result.Distance
		if not shootThrough(result.Instance) then
			return travelled
		end
		from = result.Position + direction * 0.05
		travelled += 0.05
		if travelled >= maxDistance then
			return maxDistance
		end
	end
	return travelled
end

function Hitscan.clearLine(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	local offset = to - from
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	if distance < 1e-3 then
		return true
	end
	return Hitscan.mapDistance(from, offset / distance, distance) >= distance - 0.5
end

-- Visible if either the chest or the head can be seen (fences hide legs, not heads).
function Hitscan.canSeeZombie(eye: Vector3, feet: Vector3, scale: number): boolean
	return Hitscan.clearLine(eye, feet + Vector3.new(0, HEAD_HEIGHT * scale, 0))
		or Hitscan.clearLine(eye, feet + Vector3.new(0, Hitscan.CHEST_HEIGHT * scale, 0))
end

return Hitscan

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net.source:
--!strict
-- Remote registry. The server creates every remote on first access; clients wait for them.
-- Names are listed once here so both sides can't drift.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local IS_SERVER = RunService:IsServer()

local function folder(): Instance
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	if not IS_SERVER then
		return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = "Remotes"
	f.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	return f
end

local function get(name: string, className: string): Instance
	local parent = folder()
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	if not IS_SERVER then
		return parent:WaitForChild(name)
	end
	local remote = Instance.new(className)
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = parent
	return remote
end

local Net = {}

-- Server → clients, 10 Hz, buffer from ZombiePacket. Unreliable: a lost packet is replaced
-- by the next one 100 ms later.
function Net.zombieState(): UnreliableRemoteEvent
	return get("ZombieState", "UnreliableRemoteEvent") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
end

-- Server → clients, reliable: { number } ids of zombies that died/despawned.
function Net.zombieRemoved(): RemoteEvent
	return get("ZombieRemoved", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server: (shotSeq: number, hits: { { id: number, head: boolean } }). One per shot,
-- misses included, so the server's ammo count follows the client's.
function Net.fireWeapon(): RemoteEvent
	return get("FireWeapon", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server, no payload.
function Net.reload(): RemoteEvent
	return get("Reload", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server, no payload. The server finds the targets itself.
function Net.melee(): RemoteEvent
	return get("Melee", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server: (direction: Vector3, unit).
function Net.throwGrenade(): RemoteEvent
	return get("ThrowGrenade", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Server → client: authoritative WeaponState. Client → server (no payload): request one.
function Net.weaponSync(): RemoteEvent
	return get("WeaponSync", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server: (classId: string). Only during a Prep phase.
function Net.selectClass(): RemoteEvent
	return get("SelectClass", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server: leave this map for the camp hub (no arguments).
function Net.returnToHub(): RemoteEvent
	return get("ReturnToHub", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server: PRONTO toggled in the lobby (boolean).
function Net.setReady(): RemoteEvent
	return get("SetReady", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server: (aim: Vector3, unit camera direction for thrown abilities).
function Net.useAbility(): RemoteEvent
	return get("UseAbility", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server: (itemId: string), from Config.SHOP.
function Net.purchase(): RemoteEvent
	return get("Purchase", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Server → client: (message: string) shown as a short toast.
function Net.notify(): RemoteEvent
	return get("Notify", "RemoteEvent") :: RemoteEvent
end

-- Server → clients, unreliable: (from: Vector3, to: Vector3) tracer for a turret shot.
function Net.turretShot(): UnreliableRemoteEvent
	return get("TurretShot", "UnreliableRemoteEvent") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
end

-- Server → clients, unreliable: (shooter: Player, gun: string) so others hear a shot.
function Net.shotFx(): UnreliableRemoteEvent
	return get("ShotFx", "UnreliableRemoteEvent") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
end

-- Client → server, unreliable: (pitch: number) where the player aims, radians. The server
-- copies it to the character's AimPitch attribute for everyone's pose.
function Net.aimPitch(): UnreliableRemoteEvent
	return get("AimPitch", "UnreliableRemoteEvent") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
end

-- Server → clients, unreliable: (player, action: "shot" | "reload" | "melee" | "throw",
-- gun: string) so every client can animate that player's character.
function Net.characterFx(): UnreliableRemoteEvent
	return get("CharacterFx", "UnreliableRemoteEvent") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
end

return Net

--!strict
-- Binary format for zombie replication. 11 bytes per zombie:
--   u16 id | u8 kind | u8 state | i16 x | i16 y | i16 z (decistuds) | u8 yaw (256 steps)
-- Packets are capped so a single UnreliableRemoteEvent payload stays under its ~900 byte limit.

local ZombiePacket = {}

ZombiePacket.RECORD_SIZE = 11
ZombiePacket.MAX_PER_PACKET = 70

export type State = number
ZombiePacket.STATE_WALK = 0
ZombiePacket.STATE_ATTACK = 1
ZombiePacket.STATE_IDLE = 2
ZombiePacket.STATE_CLIMB = 3 -- running up a pile and over a wall
ZombiePacket.STATE_PILE = 4 -- part of a pyramid against a wall
ZombiePacket.STATE_CHARGE = 5 -- Bull mid-charge
ZombiePacket.STATE_FUSE = 6 -- Creeper about to explode
ZombiePacket.STATE_WINDUP = 7 -- Bull scraping before a charge, Brute with a rock raised

export type Record = {
	id: number,
	kind: number,
	state: number,
	position: Vector3,
	yaw: number, -- radians
}

local TAU = math.pi * 2

local function quantize(v: number): number
	return math.clamp(math.round(v * 10), -32768, 32767)
end

function ZombiePacket.encode(records: { Record }, first: number, last: number): buffer
	local b = buffer.create((last - first + 1) * ZombiePacket.RECORD_SIZE)
	local offset = 0
	for i = first, last do
		local r = records[i]
		buffer.writeu16(b, offset, r.id)
		buffer.writeu8(b, offset + 2, r.kind)
		buffer.writeu8(b, offset + 3, r.state)
		buffer.writei16(b, offset + 4, quantize(r.position.X))
		buffer.writei16(b, offset + 6, quantize(r.position.Y))
		buffer.writei16(b, offset + 8, quantize(r.position.Z))
		buffer.writeu8(b, offset + 10, math.round((r.yaw % TAU) / TAU * 256) % 256)
		offset += ZombiePacket.RECORD_SIZE
	end
	return b
end

-- Calls `visit` once per record. Malformed buffers (wrong length) are ignored entirely.
function ZombiePacket.decode(
	b: buffer,
	visit: (
		id: number,
		kind: number,
		state: number,
		position: Vector3,
		yaw: number
	) -> ()
)
	local len = buffer.len(b)
	if len % ZombiePacket.RECORD_SIZE ~= 0 then
		return
	end
	for offset = 0, len - 1, ZombiePacket.RECORD_SIZE do
		visit(
			buffer.readu16(b, offset),
			buffer.readu8(b, offset + 2),
			buffer.readu8(b, offset + 3),
			Vector3.new(
				buffer.readi16(b, offset + 4) / 10,
				buffer.readi16(b, offset + 6) / 10,
				buffer.readi16(b, offset + 8) / 10
			),
			buffer.readu8(b, offset + 10) / 256 * TAU
		)
	end
end

return ZombiePacket
