ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Text.source:
--!strict
-- Text helpers. string.upper only knows ASCII, so Portuguese accents would stay lowercase
-- ("MUNIçãO"); upper() also maps the accented letters the game's texts use.

local Text = {}

local ACCENTS: { [string]: string } = {
	["á"] = "Á",
	["à"] = "À",
	["â"] = "Â",
	["ã"] = "Ã",
	["é"] = "É",
	["ê"] = "Ê",
	["í"] = "Í",
	["ó"] = "Ó",
	["ô"] = "Ô",
	["õ"] = "Õ",
	["ú"] = "Ú",
	["ç"] = "Ç",
}

function Text.upper(s: string): string
	local upper = string.upper(s)
	for lower, capital in ACCENTS do
		upper = string.gsub(upper, lower, capital)
	end
	return upper
end

return Text

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Signal.source:
--!strict
-- Minimal synchronous signal. Handlers run in order; disconnect via the returned function.

export type Signal<T...> = {
	connect: (self: Signal<T...>, handler: (T...) -> ()) -> () -> (),
	fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
}

local Signal = {}

function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
	local handlers: { (T...) -> () } = {}

	local function connect(_: Signal<T...>, handler: (T...) -> ()): () -> ()
		table.insert(handlers, handler)
		return function()
			local index = table.find(handlers, handler)
			if index then
				table.remove(handlers, index)
			end
		end
	end

	local function fire(_: Signal<T...>, ...: T...)
		for _, handler in table.clone(handlers) do
			handler(...)
		end
	end

	return { connect = connect, fire = fire } :: Signal<T...>
end

return Signal

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Art.FarmEnviron.source:
--!strict
-- Visual dressing for the existing farm: no terrain edits, tags, collision or queries.
-- Geometry stays below eye level in the yard; distant silhouettes sit outside combat.
local FarmEnvironment = {}

local MUD = Color3.fromRGB(64, 55, 45)
local WET = Color3.fromRGB(38, 47, 53)
local BARK = Color3.fromRGB(58, 45, 34)
local GRASS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(105, 100, 49),
	Color3.fromRGB(126, 112, 58),
	Color3.fromRGB(77, 83, 43),
	Color3.fromRGB(147, 125, 67),
}
local STONE = {
	Color3.fromRGB(89, 88, 81),
	Color3.fromRGB(103, 99, 85),
	Color3.fromRGB(70, 76, 77),
}

local function piece(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	cframe: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	wedge: boolean?
): BasePart
	local p: BasePart = if wedge then Instance.new("WedgePart") else Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cframe
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CastShadow = size.Y > 1.5
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function branch(parent: Instance, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, thickness: number)
	piece(
		parent,
		"DeadBranch",
		Vector3.new(thickness, thickness * 0.85, (b - a).Magnitude),
		CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(15)),
		BARK,
		Enum.Material.Wood
	)
end

local function tuft(parent: Instance, rng: Random, position: Vector3, height: number)
	for blade = 1, 3 do
		local h = height * rng:NextNumber(0.65, 1)
		piece(
			parent,
			"DryGrass",
			Vector3.new(0.12, h, rng:NextNumber(0.6, 1.1)),
			CFrame.new(
				position + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-0.4, 0.4), h / 2, rng:NextNumber(-0.4, 0.4))
			)
				* CFrame.Angles(
					0,
					math.rad(blade * 115 + rng:NextNumber(-25, 25)),
					math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-15, 15))
				),
			GRASS[rng:NextInteger(1, #GRASS)],
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			true
		)
	end
end

local function road(parent: Instance, rng: Random, from: Vector3, to: Vector3, width: number)
	local delta = to - from
	local direction = delta.Unit
	local right = Vector3.new(-direction.Z, 0, direction.X)
	local steps = 14
	for i = 0, steps - 1 do
		local t = (i + 0.5) / steps
		local center = from:Lerp(to, t) + right * math.sin(t * math.pi * 3) * 0.6
		local length = delta.Magnitude / steps + 0.7
		piece(
			parent,
			"WornMud",
			Vector3.new(width + rng:NextNumber(-1, 1.6), 0.045, length),
			CFrame.lookAt(
				center + Vector3.new(0, 0.275, 0),
				center + direction + Vector3.new(0, 0.275, 0)
			),
			MUD:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(83, 70, 51), rng:NextNumber(0, 0.45)),
			Enum.Material.Mud
		)
		-- Sparse puddles follow the wheel ruts, with jagged mud edges between them.
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			local p = center + right * rng:NextNumber(-width * 0.28, width * 0.28)
			local puddle = piece(
				parent,
				"RainPuddle",
				Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(1.2, 2.3), 0.035, rng:NextNumber(2.2, 4.1)),
				CFrame.lookAt(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.32, 0), p + direction + Vector3.new(0, 0.32, 0))
					* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-12, 12)), 0),
				WET,
				Enum.Material.Glass
			)
			puddle.Transparency = 0.12
			puddle.Reflectance = 0.16
			puddle.CastShadow = false
		end
		for side = -1, 1, 2 do
			local edge = center + right * side * (width / 2 + rng:NextNumber(0.6, 2.5))
			tuft(parent, rng, edge + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0), rng:NextNumber(0.75, 1.3))
		end
	end
	for _ = 1, 28 do
		local p = from:Lerp(to, rng:NextNumber(0.03, 0.97))
			+ right * rng:NextNumber(-width * 0.65, width * 0.65)
		local h = rng:NextNumber(0.12, 0.3)
		piece(
			parent,
			"RoadStone",
			Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(0.6, 1.5), h, rng:NextNumber(0.5, 1.4)),
			CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.33 + h / 2, 0))
				* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-8, 8)), rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi), 0),
			STONE[rng:NextInteger(1, #STONE)],
			Enum.Material.Slate,
			true
		)
	end
end

local function deadTree(parent: Instance, rng: Random, base: Vector3, height: number)
	local lean = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5), 0, rng:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5))
	local lower = base + Vector3.new(0, height * 0.45, 0)
	local upper = base + lean + Vector3.new(0, height * 0.8, 0)
	local top = base + lean * 1.4 + Vector3.new(0, height + 2, 0)
	branch(parent, base, lower, 1.8)
	branch(parent, lower, upper, 1.25)
	branch(parent, upper, top, 0.8)
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local angle = i * 2.35 + rng:NextNumber(-0.3, 0.3)
		local from = base + Vector3.new(0, height * (0.33 + i * 0.075), 0) + lean * 0.4
		local reach = rng:NextNumber(3, 5.5)
		local elbow = from
			+ Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * reach * 0.7, reach * 0.4, math.sin(angle) * reach * 0.7)
		local tip = elbow
			+ Vector3.new(
				math.cos(angle + 0.35) * reach * 0.5,
				reach * 0.65,
				math.sin(angle + 0.35) * reach * 0.5
			)
		branch(parent, from, elbow, 0.65)
		branch(parent, elbow, tip, 0.32)
	end
end

local function conifer(parent: Instance, base: Vector3, height: number, yaw: number)
	piece(
		parent,
		"PineTrunk",
		Vector3.new(1, height * 0.6, 1),
		CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, height * 0.3, 0)),
		BARK,
		Enum.Material.Wood
	)
	for tier = 1, 3 do
		local width = height * (0.44 - tier * 0.075)
		local h = height * 0.42
		local y = height * (0.16 + tier * 0.2)
		local color = Color3.fromRGB(34 + tier * 4, 48 + tier * 5, 43 + tier * 5)
		for side = -1, 1, 2 do
			piece(
				parent,
				"PineCrown",
				Vector3.new(width, h, width / 2),
				CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, y, 0))
					* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
					* CFrame.new(0, 0, side * width / 4)
					* CFrame.Angles(0, if side > 0 then math.pi else 0, 0),
				color,
				Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
				true
			)
		end
	end
end

local function weedCluster(parent: Instance, rng: Random, base: Vector3)
	-- Wide leaves overlap into one low silhouette instead of isolated tiny flecks.
	local rotation = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
	for leaf = 1, 6 do
		local angle = rotation + leaf * math.pi / 3
		local length = rng:NextNumber(1.9, 2.8)
		local offset = Vector3.new(math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle)) * length * 0.25
		piece(
			parent,
			"BroadleafWeed",
			Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(0.8, 1.2), 0.35, length),
			CFrame.new(base + offset + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0))
				* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(12), angle, math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-8, 8))),
			GRASS[rng:NextInteger(1, #GRASS)],
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			true
		)
	end
	for stem = 1, 3 do
		local angle = rotation + stem * 2.1
		tuft(parent, rng, base + Vector3.new(math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle)) * 1.3, 1.15)
	end
end

local function ridge(
	parent: Instance,
	base: Vector3,
	angle: number,
	width: number,
	depth: number,
	height: number,
	color: Color3
)
	-- The triangular end faces the farm: local X follows the radial direction.
	-- Each wedge's high edge meets at local Z=0, producing a pointed peak.
	for side = -1, 1, 2 do
		piece(
			parent,
			"DistantRidge",
			Vector3.new(depth, height, width / 2),
			CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, height / 2 - 3, 0))
				* CFrame.Angles(0, -angle, 0)
				* CFrame.new(0, 0, side * width / 4)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, if side > 0 then math.pi else 0, 0),
			color,
			Enum.Material.Slate,
			true
		)
	end
end

function FarmEnvironment.build(parent: Instance)
	local rng = Random.new(24102026)
	road(parent, rng, Vector3.new(0, 0, 58), Vector3.new(-26, 0, 12), 6)
	road(parent, rng, Vector3.new(0, 0, 58), Vector3.new(13, 0, 14), 7.5)
	task.wait()

	-- Weeds along existing fences and building foundations, away from the gateways.
	for i = 1, 124 do
		local side = i % 4
		local p: Vector3
		if side == 0 then
			p = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-55, -14), 0.2, rng:NextNumber(52, 58))
		elseif side == 1 then
			p = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(18, 55), 0.2, rng:NextNumber(52, 58))
		elseif side == 2 then
			p = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-56, -48), 0.2, rng:NextNumber(-48, 45))
		else
			p = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(49, 57), 0.2, rng:NextNumber(-42, 45))
		end
		tuft(parent, rng, p, rng:NextNumber(0.85, 1.3))
	end
	for _, base in
		{
			Vector3.new(-43, 0.2, 7),
			Vector3.new(-48, 0.2, 54),
			Vector3.new(-36, 0.2, 55),
			Vector3.new(-23, 0.2, 54),
			Vector3.new(24, 0.2, 55),
			Vector3.new(38, 0.2, 54),
			Vector3.new(50, 0.2, 54),
			Vector3.new(-55, 0.2, -38),
			Vector3.new(-55, 0.2, 8),
			Vector3.new(-55, 0.2, 38),
			Vector3.new(54, 0.2, -30),
			Vector3.new(54, 0.2, 0),
			Vector3.new(54, 0.2, 25),
			Vector3.new(-40, 0.2, -28),
			Vector3.new(-28, 0.2, -28),
			Vector3.new(-16, 0.2, -28),
			Vector3.new(49, 0.2, -4),
			Vector3.new(49, 0.2, 14),
			Vector3.new(24, 0.2, 36),
			Vector3.new(38, 0.2, 36),
		}
	do
		weedCluster(parent, rng, base)
	end
	task.wait()

	for i, base in
		{
			Vector3.new(70, 0, 25),
			Vector3.new(-72, 0, -30),
			Vector3.new(35, 0, 72),
			Vector3.new(-70, 0, 62),
		}
	do
		deadTree(parent, rng, base, 12 + (i % 3) * 3)
	end
	-- A broken skyline outside the 240-stud navigation grid.
	for i = 0, 31 do
		local angle = i * math.pi * 2 / 32 + 0.06
		local radius = rng:NextNumber(250, 282)
		conifer(
			parent,
			Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius),
			rng:NextNumber(20, 34),
			angle
		)
	end
	task.wait()
	for i = 0, 13 do
		local angle = math.pi * (0.85 + i / 13 * 1.3)
		local radius = rng:NextNumber(275, 288)
		local h = rng:NextNumber(25, 45)
		local w = rng:NextNumber(38, 64)
		local base = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
		local color = Color3.fromRGB(55 + i % 3 * 8, 67 + i % 3 * 7, 79 + i % 3 * 7)
		ridge(parent, base, angle, w, rng:NextNumber(25, 35), h, color)
		local tangent = Vector3.new(-math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle))
		local secondaryBase = base
			+ tangent * w * rng:NextNumber(0.35, 0.5)
			+ Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * rng:NextNumber(3, 8)
		ridge(
			parent,
			secondaryBase,
			angle + 0.08,
			w * 0.65,
			25,
			h * rng:NextNumber(0.55, 0.8),
			color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 64), 0.2)
		)
	end
end

return FarmEnvironment

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Art.FarmNightLi.source:
--!strict
-- Moonlit blue ambience with warm practical lights supplied by the map.
-- Called after FarmMap's original lighting setup; this adjusts those effects in place.
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local FarmNightLighting = {}

function FarmNightLighting.apply()
	-- Place the moon above the northern skyline, visible from the farm entrance.
	Lighting.ClockTime = 22
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = -35
	Lighting.Brightness = 1.7
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.2
	-- Keep outdoor silhouettes readable on mobile, including when post effects are disabled.
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(95, 115, 145)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.35
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.6
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.55

	local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
	if not atmosphere then
		atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
		atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
	end
	atmosphere.Density = 0.29
	atmosphere.Offset = 0.12
	atmosphere.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 157, 196)
	atmosphere.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(52, 80, 121)
	atmosphere.Glare = 0.08
	atmosphere.Haze = 1.5

	local grade = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	if not grade then
		grade = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		grade.Parent = Lighting
	end
	grade.Enabled = true
	grade.Brightness = 0
	grade.Contrast = 0.08
	grade.Saturation = -0.12
	-- A restrained tint leaves the lamps orange instead of washing the whole scene blue.
	grade.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 242, 255)

	local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BloomEffect")
	if not bloom then
		bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
		bloom.Parent = Lighting
	end
	bloom.Enabled = true
	bloom.Intensity = 0.22
	bloom.Size = 24
	bloom.Threshold = 1.8

	-- Use Studio's built-in Sky defaults, including its moon; no external asset dependency.
	local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
	if not sky then
		sky = Instance.new("Sky")
		sky.Name = "FarmMoonSky"
		sky.Parent = Lighting
	end
	sky.CelestialBodiesShown = true
	sky.MoonAngularSize = 12
	sky.SunAngularSize = 8
	sky.StarCount = 450

	local clouds = workspace.Terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
	if not clouds then
		clouds = Instance.new("Clouds")
		clouds.Name = "FarmMoonClouds"
		clouds.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	end
	clouds.Enabled = true
	clouds.Cover = 0.7
	clouds.Density = 0.48
	clouds.Color = Color3.fromRGB(104, 127, 161)
end

return FarmNightLighting

--!strict
-- Low-poly weapon models held in the player's right hand, grip at the origin and barrel
-- pointing -Z; a "Muzzle" part marks where tracers start. No textures: dark metal, worn wood,
-- a little steel.
--
-- Preferred source: Blender meshes (tools/blender/weapons.py) imported into
-- ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Weapons — one MeshPart per colour tone (<Name>_Metal, _Steel,
-- _Wood, _WoodDark) plus <Name>_Grip / <Name>_Muzzle marker cubes (0.1 stud in Blender). The
-- markers fix the importer's unit scale and orientation, so the raw import works as is.
-- Without imported meshes, the part-built models below are used.

local WeaponModels = {}

local METAL = Color3.fromRGB(42, 44, 48)
local STEEL = Color3.fromRGB(150, 154, 160)
local WOOD = Color3.fromRGB(110, 72, 44)
local WOOD_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(80, 52, 34)

type Piece = {
	size: Vector3,
	offset: Vector3,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	rotation: Vector3?,
}

local function p(
	size: Vector3,
	offset: Vector3,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	rotation: Vector3?
): Piece
	return { size = size, offset = offset, color = color, material = material, rotation = rotation }
end

-- Barrel tip per model, for the Muzzle marker.
local MODELS: { [string]: { pieces: { Piece }, muzzle: Vector3 } } = {
	Pistol = {
		pieces = {
			p(
				Vector3.new(0.25, 0.6, 0.35),
				Vector3.new(0, -0.2, 0.05),
				METAL,
				nil,
				Vector3.new(-15, 0, 0)
			),
			p(Vector3.new(0.27, 0.3, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -0.3), METAL, Enum.Material.Metal),
		},
		muzzle = Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -0.85),
	},
	SMG = {
		pieces = {
			p(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.45, 1.3), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -0.35), METAL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.75, 0.3), Vector3.new(0, -0.3, -0.45), METAL),
			p(Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 0.25, -1.2), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.2, 0.35, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0.55), METAL),
		},
		muzzle = Vector3.new(0, 0.25, -1.5),
	},
	Shotgun = {
		pieces = {
			p(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 2.4), Vector3.new(0, 0.3, -1), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.28, 0.7), Vector3.new(0, 0.1, -1), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood),
			p(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.4, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0.1), METAL),
			p(
				Vector3.new(0.28, 0.5, 1),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.85),
				WOOD,
				Enum.Material.Wood,
				Vector3.new(-8, 0, 0)
			),
		},
		muzzle = Vector3.new(0, 0.3, -2.25),
	},
	Rifle = {
		pieces = {
			p(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.5, 1.8), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -0.5), METAL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0.3, -1.85), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 0.8), Vector3.new(0, 0.62, -0.5), METAL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.7, 0.32), Vector3.new(0, -0.3, -0.6), METAL),
			p(Vector3.new(0.26, 0.45, 0.9), Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0.75), METAL),
		},
		muzzle = Vector3.new(0, 0.3, -2.4),
	},
	AK47 = {
		pieces = {
			p(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.42, 1.5), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -0.4), METAL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.32, 0.34, 0.7), Vector3.new(0, 0.18, -1.3), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood),
			p(Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, 0.7), Vector3.new(0, 0.3, -1.95), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			-- The curved magazine is the AK's silhouette.
			p(
				Vector3.new(0.22, 0.8, 0.32),
				Vector3.new(0, -0.35, -0.55),
				METAL,
				nil,
				Vector3.new(18, 0, 0)
			),
			p(
				Vector3.new(0.26, 0.5, 1),
				Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0.75),
				WOOD,
				Enum.Material.Wood,
				Vector3.new(-10, 0, 0)
			),
		},
		muzzle = Vector3.new(0, 0.3, -2.3),
	},
	Knife = {
		pieces = {
			p(Vector3.new(0.18, 0.22, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.1), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood),
			p(Vector3.new(0.06, 0.2, 0.8), Vector3.new(0, 0.02, -0.55), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
		},
		muzzle = Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.95),
	},
	Bat = {
		pieces = {
			p(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 1.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.2), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood),
			p(Vector3.new(0.38, 0.38, 1.6), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.55), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood),
			-- Nails sticking out of the head.
			p(Vector3.new(0.06, 0.6, 0.06), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.4), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.6, 0.06, 0.06), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.8), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
			p(Vector3.new(0.06, 0.6, 0.06), Vector3.new(0, 0, -2.1), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal),
		},
		muzzle = Vector3.new(0, 0, -2.4),
	},
}

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(214, 172, 62)

local TONE_COLORS: { [string]: Color3 } = {
	Metal = METAL,
	Steel = STEEL,
	Wood = WOOD,
	WoodDark = WOOD_DARK,
}
local MARKER_SIZE = 0.1
-- Grip → muzzle in studs as authored in Blender (assets/export/weapons.json).
local MESH_MUZZLE: { [string]: Vector3 } = {
	Pistol = Vector3.new(0, 0.24, -0.95),
	SMG = Vector3.new(0, 0.28, -1.48),
	Shotgun = Vector3.new(0, 0.33, -2.25),
	Rifle = Vector3.new(0, 0.26, -2.35),
	AK47 = Vector3.new(0, 0.24, -2.25),
	Knife = Vector3.new(0, 0.03, -1.0),
	Bat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -2.45),
}

local function meshSource(): Instance?
	local assets = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Assets")
	return assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
end

local function findMesh(root: Instance, name: string): BasePart?
	local found = root:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	return if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then found else nil
end

-- Shortest-arc rotation turning `from` onto `to` (both non-zero).
local function arc(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): CFrame
	local a, b = from.Unit, to.Unit
	local axis = a:Cross(b)
	local dot = math.clamp(a:Dot(b), -1, 1)
	if axis.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
		return if dot > 0 then CFrame.identity else CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis, math.pi)
	end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(dot))
end

-- Rotation that turns `from` onto `to`, for import axis mismatches. Turns around the vertical
-- first (the Studio importer brings these FBX files in facing +Z, a 180° yaw), then fixes any
-- remaining pitch — a plain shortest arc would roll a reversed gun onto its side.
local function alignRotation(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): CFrame
	local yaw = CFrame.identity
	if
		Vector2.new(from.X, from.Z).Magnitude > 1e-3
		and Vector2.new(to.X, to.Z).Magnitude > 1e-3
	then
		yaw = CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(to.X, to.Z) - math.atan2(from.X, from.Z), 0)
	end
	return arc(yaw * from, to) * yaw
end

-- Builds `name` from imported Blender meshes, normalised to studs with the grip at the
-- origin. Nil if the meshes for it aren't in the place.
local function buildFromMeshes(name: string, skin: string?): Model?
	local source = meshSource()
	local grip = source and findMesh(source, name .. "_Grip")
	local tip = source and findMesh(source, name .. "_Muzzle")
	local expected = MESH_MUZZLE[name]
	if not source or not grip or not tip or not expected then
		return nil
	end
	local scale = MARKER_SIZE / math.max(grip.Size.X, 1e-6)
	local gripFrame = grip.CFrame
	local rawMuzzle = gripFrame:PointToObjectSpace(tip.Position) * scale
	if rawMuzzle.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		return nil
	end
	-- Whatever axes the importer used, turn the grip→muzzle line onto the authored one.
	local fix = alignRotation(rawMuzzle, expected)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name
	for tone, color in TONE_COLORS do
		local mesh = findMesh(source, name .. "_" .. tone)
		if mesh then
			local piece = mesh:Clone()
			for _, child in piece:GetChildren() do
				child:Destroy() -- drop importer leftovers (welds, attachments)
			end
			local relative = gripFrame:ToObjectSpace(mesh.CFrame)
			piece.Size = mesh.Size * scale
			piece.CFrame = fix * (CFrame.new(relative.Position * scale) * relative.Rotation)
			local metal = tone == "Metal" or tone == "Steel"
			piece.Color = if skin == "gold" and metal then GOLD else color
			piece.Material = if skin == "gold" and metal
				then Enum.Material.Foil
				elseif metal then Enum.Material.Metal
				else Enum.Material.Wood
			piece.Anchored = false
			piece.Massless = true
			piece.CanCollide = false
			piece.CanQuery = false
			piece.CanTouch = false
			piece.CastShadow = false
			piece.Parent = model
		end
	end
	local muzzle = Instance.new("Part")
	muzzle.Name = "Muzzle"
	muzzle.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
	muzzle.Transparency = 1
	muzzle.Anchored = false
	muzzle.Massless = true
	muzzle.CanCollide = false
	muzzle.CanQuery = false
	muzzle.CanTouch = false
	muzzle.CFrame = CFrame.new(expected)
	muzzle.Parent = model
	model.WorldPivot = CFrame.new()
	return model
end

-- Builds the model for `name` (a gun or melee name). The returned model's pivot is the grip.
-- `skin` "gold" (Pacote do Sobrevivente) turns the metal parts gold; wood stays wood.
function WeaponModels.build(name: string, skin: string?): Model?
	local fromMeshes = buildFromMeshes(name, skin)
	if fromMeshes then
		return fromMeshes
	end
	local def = MODELS[name]
	if not def then
		return nil
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name
	local function part(partName: string, size: Vector3, cframe: CFrame): Part
		local piece = Instance.new("Part")
		piece.Name = partName
		piece.Size = size
		piece.CFrame = cframe
		piece.Anchored = false
		piece.Massless = true
		piece.CanCollide = false
		piece.CanQuery = false
		piece.CanTouch = false
		piece.CastShadow = false
		piece.Parent = model
		return piece
	end
	for i, piece in def.pieces do
		local rotation = piece.rotation or Vector3.zero
		local built = part(
			"Piece" .. i,
			piece.size,
			CFrame.new(piece.offset)
				* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotation.X), math.rad(rotation.Y), math.rad(rotation.Z))
		)
		local metal = piece.color == METAL or piece.color == STEEL
		if skin == "gold" and metal then
			built.Color = GOLD
			built.Material = Enum.Material.Foil
		else
			built.Color = piece.color
			built.Material = piece.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		end
	end
	local muzzle = part("Muzzle", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), CFrame.new(def.muzzle))
	muzzle.Transparency = 1
	model.WorldPivot = CFrame.new()
	return model
end

return WeaponModels

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Art.ZombieRigs.source:
--!strict
-- Low-poly zombie rigs (docs/DEFINICOES.md §3): a shared base body plus a few parts per kind
-- for a readable silhouette — Runner lean and ragged, Bull in riot plates, Creeper bloated
-- with glowing pustules, Brute hunched with huge fists. No textures; colour and shape only.
-- Every part belongs to an animation role; the renderer rotates arms and legs around their
-- role's pivot and bobs the body and head.
--
-- Offsets are relative to the feet with the zombie facing -Z, before the kind's scale.

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local ZombieRigs = {}

export type Role = "Body" | "Head" | "ArmL" | "ArmR" | "LegL" | "LegR"
export type Tone = "skin" | "shirt" | "pants" | "eyes" | "dark" | "accent" | "glow" | "fixed"

export type PartSpec = {
	name: string,
	role: Role,
	tone: Tone,
	size: Vector3,
	offset: Vector3,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	-- Hero rigs (Art/HeroRigs): the Blender mesh to use, its own colour for tone "fixed",
	-- and whether it glows (flashes red on a Creeper's fuse).
	mesh: string?,
	color: Color3?,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	glow: boolean?,
}

export type Variant = { skin: Color3, shirt: Color3, pants: Color3 }

-- Rotation pivots: hips for legs, shoulders for arms; body and head only bob.
ZombieRigs.PIVOTS = table.freeze({
	Body = Vector3.zero,
	Head = Vector3.zero,
	ArmL = Vector3.new(-1.12, 3.75, 0),
	ArmR = Vector3.new(1.12, 3.75, 0),
	LegL = Vector3.new(-0.45, 2, 0),
	LegR = Vector3.new(0.45, 2, 0),
}) :: { [Role]: Vector3 }

local EYES = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 20)
local GLOW = Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 60)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(40, 25, 25)
ZombieRigs.FUSE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(230, 30, 30)

local function spec(
	name: string,
	role: Role,
	tone: Tone,
	size: Vector3,
	offset: Vector3,
	shape: Enum.PartType?
): PartSpec
	return { name = name, role = role, tone = tone, size = size, offset = offset, shape = shape }
end

local function base(): { PartSpec }
	return {
		spec("LegL", "LegL", "pants", Vector3.new(0.7, 2, 0.7), Vector3.new(-0.45, 1, 0)),
		spec("LegR", "LegR", "pants", Vector3.new(0.7, 2, 0.7), Vector3.new(0.45, 1, 0)),
		spec("Hips", "Body", "pants", Vector3.new(1.7, 0.6, 0.95), Vector3.new(0, 2.15, 0)),
		-- Slight forward hunch: the chest sits a little ahead of the hips.
		spec("Torso", "Body", "shirt", Vector3.new(1.8, 1.7, 1), Vector3.new(0, 3.25, -0.1)),
		spec("Head", "Head", "skin", Vector3.new(1.15, 1.15, 1.15), Vector3.new(0, 4.6, -0.3)),
		spec("Jaw", "Head", "dark", Vector3.new(0.8, 0.28, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 4.08, -0.65)),
		spec("Eyes", "Head", "eyes", Vector3.new(0.85, 0.2, 0.1), Vector3.new(0, 4.75, -0.88)),
		spec("ArmL", "ArmL", "skin", Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 2), Vector3.new(-1.12, 3.75, -0.85)),
		spec("ArmR", "ArmR", "skin", Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 2), Vector3.new(1.12, 3.75, -0.85)),
		spec(
			"SleeveL",
			"ArmL",
			"shirt",
			Vector3.new(0.58, 0.58, 0.6),
			Vector3.new(-1.12, 3.75, -0.1)
		),
		spec(
			"SleeveR",
			"ArmR",
			"shirt",
			Vector3.new(0.58, 0.58, 0.6),
			Vector3.new(1.12, 3.75, -0.1)
		),
	}
end

local function withExtras(extras: { PartSpec }): { PartSpec }
	local parts = base()
	for _, extra in extras do
		table.insert(parts, extra)
	end
	return table.freeze(parts)
end

ZombieRigs.RIGS = table.freeze({
	Runner = withExtras({}),
	-- Riot gear: shoulder plates, chest plate, helmet.
	Bull = withExtras({
		spec("PlateL", "Body", "accent", Vector3.new(1, 0.5, 1.2), Vector3.new(-1.1, 4.15, 0)),
		spec("PlateR", "Body", "accent", Vector3.new(1, 0.5, 1.2), Vector3.new(1.1, 4.15, 0)),
		spec("Chest", "Body", "accent", Vector3.new(1.9, 1.3, 0.3), Vector3.new(0, 3.3, -0.65)),
		spec("Helmet", "Head", "accent", Vector3.new(1.3, 0.6, 1.3), Vector3.new(0, 5.05, -0.3)),
	}),
	-- Swollen belly and pustules that glow (and flash red on the fuse).
	Creeper = withExtras({
		spec(
			"Belly",
			"Body",
			"skin",
			Vector3.new(1.9, 1.9, 1.9),
			Vector3.new(0, 2.95, -0.4),
			Enum.PartType.Ball
		),
		spec(
			"PustuleA",
			"Body",
			"glow",
			Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
			Vector3.new(0.6, 3.4, -1.25),
			Enum.PartType.Ball
		),
		spec(
			"PustuleB",
			"Body",
			"glow",
			Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4),
			Vector3.new(-0.5, 2.6, -1.3),
			Enum.PartType.Ball
		),
		spec(
			"PustuleC",
			"Head",
			"glow",
			Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35),
			Vector3.new(0.4, 5, -0.6),
			Enum.PartType.Ball
		),
	}),
	-- Hunched back, heavy trapezius, fists like boulders.
	Brute = withExtras({
		spec("FistL", "ArmL", "skin", Vector3.new(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), Vector3.new(-1.12, 3.75, -2)),
		spec("FistR", "ArmR", "skin", Vector3.new(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), Vector3.new(1.12, 3.75, -2)),
		spec("Hunch", "Body", "shirt", Vector3.new(1.6, 1, 1), Vector3.new(0, 4.15, 0.5)),
		spec("TrapL", "Body", "skin", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.6, 0.9), Vector3.new(-0.7, 4.15, 0)),
		spec("TrapR", "Body", "skin", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.6, 0.9), Vector3.new(0.7, 4.15, 0)),
	}),
}) :: { [Types.ZombieKind]: { PartSpec } }

-- Desaturated clothing, so the crowd varies without stealing attention from the eyes.
local RUNNER_SHIRTS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(150, 145, 130),
	Color3.fromRGB(80, 90, 105),
	Color3.fromRGB(110, 52, 46),
	Color3.fromRGB(84, 92, 62),
	Color3.fromRGB(95, 75, 55),
	Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 74),
}
local RUNNER_PANTS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 72),
	Color3.fromRGB(72, 62, 50),
	Color3.fromRGB(42, 46, 52),
	Color3.fromRGB(88, 82, 64),
}
local RUNNER_SKINS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(122, 132, 110),
	Color3.fromRGB(132, 128, 112),
	Color3.fromRGB(108, 118, 104),
}

local FIXED: { [Types.ZombieKind]: Variant } = {
	Bull = {
		skin = Color3.fromRGB(110, 104, 96),
		shirt = Color3.fromRGB(58, 62, 72),
		pants = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 55),
	},
	Creeper = {
		skin = Color3.fromRGB(160, 176, 70),
		shirt = Color3.fromRGB(104, 118, 40),
		pants = Color3.fromRGB(60, 64, 40),
	},
	Brute = {
		skin = Color3.fromRGB(104, 92, 84),
		shirt = Color3.fromRGB(58, 44, 38),
		pants = Color3.fromRGB(45, 38, 34),
	},
}

-- Colours for one zombie; `seed` (its id) keeps a Runner's outfit stable between LOD swaps.
function ZombieRigs.variant(kind: Types.ZombieKind, seed: number): Variant
	local fixed = FIXED[kind]
	if fixed then
		return fixed
	end
	return {
		skin = RUNNER_SKINS[seed % #RUNNER_SKINS + 1],
		shirt = RUNNER_SHIRTS[(seed // 3) % #RUNNER_SHIRTS + 1],
		pants = RUNNER_PANTS[(seed // 7) % #RUNNER_PANTS + 1],
	}
end

-- Colour of one rig part for one zombie's outfit.
function ZombieRigs.partColor(part: PartSpec, variant: Variant, kind: Types.ZombieKind): Color3
	return part.color or ZombieRigs.color(part.tone, variant, kind)
end

function ZombieRigs.color(tone: Tone, variant: Variant, kind: Types.ZombieKind): Color3
	if tone == "skin" then
		return variant.skin
	elseif tone == "shirt" then
		return variant.shirt
	elseif tone == "pants" then
		return variant.pants
	elseif tone == "eyes" then
		return EYES
	elseif tone == "glow" then
		return GLOW
	elseif tone == "accent" then
		return if kind == "Bull" then Color3.fromRGB(70, 74, 80) else Color3.fromRGB(60, 50, 45)
	end
	return DARK
end

function ZombieRigs.material(tone: Tone): Enum.Material
	if tone == "eyes" or tone == "glow" then
		return Enum.Material.Neon
	elseif tone == "accent" then
		return Enum.Material.Metal
	end
	return Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
end

return ZombieRigs

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Art.FarmVisuals.source:
--!strict
-- Art-only integration. Original map parts, prompts and gameplay tags stay in place.
local Structures = require(script.Parent.FarmStructures)
local Environment = require(script.Parent.FarmEnvironment)
local NightLighting = require(script.Parent.FarmNightLighting)
local Props = require(script.Parent.FarmProps)
local FacadeDetails = require(script.Parent.FarmFacadeDetails)

local FarmVisuals = {}

function FarmVisuals.apply(map: Instance)
	if map:FindFirstChild("VisualUpgrade") then
		return
	end
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "VisualUpgrade"
	Structures.build(map, root, Props.apply(map, root))
	FacadeDetails.build(root)
	Environment.build(root)
	-- Keep every surface out of movement, hitscan and overlap queries.
	for _, item in root:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			item.Anchored = true
			item.CanCollide = false
			item.CanQuery = false
			item.CanTouch = false
		end
	end
	root.Parent = map
	NightLighting.apply()
end

return FarmVisuals

--!strict
-- Blender meshes for the farm props (tools/blender/props.py): the rusted tractor, the pickup
-- and the crates. FarmMap still builds the original parts, which keep giving collisions, cover
-- and flow-field walls; when the meshes are imported into ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Props, those
-- parts turn invisible and the meshes are laid over them. Each prop is authored around the
-- centre of its body part, where a <Prop>_Origin marker cube gives the importer's unit scale.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local FarmProps = {}

local MARKER_SIZE = 0.1

type Look = { color: Color3, material: Enum.Material }
type PropDef = {
	anchor: string, -- body part the prop is drawn around
	parts: string, -- pattern for every original part of the prop (hidden when meshed)
	tones: { [string]: Look },
}

local function look(r: number, g: number, b: number, material: Enum.Material): Look
	return { color = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b), material = material }
end

local TIRE = look(28, 28, 30, Enum.Material.Rubber)
local DARK = look(43, 38, 34, Enum.Material.Metal)

local PROPS: { [string]: PropDef } = {
	Tractor = {
		anchor = "TractorBody",
		parts = "^Tractor",
		tones = {
			Paint = look(124, 72, 44, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal),
			Dark = DARK,
			Tire = TIRE,
			Rim = look(176, 146, 74, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal),
		},
	},
	Truck = {
		anchor = "TruckBody",
		parts = "^Truck",
		tones = {
			Paint = look(113, 44, 31, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal),
			Glass = look(30, 36, 42, Enum.Material.Glass),
			Tire = TIRE,
			Chrome = look(82, 86, 86, Enum.Material.Metal),
			Dark = DARK,
			Lamp = look(174, 161, 119, Enum.Material.Glass),
			Tail = look(120, 32, 26, Enum.Material.Glass),
		},
	},
	Crate = {
		anchor = "Crate",
		parts = "^Crate$",
		tones = {
			Wood = look(108, 94, 77, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks),
			Frame = look(72, 60, 48, Enum.Material.Wood),
		},
	},
}

-- Lays the meshes over map.Props and returns the props it drew, so FarmStructures skips its
-- part-built details for them. Without imported meshes nothing changes.
function FarmProps.apply(map: Instance, parent: Instance): { [string]: boolean }
	local meshed: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	local source = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Props")
	local props = map:FindFirstChild("Props")
	if not source or not props then
		return meshed
	end
	local meshes: { [string]: MeshPart } = {}
	for _, d in source:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
			meshes[d.Name] = d
		end
	end

	for name, def in PROPS do
		local origin = meshes[name .. "_Origin"]
		if not origin then
			continue
		end
		local scale = MARKER_SIZE / math.max(origin.Size.X, 1e-6)
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = name .. "Meshes"
		for _, anchor in props:GetChildren() do
			if not anchor:IsA("BasePart") or anchor.Name ~= def.anchor then
				continue
			end
			for tone, toneLook in def.tones do
				local mesh = meshes[name .. "_" .. tone]
				if not mesh then
					continue
				end
				local piece = mesh:Clone()
				for _, child in piece:GetChildren() do
					child:Destroy() -- importer leftovers (welds, attachments)
				end
				local relative = origin.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(mesh.CFrame)
				piece.Name = name .. tone
				piece.Size = mesh.Size * scale
				piece.CFrame = anchor.CFrame
					* CFrame.new(relative.Position * scale)
					* relative.Rotation
				piece.Color = toneLook.color
				piece.Material = toneLook.material
				piece.Parent = folder
			end
		end
		for _, p in props:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name:match(def.parts) then
				p.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		folder.Parent = parent
		meshed[name] = true
	end
	return meshed
end

return FarmProps

--!strict
-- Visual skins over the original farm. Every new part is excluded from physics and raycasts.
local Structures = {}
local WOOD = Color3.fromRGB(108, 94, 77)
local TRIM = Color3.fromRGB(147, 133, 106)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(43, 38, 34)
local ROOF = Color3.fromRGB(43, 53, 61)
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(113, 44, 31)
local RUST = Color3.fromRGB(106, 55, 32)
local WARM = Color3.fromRGB(255, 151, 60)

-- `meshed` names the props FarmProps already drew from Blender meshes; their part-built
-- details are skipped.
function Structures.build(map: Instance, parent: Instance, meshed: { [string]: boolean }?)
	local meshedProps = meshed or {}
	local rng = Random.new(241026)
	local count = 0
	local function group(name: string): Folder
		local f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = name
		f.Parent = parent
		return f
	end
	local function tint(c: Color3, amount: number): Color3
		local n = rng:NextNumber(-amount, amount)
		return Color3.new(
			math.clamp(c.R + n, 0, 1),
			math.clamp(c.G + n, 0, 1),
			math.clamp(c.B + n, 0, 1)
		)
	end
	local function piece(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		cf: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		folder: Instance,
		class: string?
	): BasePart
		local p = Instance.new(class or "Part") :: BasePart
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cf
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.Parent = folder
		count += 1
		return p
	end
	local function beam(
		name: string,
		a: Vector3,
		b: Vector3,
		width: number,
		color: Color3,
		folder: Instance
	)
		return piece(
			name,
			Vector3.new(width, width, (b - a).Magnitude),
			CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b),
			color,
			folder
		)
	end
	local function hideDecor(folder: Instance, prefixes: { string })
		for _, p in folder:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p.CanCollide and not p.CanQuery and #p:GetTags() == 0 then
				for _, prefix in prefixes do
					if string.sub(p.Name, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
						p.Transparency = 1
						p.CastShadow = false
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function light(holder: BasePart, range: number, brightness: number)
		local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
		l.Color = WARM
		l.Range = range
		l.Brightness = brightness
		l.Shadows = false
		l.Parent = holder
	end
	-- A shallow window on an already solid wall, never across a gameplay opening.
	local function window(cf: CFrame, width: number, height: number, folder: Instance)
		piece("WindowRecess", Vector3.new(width + 0.6, height + 0.6, 0.18), cf, DARK, folder)
		local glass = piece(
			"WarmWindow",
			Vector3.new(width, height, 0.12),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.12),
			Color3.fromRGB(193, 86, 31),
			folder
		)
		glass.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		light(glass, 14, 0.65)
		for _, x in { -width / 2, 0, width / 2 } do
			piece(
				"WindowMullion",
				Vector3.new(0.24, height + 0.4, 0.32),
				cf * CFrame.new(x, 0, 0.25),
				DARK,
				folder
			)
		end
		for _, y in { -height / 2, 0, height / 2 } do
			piece(
				"WindowRail",
				Vector3.new(width + 0.4, 0.24, 0.32),
				cf * CFrame.new(0, y, 0.25),
				TRIM,
				folder
			)
		end
		piece(
			"WindowSill",
			Vector3.new(width + 1, 0.35, 0.8),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, -height / 2 - 0.2, 0.1),
			WOOD,
			folder
		)
	end
	local function siding(original: Instance, center: Vector3, barn: boolean, dest: Instance)
		for _, wall in original:GetChildren() do
			if
				wall:IsA("BasePart")
				and (
					wall.Name:match("^Wall")
					or wall.Name:match("^Sill")
					or wall.Name:match("^Lintel")
					or wall.Name == "DoorLintel"
				)
			then
				local alongX = wall.Size.X > wall.Size.Z
				local length = if alongX then wall.Size.X else wall.Size.Z
				local axis = if alongX then Vector3.xAxis else Vector3.zAxis
				local normal = if alongX
					then Vector3.new(0, 0, if wall.Position.Z > center.Z then 1 else -1)
					else Vector3.new(if wall.Position.X > center.X then 1 else -1, 0, 0)
				local origin = wall.Position + normal * 0.63
				if barn then
					local columns = math.ceil(length / 1.55)
					for i = 1, columns do
						local width = length / columns - 0.09
						local pos = origin + axis * (-length / 2 + (i - 0.5) * length / columns)
						local size = if alongX
							then Vector3.new(width, wall.Size.Y - 0.1, 0.2)
							else Vector3.new(0.2, wall.Size.Y - 0.1, width)
						piece("BarnBoard", size, CFrame.new(pos), tint(RED, 0.055), dest)
					end
				else
					local rows = math.ceil(wall.Size.Y / 1.05)
					local cols = math.max(1, math.ceil(length / 8))
					for row = 1, rows do
						for col = 1, cols do
							local pos = origin
								+ axis * (-length / 2 + (col - 0.5) * length / cols)
								+ Vector3.new(
									0,
									-wall.Size.Y / 2 + (row - 0.5) * wall.Size.Y / rows,
									0
								)
							local size = if alongX
								then Vector3.new(
									length / cols - 0.07,
									wall.Size.Y / rows - 0.07,
									0.22
								)
								else Vector3.new(
									0.22,
									wall.Size.Y / rows - 0.07,
									length / cols - 0.07
								)
							piece(
								"WeatheredClapboard",
								size,
								CFrame.new(pos),
								tint(WOOD, 0.065),
								dest
							)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function roof(
		cx: number,
		cz: number,
		width: number,
		depth: number,
		height: number,
		rise: number,
		wallColor: Color3,
		dest: Instance
	)
		local half = depth / 2 + 1.7
		local angle = math.atan2(rise, half)
		local slopeLength = math.sqrt(half * half + rise * rise)
		local cols = math.ceil((width + 3.4) / 2.7)
		local rows = math.ceil(slopeLength / 3.0)
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			for row = 1, rows do
				for col = 1, cols do
					-- Broken shingles expose battens, with intact silhouette at the ridge.
					if row == 1 or rng:NextNumber() > 0.16 then
						local t = (row - 0.5) * slopeLength / rows
						local pos = Vector3.new(
							cx - (width + 3.4) / 2 + (col - 0.5) * (width + 3.4) / cols,
							height + rise - t * math.sin(angle),
							cz + side * t * math.cos(angle)
						)
						piece(
							"BrokenShingle",
							Vector3.new(
								(width + 3.4) / cols - 0.07,
								0.21,
								slopeLength / rows + 0.16
							),
							CFrame.new(pos)
								* CFrame.Angles(side * angle, 0, rng:NextNumber(-0.022, 0.022)),
							tint(ROOF, 0.04),
							dest
						)
					end
				end
			end
			for x = cx - width / 2, cx + width / 2, 4.2 do
				beam(
					"RoofRafter",
					Vector3.new(x, height + rise - 0.2, cz),
					Vector3.new(x, height - 0.2, cz + side * half),
					0.3,
					WOOD,
					dest
				)
			end
			for row = 1, 3 do
				local t = slopeLength * row / 4
				piece(
					"RoofBatten",
					Vector3.new(width + 2, 0.2, 0.2),
					CFrame.new(
						cx,
						height + rise - t * math.sin(angle) - 0.2,
						cz + side * t * math.cos(angle)
					),
					DARK,
					dest
				)
			end
		end
		piece(
			"RidgeCap",
			Vector3.new(width + 3.8, 0.45, 0.65),
			CFrame.new(cx, height + rise + 0.05, cz),
			ROOF,
			dest
		)
		for _, x in { cx - width / 2, cx + width / 2 } do
			for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
				piece(
					"GableEnd",
					Vector3.new(0.3, rise, depth / 2),
					CFrame.new(x, height + rise / 2, cz + side * depth / 4)
						* CFrame.Angles(0, if side > 0 then math.pi else 0, 0),
					wallColor,
					dest,
					"WedgePart"
				)
				beam(
					"GableFascia",
					Vector3.new(x, height + rise + 0.2, cz),
					Vector3.new(x, height - 0.05, cz + side * half),
					0.55,
					TRIM,
					dest
				)
			end
			for z = -depth / 2 + 1, depth / 2 - 1, 1.8 do
				local h = rise * (1 - math.abs(z) / (depth / 2))
				piece(
					"GableBoard",
					Vector3.new(0.42, math.max(0.2, h), 1.68),
					CFrame.new(x, height + h / 2, cz + z),
					tint(wallColor, 0.04),
					dest
				)
			end
		end
	end
	local house = map:FindFirstChild("Farmhouse")
	local barn = map:FindFirstChild("Barn")
	assert(house and barn, "Existing farm buildings missing")
	local hf = group("FarmhouseSkin")
	hideDecor(house, { "Roof", "Chimney", "Porch", "WindowN", "WindowW" })
	siding(house, Vector3.new(-28, 0, -10), false, hf)
	roof(-28, -10, 34, 28, 14.6, 9, WOOD, hf)
	-- Two warm south windows sit on solid facade segments outside the door opening.
	window(CFrame.new(-38, 7, 4.72), 4.5, 5.4, hf)
	window(CFrame.new(-18, 7, 4.72), 4.5, 5.4, hf)
	window(CFrame.new(-10.65, 18.3, -10) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0), 3.5, 4, hf)
	window(CFrame.new(-45.67, 7, -10) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi / 2, 0), 4.5, 5, hf)
	-- Broad porch with a clear central doorway and ammunition access on its east side.
	for x = -40, -16, 2 do
		piece(
			"PorchDeck",
			Vector3.new(1.9, 0.16, 7.2),
			CFrame.new(x, 0.16, 7.5),
			tint(WOOD, 0.06),
			hf
		)
	end
	for _, x in { -40, -34, -22, -16 } do
		piece("PorchPillar", Vector3.new(0.55, 9.3, 0.55), CFrame.new(x, 4.8, 10.8), TRIM, hf)
		beam(
			"PorchKneeBrace",
			Vector3.new(x, 7.5, 10.8),
			Vector3.new(x + 1.5, 9.2, 10.8),
			0.3,
			WOOD,
			hf
		)
	end
	for i = 0, 17 do
		piece(
			"PorchRoofBoard",
			Vector3.new(1.55, 0.22, 8.5),
			CFrame.new(-41 + i * 1.55, 10.1, 7.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(9), 0, 0),
			tint(ROOF, 0.035),
			hf
		)
	end
	for _, span in { { -40, -32 }, { -24, -16 } } do
		piece(
			"PorchRail",
			Vector3.new(span[2] - span[1], 0.25, 0.3),
			CFrame.new((span[1] + span[2]) / 2, 3.5, 10.8),
			TRIM,
			hf
		)
		for x = span[1], span[2], 1.3 do
			piece(
				"PorchBaluster",
				Vector3.new(0.2, 2.7, 0.2),
				CFrame.new(x, 1.95, 10.8),
				tint(WOOD, 0.04),
				hf
			)
		end
	end
	-- Brickwork rather than a single plain chimney.
	for row = 0, 9 do
		for col = 0, 1 do
			piece(
				"ChimneyBrick",
				Vector3.new(1.32, 0.62, 2.6),
				CFrame.new(-20.7 + col * 1.4 + (row % 2) * 0.12, 20 + row * 0.67, -14),
				tint(RUST, 0.05),
				hf
			)
		end
	end
	piece("ChimneyCrown", Vector3.new(3.3, 0.6, 3.2), CFrame.new(-20, 26.8, -14), DARK, hf)
	local bf = group("BarnSkin")
	hideDecor(barn, { "Roof", "CornerTrim", "DoorHeader", "Hayloft" })
	siding(barn, Vector3.new(30, 0, 12), true, bf)
	roof(30, 12, 30, 40, 20.6, 12, RED, bf)
	for _, x in { 14.5, 45.5 } do
		for _, z in { -8.6, 32.6 } do
			piece("BarnCornerPost", Vector3.new(0.8, 20, 0.8), CFrame.new(x, 10, z), WOOD, bf)
		end
	end
	-- Frames hug the existing west opening; no decoration spans the walkable opening.
	for _, z in { -0.5, 24.5 } do
		piece("BarnDoorJamb", Vector3.new(0.65, 19, 0.7), CFrame.new(14.1, 9.5, z), TRIM, bf)
	end
	piece("BarnDoorHeader", Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 26), CFrame.new(14.1, 19.2, 12), TRIM, bf)
	window(CFrame.new(14.55, 24.4, 12) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi / 2, 0), 5.8, 4.6, bf)
	window(CFrame.new(30, 10, 32.72), 4, 4.8, bf)
	for _, z in { -8.75, 32.75 } do
		for y = 3, 18, 7.2 do
			piece(
				"BarnHorizontalBeam",
				Vector3.new(30.8, 0.36, 0.4),
				CFrame.new(30, y, z),
				WOOD,
				bf
			)
		end
		beam("BarnDiagonalBrace", Vector3.new(16, 3, z), Vector3.new(24, 17, z), 0.45, WOOD, bf)
		beam("BarnDiagonalBrace", Vector3.new(44, 3, z), Vector3.new(36, 17, z), 0.45, WOOD, bf)
	end
	-- Warm recessed interior lighting keeps the original shop visibly accessible.
	local glow = piece("BarnWarmFill", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), CFrame.new(25, 9, 12), WARM, bf)
	glow.Transparency = 1
	light(glow, 27, 1.2)
	local yard = map:FindFirstChild("Yard")
	assert(yard, "Existing yard missing")
	hideDecor(yard, { "Mill" })
	local mf = group("WindmillSkin")
	local base = Vector3.new(-45, 0, -45)
	local top = 38
	local corners =
		{ Vector2.new(-1, -1), Vector2.new(1, -1), Vector2.new(1, 1), Vector2.new(-1, 1) }
	local function leg(c: Vector2, y: number): Vector3
		local spread = 3.4 - 2.5 * y / top
		return base + Vector3.new(c.X * spread, y, c.Y * spread)
	end
	for i, c in corners do
		beam("TowerLeg", leg(c, 0), leg(c, top), 0.55, RUST, mf)
		local nextCorner = corners[i % 4 + 1]
		for y = 0, 28, 7 do
			beam("TowerCross", leg(c, y), leg(nextCorner, y + 7), 0.24, WOOD, mf)
			beam("TowerRail", leg(c, y + 7), leg(nextCorner, y + 7), 0.28, RUST, mf)
		end
	end
	piece("MillServicePlatform", Vector3.new(4.2, 0.4, 4.2), CFrame.new(-45, 36, -45), WOOD, mf)
	local hub = base + Vector3.new(0, 40, -1.8)
	for i = 0, 15 do
		local angle = i * math.pi / 8
		local outward = Vector3.new(math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle), 0)
		local tangent = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), -math.sin(angle), 0)
		beam("RotorSpoke", hub, hub + outward * 8.7, 0.12, DARK, mf)
		if i ~= 3 and i ~= 10 then
			piece(
				"RotorSail",
				Vector3.new(2.3, 3.5, 0.18),
				CFrame.fromMatrix(hub + outward * 7, tangent, outward, Vector3.zAxis),
				tint(ROOF, 0.035),
				mf
			)
		end
		local nextDirection =
			Vector3.new(math.sin(angle + math.pi / 8), math.cos(angle + math.pi / 8), 0)
		beam("RotorRim", hub + outward * 5.2, hub + nextDirection * 5.2, 0.14, RUST, mf)
	end
	local hubPart = piece(
		"RotorHub",
		Vector3.new(0.9, 1.8, 1.8),
		CFrame.new(hub) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0),
		RUST,
		mf
	) :: Part
	hubPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	beam("VaneArm", hub + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), hub + Vector3.new(10, -0.5, 3), 0.3, RUST, mf)
	piece(
		"TailVane",
		Vector3.new(5, 3, 0.2),
		CFrame.new(hub + Vector3.new(10, -0.5, 3)) * CFrame.Angles(0, -0.2, 0.08),
		ROOF,
		mf
	)
	local perimeter = map:FindFirstChild("Perimeter")
	assert(perimeter, "Existing perimeter missing")
	hideDecor(perimeter, { "SiloDome", "SiloHoop", "Ladder" })
	local sf = group("SiloSkin")
	local siloCenter = Vector3.new(56, 0, -56)
	-- Panel seams and segmented cap retain the original cylindrical climb collider.
	for panel = 0, 15 do
		local a = panel * math.pi / 8
		local cf = CFrame.new(siloCenter) * CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0)
		for row = 0, 4 do
			piece(
				"SiloSheet",
				Vector3.new(2.7, 5.86, 0.16),
				cf * CFrame.new(0, 3 + row * 6, 7.06),
				tint(Color3.fromRGB(116, 121, 119), 0.045),
				sf
			)
		end
		for _, y in { 1, 6, 12, 18, 24, 29.5 } do
			piece(
				"SiloRingSegment",
				Vector3.new(2.85, 0.22, 0.22),
				cf * CFrame.new(0, y, 7.2),
				RUST,
				sf
			)
		end
		local domeA = siloCenter + Vector3.new(math.sin(a) * 7.2, 30, math.cos(a) * 7.2)
		local domeB = siloCenter + Vector3.new(math.sin(a) * 4.2, 34, math.cos(a) * 4.2)
		beam("DomeRib", domeA, domeB, 0.24, DARK, sf)
		beam("DomeRib", domeB, siloCenter + Vector3.new(0, 36, 0), 0.2, DARK, sf)
		piece(
			"DomeLowerPanel",
			Vector3.new(2.7, 0.22, 5),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, 32, 5.7) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(53), 0, 0),
			tint(ROOF, 0.025),
			sf
		)
		piece(
			"DomeUpperPanel",
			Vector3.new(1.55, 0.22, 4.7),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, 35, 2.1) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(26), 0, 0),
			tint(ROOF, 0.025),
			sf
		)
	end
	for _, x in { 54.9, 57.1 } do
		piece("SiloLadderRail", Vector3.new(0.2, 30, 0.2), CFrame.new(x, 15, -48.5), DARK, sf)
	end
	for y = 1, 29, 1.5 do
		piece("SiloLadderRung", Vector3.new(2.3, 0.17, 0.2), CFrame.new(56, y, -48.5), RUST, sf)
	end
	-- Detail existing cover props without changing their extents or physical materials.
	local props = map:FindFirstChild("Props")
	assert(props, "Existing props missing")
	local pf = group("PropDetails")
	for _, p in props:GetChildren() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			if p.Name == "Crate" and not meshedProps.Crate then
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					for _, y in { -1.2, 1.2 } do
						piece(
							"CrateFrame",
							Vector3.new(3.1, 0.28, 0.2),
							p.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, y, side * 1.57),
							DARK,
							pf
						)
					end
					piece(
						"CrateDiagonal",
						Vector3.new(0.32, 3.7, 0.2),
						p.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, side * 1.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(40)),
						WOOD,
						pf
					)
				end
			elseif p.Name:match("^Drum") then
				for _, x in { -1.25, 1.25 } do
					local hoop = piece(
						"BarrelHoop",
						Vector3.new(0.16, 2.28, 2.28),
						p.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, 0, 0),
						DARK,
						pf
					) :: Part
					hoop.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
				end
			elseif p.Name:match("^Truck") then
				if p.Name == "TruckBody" or p.Name == "TruckCab" then
					p.Color = RED
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not meshedProps.Truck then
		local truck = CFrame.new(-28, 0, 70) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-35), math.rad(4))
		piece("TruckGrille", Vector3.new(4.5, 1.2, 0.18), truck * CFrame.new(0, 2, -6.15), DARK, pf)
		piece(
			"TruckBumper",
			Vector3.new(5.2, 0.45, 0.6),
			truck * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, -6.25),
			Color3.fromRGB(82, 86, 86),
			pf
		)
		for _, x in { -1.7, 1.7 } do
			local headlight = piece(
				"TruckHeadlight",
				Vector3.new(0.15, 0.7, 0.7),
				truck * CFrame.new(x, 2.2, -6.3) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0),
				Color3.fromRGB(174, 161, 119),
				pf
			) :: Part
			headlight.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		end
		for i = 0, 5 do
			piece(
				"TruckGrilleSlat",
				Vector3.new(0.1, 1, 0.1),
				truck * CFrame.new(-1.1 + i * 0.44, 2, -6.28),
				TRIM,
				pf
			)
		end
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			piece(
				"TruckBedSide",
				Vector3.new(0.22, 1.25, 4),
				truck * CFrame.new(side * 2.45, 3.9, 3.7),
				RED,
				pf
			)
			piece(
				"TruckDoorHandle",
				Vector3.new(0.15, 0.13, 0.6),
				truck * CFrame.new(side * 2.5, 3.6, -0.3),
				DARK,
				pf
			)
		end
	end
	return count
end

--!strict
-- Supplemental architecture and weathering; only decorative descendants are created.
local Details = {}

function Details.build(parent: Instance)
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "FacadeDetails"
	root.Parent = parent
	local rng = Random.new(251026)
	local wood = Color3.fromRGB(105, 90, 72)
	local edge = Color3.fromRGB(132, 115, 88)
	local dark = Color3.fromRGB(44, 39, 33)
	local slate = Color3.fromRGB(43, 53, 61)
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		cf: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		wedge: boolean?
	): BasePart
		local p: BasePart = if wedge then Instance.new("WedgePart") else Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cf
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Parent = root
		return p
	end
	local function beam(name: string, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, width: number, color: Color3)
		part(
			name,
			Vector3.new(width, width, (b - a).Magnitude),
			CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b),
			color
		)
	end
	-- Front dormer above the porch: a visual attic, above the existing ceiling collider.
	local cx, front = -34, 0.8
	part("DormerFront", Vector3.new(6, 4.8, 0.3), CFrame.new(cx, 20.4, front), wood)
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		part("DormerSide", Vector3.new(0.3, 4.8, 6.5), CFrame.new(cx + side * 3, 20.4, -2.3), wood)
		part(
			"DormerGable",
			Vector3.new(0.35, 2.6, 3),
			CFrame.new(cx + side * 1.5, 24.1, front) * CFrame.Angles(0, -side * math.pi / 2, 0),
			wood,
			true
		)
		part(
			"DormerRoof",
			Vector3.new(4.5, 0.23, 7.1),
			CFrame.new(cx + side * 1.75, 24.1, -2.3)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -side * math.atan2(2.6, 3.5)),
			slate
		)
		beam(
			"DormerRoofTrim",
			Vector3.new(cx, 25.4, 1.35),
			Vector3.new(cx + side * 3.6, 22.75, 1.35),
			0.3,
			edge
		)
	end
	for row = 0, 4 do
		part("DormerClapboard", Vector3.new(6, 0.13, 0.2), CFrame.new(cx, 18.4 + row, 1), dark)
	end
	part("DormerWindowRecess", Vector3.new(3.2, 3.6, 0.15), CFrame.new(cx, 20.9, 1.05), dark)
	local pane = part(
		"DormerWarmGlass",
		Vector3.new(2.7, 3.1, 0.1),
		CFrame.new(cx, 20.9, 1.15),
		Color3.fromRGB(193, 86, 31)
	)
	pane.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
	glow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 159, 76)
	glow.Brightness = 0.45
	glow.Range = 11
	glow.Shadows = false
	glow.Parent = pane
	for _, x in { -1.5, 0, 1.5 } do
		part("DormerWindowFrame", Vector3.new(0.2, 3.7, 0.25), CFrame.new(cx + x, 20.9, 1.25), edge)
	end
	for _, y in { 19.1, 20.9, 22.7 } do
		part("DormerWindowFrame", Vector3.new(3.2, 0.2, 0.25), CFrame.new(cx, y, 1.25), edge)
	end
	-- Shutters flank only the south decorative windows; the east barricades are untouched.
	for _, wx in { -38, -18 } do
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			local cf = CFrame.new(wx + side * 3, 7, 4.95)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, side * 0.11, side * 0.035)
			for slat = 0, 6 do
				if not (side == 1 and slat == 2) then
					part(
						"BrokenShutter",
						Vector3.new(1, 0.62, 0.18),
						cf * CFrame.new(0, -2.1 + slat * 0.7, 0),
						wood:Lerp(dark, rng:NextNumber(0.1, 0.4))
					)
				end
			end
			part(
				"ShutterRail",
				Vector3.new(0.15, 5.2, 0.2),
				cf * CFrame.new(side * 0.35, 0, -0.05),
				dark
			)
		end
	end
	-- Thin broken boards and nail marks on existing, already-solid wall surfaces.
	for i = 1, 24 do
		local x = if i % 2 == 0 then rng:NextNumber(-44, -32) else rng:NextNumber(-24, -12)
		local y = rng:NextNumber(0.8, 13)
		if y < 4 or y > 10 then
			part(
				"SplitClapboard",
				Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(0.8, 2.2), 0.06, 0.06),
				CFrame.new(x, y, 4.77) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rng:NextNumber(-0.025, 0.025)),
				dark
			)
		end
	end
	-- Small leaf clusters climb the solid outer surfaces, never entrances or windows.
	for _, vine in
		{
			{ cf = CFrame.new(-44, 0, 4.9), height = 12 },
			{ cf = CFrame.new(-13, 0, 4.9), height = 6 },
			{ cf = CFrame.new(44, 0, 32.9), height = 16 },
			{ cf = CFrame.new(17, 0, 32.9), height = 10 },
			{ cf = CFrame.new(59, 0, -49.4), height = 22 },
		}
	do
		for step = 1, math.floor(vine.height / 0.85) do
			local x = math.sin(step * 0.65) * 0.7
			local cf = vine.cf * CFrame.new(x, step * 0.85, 0.04)
			part(
				"IvyStem",
				Vector3.new(0.09, 1, 0.12),
				cf * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.2 * math.cos(step)),
				dark
			)
			for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
				local color = Color3.fromRGB(
					65 + rng:NextInteger(0, 27),
					74 + rng:NextInteger(0, 20),
					37 + rng:NextInteger(0, 12)
				)
				part(
					"IvyLeaf",
					Vector3.new(0.7, 0.8, 0.12),
					cf
						* CFrame.new(side * 0.4, 0.2, 0.13)
						* CFrame.Angles(0, side * 0.25, side * 0.65),
					color,
					true
				)
			end
		end
	end
	-- Dark ties make the original hay cover read as bundled straw without touching it.
	for _, bale in
		{
			{ cf = CFrame.new(9, 1.25, 28), size = Vector3.new(4, 2.5, 2.5) },
			{
				cf = CFrame.new(9.5, 3.75, 28.3) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(8), 0),
				size = Vector3.new(4, 2.5, 2.5),
			},
		}
	do
		for _, x in { -1.1, 1.1 } do
			for _, z in { -1, 1 } do
				part(
					"HayBinding",
					Vector3.new(0.08, bale.size.Y + 0.03, 0.08),
					bale.cf * CFrame.new(x, 0, z * (bale.size.Z / 2 + 0.03)),
					dark
				)
			end
			part(
				"HayBinding",
				Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, bale.size.Z),
				bale.cf * CFrame.new(x, bale.size.Y / 2 + 0.03, 0),
				dark
			)
		end
	end
end

return Details
